jobs.title: Director Communication (Flexible Location)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to help shape how the world sees Seco? We’re entering an exciting new chapter for our Brand, Marketing and Communication function, one global unified team, built to keep the Seco brand top of mind for our key target audiences – and to accelerate the company strategy. We’re looking for a seasoned communications leader to join us as Director Communication and take our story telling, reputation and stakeholder engagement to the next level.

As a member of the Brand, Marketing and Communication Management Team, you work closely with Seco’s executive leadership and play a key role in shaping the future of our communication function. Be part of a people-centric culture with opportunities for professional growth within Seco and the wider Sandvik Group.

About the job

This is a unique opportunity to build, shape and further develop a future team of four team members, in a newly established communication department. As Director of Communication, you lead our global communication agenda across internal and external audiences. You design and drive an integrated communication strategy that builds trust with customers, partners and employees, while turning transformation into a clear and compelling story inside and outside the company. You’re a member of the leadership team and report to the Vice President Brand, Marketing and Communication.

Job responsibilities

    Own the global communication strategy supporting Seco´s purpose to make manufacturing fast, easy, and sustainable.
    Lead a senior communications team of four future team members, complemented by agency partners, through clarity, coaching and project-based ways of working.
    Drive thought leadership on key topics for Seco, including sustainability and the future of manufacturing.
    Protect and strengthen Seco’s public image through reputation management, media relations and crisis and issues communication.
    Lead change and transformation communication that engages employees around strategy, culture and organizational development.
    Provide executive communication counsel and content for the President of Seco and other senior leaders.
    Collaborate cross-functional with Sales, Offer & Innovation, Strategy, Sustainability, HR and Sandvik Group / Machining communications to deliver one Seco narrative.
    Manage the communication budget and agency ecosystem with a clear focus on business value and cost‑effectiveness.

Location and flexibility

This position is flexible within Europe or the Americas region.

Your profile

You’re an experienced communications leader with a strong background in corporate communications, public relations, or related fields, preferably from a global or multinational environment. With a degree in communications or a related field, you know how to connect business objectives to clear messaging, stakeholder engagement and measurable communication impact.

Your background includes

    Proven managerial experience, with the ability to guide, coach, and develop the team.
    Strong experience from internal communication, leadership messaging, and employee engagement.
    The ability to manage external communication and media relations to maintain a positive public image, including planning and execute crisis communication.
    Experience working in a project-based, cross-functional environment.
    Confidence managing budgets, projects and agency partners efficiently, with strong prioritization and time management skills.
    The ability to build relationships with media, industry leaders, and key stakeholders.
    Full professional fluency in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are a plus.

You bring a growth mindset, personal accountability, and a genuine belief in winning together, which is essential as you will help influence the direction of the newly established Brand, Marketing and Communication function alongside with your peers in the Management Team. Working across cultures, functions and leadership teams comes naturally to you, and you’re comfortable turning insight, feedback and data into communication that moves the business forward.

Our Seco culture  

At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.

Contact information  

For further information about this position, please contact:

Gabriella Huss, Executive Talent Acquisition Expert, gabriella.huss@sandvik.com

We’ve already decided on what advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts.

Hiring Manager  

Hanna Lye, Vice President Brand, Marketing and Communication

Send your application no later than August 30th, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0096144.

Our recruitment process is open and fair – we welcome all applicants and evaluate every unique application in line with the specified requirements profile, to find the best match for the position. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.

jobs.title: Barnevernkonsulent
jobs.employer: FELLES BARNEVERNTENESTE FOR VANG OG VESTRE SLIDRE KOMMUNE
jobs.description:
Felles barnevernteneste for Vang og Vestre Slidre kommune har eit ledig vikariat i 100 % stilling med snarleg oppstart og fram til 31.12.2027, med moglegheit for forlenging eller fast tilsetting.

Er du ein engasjert fagperson og ynskjer å vere del av eit fagmiljø der du kan gjere ein positiv skilnad? Vi søker deg som ynskjer varierte barnevernfaglege oppgåver i eit miljø med erfarne tilsette som er opptatt av utvikling, samarbeid og med eit høgt fagleg fokus! 

Opplysningar om arbeidsstaden og stillinga:

Felles barnevernteneste for Vang og Vestre Slidre kommune er ei interkommunal teneste der Vestre Slidre er vertskommune. Tenesta består av 8,1 årsverk og har godt utdanna og engasjerte fagfolk. Tenesta er organisert under avdelinga Familie, helse og førebygging. Barneverntenesta har fokus på å tilby tiltak for barn, unge og familiar der dei bur og vi har fokus på korleis vi organiserer tenesta for å sikre kvalitet og effektivitet i sakshandsaminga. Det vert lagt vekt på tverrfagleg samarbeid med andre tenester. 

Tenesta jobbar etter generalistmodellen, som omfattar oppgåver knytt til mottak, akuttarbeid, undersøking, hjelpetiltak, omsorgstiltak/fosterheim og ettervern. Du får difor ein variert kvardag og brei erfaring som barnevernkonsulent.

Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Undersøking og oppfølging av hjelpe- og omsorgstiltak
  • Dokumentering og sakshandsaming av det barnevernsfaglege arbeidet i tråd med lovkrava
  • Partsrepresentant i Fylkesnemnda og øvrige rettsinstansar
  • Deltaking i barnevernfagleg akuttarbeid
  • Samarbeid med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartar
  • Aktiv deltaking i utviklinga av tenesta sitt faglege arbeid
  • Andre oppgåver kan bli tillagt stillinga
Kvalifikasjonar
  • - 3-årig relevant utdanning på høgskule- eller universitetsnivå, fortrinnsvis som barnevernspedagog, sosionom eller vernepleiar. 
    - Påbegynt eller fullført masterutdanning eller anna relevant vidareutdanning er ein fordel, men ikkje eit krav. 
    - Det er ynskjeleg med erfaring innan kommunal barnevernteneste. 
    - Førarkort klasse B (Krav)
Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ynskjer deg som:

  • har god relasjonskompetanse
  • kan uttrykke deg godt munnleg og skriftleg
  • har evne til å arbeide sjølvstendig, målretta og strukturert
  • har gode samarbeidsevner både internt og mot eksterne aktørar
  • er fleksibel, robust og har høg arbeidskapasitet
  • har eit fagleg engasjement
  • er trygg, raus og varm i fagutøvinga
  • vil bidra til gode tverrfaglege løysingar
  • er digitalt kompetent og har interesse for dette
Vi tilbyr
  • Kommunen kan legge til rette for vidareutdanning viss ynskeleg
  • Løn etter tariff. Som eit rekrutteringstiltak tilbyr vi minimum 10 års ansiennitet
  • Ellers gjeld arbeidsvilkår etter dei reglar som til ei kvar tid går fram av gjeldande lover, reglement og tariffavtalar
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Spennande og meningsfylte arbeidsoppgåver
  • Eit engasjert og kompetent arbeidsmiljø
  • Fagleg og personleg utvikling med støtte frå erfarne fagpersonar
  • Vestre Slidre og Vang ligg i sentralitetsklasse 5 og 6, og ved å bu i ein av desse kommunane kan du etter eitt år få sletta 25 000 kroner av studielånet ditt kvart år.
Kontaktinformasjon

Melanie Degen, Tenesteleiar Familie, helse og førebygging, 949 78 343

Arbeidsstad

Slidrevegen 16
2966 SLIDRE

Nøkkelinformasjon:

Arbeidsgivar: Vestre Slidre kommune

Referansenr.: 5160485687
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Vikar
Søknadsfrist: 03.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Andre opplysningar

 Eit godt arbeidsmiljø er prega av mangfald. Vi oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje uavhengig av kjønn, funksjonsevne eller kulturell bakgrunn. Arbeidsplassen vil bli tilrettelagt ved behov. Det vert gjort merksam på at namnet på ein søkjar kan bli gjort offentleg sjølv om søkjaren har bedt om at namnet blir unnteke offentleg søkjarliste. Ynskje om unntak frå offentleg søkjarliste må grunngjevast i søknaden, jf. offentleglova § 25, andre ledd. Søkjaren vert varsla dersom ynskje ikkje kan takast til følgje.

 

Vestre Slidre kommune er ein landbruks- og reiselivskommune i Valdres, og som ligg vakkert til nær Jotunheimen, er 457 km2 stor og har omlag 2 100 innbyggjarar. Vi har ei god skule, full barnehagedekning og ei av dei beste kulturskulane i landet. Kommunen har også eit rikt kulturliv med song, musikk og idrett, og eit vidt spekter innanfor lag og foreiningar.

Her ligg det til rette for aktivt friluftsliv - både sommar og vinter. Største delen av fjellområda i kommunen er statsallmenning. For jakt- og fiskeinteresserte byr dette på mange gode - som for eksempel fiske med garn og oter i alle vatn i allmenningen, og tilgang til småviltjakt. Vestre Slidre kommune kan også by på eit alpinanlegg og 300 km oppkøyrte skiløyper i vårt vakre og varierte fjellområde, samt to lysløypeanlegg. Det er god kommunikasjon til Oslo og Vestlandet via E-16, som går gjennom kommunen.

Flytte til Valdres? Sjå http://www.velgvaldres.no

Au sein d'un environnement Supply Chain Optimization (4PL), vous intervenez sur un périmètre stratégique visant à piloter et optimiser les opérations de transport multimodal, avec une dominante route.

Ainsi, vos missions principales seront :
- Superviser les opérations de transport multimodal, avec un focus sur le transport routier domestique et international
- Planifier, piloter et suivre l'ensemble des flux logistiques dans un environnement 4PL / Lead Logistics Provider
- Garantir le respect des SLA, KPI et engagements clients
- Gérer les incidents transport et mettre en place des plans d'actions correctifs
- Optimiser les coûts et la performance globale des opérations
- Piloter les relations avec les transporteurs et partenaires logistiques
- Négocier les conditions opérationnelles et contractuelles et suivre la performance fournisseurs
- Manager, accompagner et développer une équipe opérationnelle
- Organiser la planification et la répartition des activités
- Déployer une culture de performance et d'amélioration continue
- Piloter l'optimisation des processus transport et contribuer à la digitalisation (TMS, reporting, dashboards)
- Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients stratégiques et proposer des solutions d'optimisation logistique

Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en logistique, transport ou supply chain, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative de 5 ans minimum en transport et logistique, avec une expertise en transport routier national et international, sur des fonctions managériales.

Une expérience en environnement 4PL ou en pilotage de transporteurs multiples est fortement appréciée.
Vous maîtrisez les outils TMS ainsi que le pack Microsoft Office (Excel avancé, PowerPoint) et avez une bonne connaissance des KPI et du pilotage de la performance opérationnelle.
La connaissance des réglementations transport international et export control est un plus.
Un niveau bilingue français et anglais est indispensable. Une troisième langue serait appréciée.

Ce poste est une mission d'intérim à pourvoir à partir du mois de novembre, pour 6 mois, à Blagnac (31), statut Cadre.

jobs.title: Learning Support Teacher - Primary School
jobs.description:
Reports to: Dean of Students

﻿

Our vision

To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.

Our mission

Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.

Description/Purpose

A Learning Support teacher helps design and implement interventions for students with learning needs.

Duties/Responsibilities

    Collaborating with the subject teachers to set targets and strategies and accommodations needed by the identified students.
    Create individualized, strategic lessons and interventions for the student.
    Help students to cope with and overcome problems that arise because of learning difficulties.
    Use adaptive technology and targeted intervention programs to maximise individual learning potential.
    Work with students within a class and in small groups.
    Progress monitor and collect data to measure student progress and appropriateness of student support.
    Planning, collaborating and implementing ILP’s.
    Adapting  PYP / primary school program and conventional teaching methods to meet individual needs.
    Working as a team-member within the Department and wider school staff and liaising with other relevant individuals such as educational psychologists, parents and other specialists that compose a multidisciplinary team.
    Providing professional development and classroom strategies to teachers that will improve the classroom performance and student achievement.

Required Qualifications, Attributes and Experience

    Qualified SPED teacher or Qualified teacher with specialised SPED related training.
    Experience as a Learning Support Teacher in Primary school is an advantage.
    Experience of IB curriculum is an advantage.
    Self-motivation, creativity and enthusiasm.
    Experience in working with/ awareness of local laws.
    Experience and flexibility working in an international school environment.
    Excellent communication, collaboration and organizational skills.
    A strong ability to establish good rapport with students and adults.
    Ability to maintain confidentiality.
    Ability to view students with unconditional positive regard.
    Ability to show initiative and to work independently.
    Ability to administer assessments.
    Fluent in English (reading, writing, speaking).

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:

As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation.

Contract details:

Temporary Cover Contract

Employment rate: 50%

Start date: Immediate

End date: December 18, 2026 (possibility of extension for the rest of the school year. Will be discussed at the end of the contract).

Salary:

Individually negotiated.

Application:

Last day for application: Monday August 24, 2026.

We only accept applications in English and from certified candidates.

SIS holds the right to offer the position as soon as a viable candidate is found.

Please send your letter of interest and CV to application@intsch.se. Please write [LS Teacher Primary School] in the Subject Line.

jobs.title: Barnevernkonsulent
jobs.description:
Nordre Aker barneverntjeneste holder til i hyggelige lokaler i Nydalsveien 21 med utsikt til Akerselva, og er samlokalisert med øvrige tjenester i bydelen. Dette gir oss en unik mulighet til enkelt å samarbeide på tvers og møte innbyggerne med rett hjelp til rett tid, noe vi er svært opptatt av.

Barneverntjenesten i Nordre Aker er organisert under samme seksjon som forebyggende enhet og kulturenheten. Målet er å jobbe godt forebyggende barne- og ungdomsarbeid. Vi har 25 stillinger og er organisert etter spesialistmodell. Tjenesten består av følgende team: mottak- og undersøkelsesteam, tiltaksteam, familieteam og fosterhjemsteam.

Stillingen er tilknyttet tjenestens tiltaksteam.

  • Delta i opplæring av nyansatte og studenter

  • 3-årig sosialfaglig utdanning som barnevernspedagog, sosionom eller annen relevant 3-årig høgskole/ universitetsutdanning

  • Krav om erfaring fra arbeid med barneverntjenestens målgruppe, fortrinnsvis erfaring fra barneverntjenestens førstelinje
  • Krav om erfaring fra tverrfaglig samarbeid

  • Gyldig politiattest kreves ved ansettelse

  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner som skaper trygghet og tillit hos brukerne
  • Du er god til å prioritere, du tåler arbeidspress og er fleksibel
  • Du liker å jobbe strukturert og systematisk
  • Du har mot til å være tydelig, og til å fremme egne synspunkter og vurderinger
  • Du er en medarbeider som liker å samarbeide med kollegaer og aktuelle instanser. Du er samtidig selvstendig og kan stå alene i relasjoner og situasjoner
  • Du leverer i henhold til tidsfrister, og kan tenke kreativt når utfordrende oppgaver skal løses
  • Du liker å ha et sosialt engasjement på arbeidsplassen
  • Du er opptatt av kompetanse- og fagutvikling, og således ville bidra til utvikling av tjenesten
Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag med krevende utfordringer
  • Fokus på faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving
  • Intern og ekstern veiledning
  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med mye humor
  • En stabil personalgruppe med høy faglig kompetanse
  • Gode forsikrings-, pensjon-, og låneordninger
  • Lønnstrinn 34-43 (kr 633.200- 740.600 ) etter lønnsansiennitet
  • Relevant videreutdanning kompenseres med ett lønnstrinn for 30 studiepoeng og to lønnstrinn for master

Bydel Nordre Aker har rundt 56 000 innbyggere. Bydelen strekker seg fra Badebakken i sør, gjennom Maridalen og Solemskogen i nord, og fra Trondheimsveien i øst til Sognsvannsbekken i vest. Denne utstrekningen gjør Bydel Nordre Aker til den geografisk største bydelen i Oslo. Bydelens visjon er: " Sammen skaper vi selvstendige, aktive og gode liv i Bydel  Nordre Aker". Vi ønsker å være i dialog med bydelens innbyggere og utvikle gode tjenester. 

Arbeidsplassene i Oslo kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Oslo kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

I henhold til offentlighetsloven kan søkeren føres opp på offentlig søkerliste selv om det er anmodet om anonymitet. Vedkommende vil i tilfelle bli varslet.

jobs.title: Sous Chef with a Passion for Teamwork and good food, for University Canteen in Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you a highly skilled culinary professional who loves being where the action is – while also dreaming of family-friendly working hours and an amazing team? Then keep reading. We are looking for a Sous Chef with strong control of the hot kitchen section, a keen eye for quality, and a good sense of humor.

Who are we?

We are a large canteen serving approximately 350 guests daily – both students and staff in Copenhagen. The atmosphere is vibrant, filled with energy, learning, and great food.

You will become part of a friendly and supportive team where everyone pulls together, and where we truly mean it when we say we enjoy working with each other. There are smiles in the kitchen and a relaxed atmosphere – even during busy times. We also collaborate closely with colleagues in other canteens and cafés on campus, so you are never on your own.

Your responsibilities

As Sous Chef, you will be the Head Chef’s right hand and take responsibility for the hot kitchen section – while also rotating and supporting across the team when needed. Your primary tasks include:

  • Daily operations and food preparation in both canteens – vegetarian and classic cuisine

  • Sparring with the Head Chef on development and optimization

  • Ensuring quality, joy of food, and positive energy – every day

  • Catering for meetings and participating in events

  • Contributing ideas, structure, and a great atmosphere in the kitchen

Who are you?

You are a trained chef or caterer, and you:

  • Have a strong overview and can stay calm under pressure

  • Are positive, outgoing, and a true team player

  • Have a flair for both classic canteen dishes and plant-based cuisine

  • Thrive in a lively environment with many people

  • Want to be part of a team where we both laugh and work hard

Why apply?

Because we offer you:

  • A great workplace with good colleagues and a positive atmosphere

  • Working hours from 6:30 AM to 2:30 PM – giving you time for yourself and your family

  • Opportunities for professional development and new culinary experiences

  • Salary and terms according to the canteen collective agreement, including:

  • Competitive base salary, pension, health insurance, and flexible benefits scheme

Ready to apply?

Send us your application and CV – we look forward to hearing from you!

Start date: 1 st september

Ketä haemme?

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia useille työmaille pääkaupunkiseudulle! Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

Mitä työ sisältää?

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen niin kauan, kun työmaa on olemassa. Liikenteenohjauksessa työskennellään useimmiten pareittain ja ohjataan liikennettä vuorotellen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

Mitä vaaditaan?

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky Sinulla tulee olla vähintään AM121 tai B-luokan ajokortti Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

Koulutamme ja perehdytämme sinut tehtävään alla olevien koulutusten avulla:

Tieturva 1-koulutus

Työturvallisuuskoulutus

Liikenteenohjaajan pätevyys

Palkkaa maksamme Asfalttialan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaisesti. Sen lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle: Turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Laadukkaat työvälineet ja -varusteet

Reilun ja tasapuolisen kohtelun

Vaihtelevia työmaita ja työpäiviä

Mahdollisuuden edetä uralla sekä Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

jobs.title: Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner to shape St1's CRM approach and deliver the Salesforce-based solutions that support our sales, customer service, and business operations. This role sits where business needs meet technical delivery: you make sure what we build is scalable, secure, and actually adopted by the people who use it.

A big part of the role is partnering with business teams who are actively developing their digital ways of working. You act as a trusted advisor, drawing on experience from multiple Salesforce implementations to guide teams, introduce best practices, and drive real process change and adoption, not just deliver features.

You work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and administrators, translating requirements into a prioritized backlog and actionable solutions. This is a hands-on role: it combines business analysis with real configuration work in Salesforce, so you are as comfortable writing a user story as you are building in the platform.

How youll help drive the change

Joining St1, youll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner, youll play a key role in

Product Strategy & Vision

Define and communicate the roadmap for Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud capabilities.

Align platform initiatives with business objectives and customer experience goals.

Continuously evaluate new Salesforce features and innovations for business value.

Backlog & Requirements Management

Own and maintain the Sales & Service product backlog.

Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements.

Translate business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep backlog items well-defined and ready for development.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance on Salesforce architecture, integrations, and configurations.

Partner with architects and developers to design scalable, secure solutions, and review designs against best practices and enterprise standards.

Configure Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud hands-on where needed.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Act as the primary liaison between business users, Business Technology, and external vendor teams.

Design and facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and process improvements that help business teams build confidence and capability.

Manage expectations and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.

Partner with business leads to drive user adoption: coaching teams through change, addressing resistance, and building long-term ownership of new ways of working.

Share insights and best practices from prior implementations to help the business make informed decisions and avoid common pitfalls.

Platform Governance & Quality

Ensure compliance with security, data, and governance standards.

Promote best practices for development, documentation, and deployment.

What you bring to the team

Were looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have:

5+ years of experience working with Salesforce platforms, including 3+ years in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, or Technical Lead role.

Proven hands-on experience configuring Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud.

Strong understanding of CRM, sales operations, and customer service processes.

Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and process adoption in environments with varying levels of digital maturity.

Track record of delivering Salesforce implementations across multiple organizations, with the ability to bring cross-industry best practices to new contexts.

A bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have: Salesforce certifications (e.g. Administrator, Platform Developer, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant), experience with Einstein or Agentforce, and experience in large-scale, highly integrated environments.

Who are we looking for

We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. We value people who are curious, commercial, committed and caring, and who thrive in collaborative, fast-changing environments.

Why Join St1?

- Shape St1s CRM vision and create tangible impact across sales and customer service.
- Blend business insight with hands-on design and delivery.
- Influence how teams adopt modern digital ways of working.
- Develop into Salesforce architecture, AI-powered CRM, or product leadership.
- Helsinki or Stockholm base, with excellent social benefits.
- Work in a high-performing Nordic tech organisation built on trust and responsibility.

How we support your journey

At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where youre respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture - and a business that never stands still - theres room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries.

Youll have real ownership of St1's CRM platform and how it's used, working with a wide range of teams; backed by competitive pay, a bonus scheme and genuine opportunities to grow your career.

If youd like to explore more about our culture, visit our career site.

What to expect after you apply

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and equitable recruitment process.

Interested? Send us your CV and cover letter via the Barona Career site no later than Thursday, 14 August 2026. For more information, please reach out to us during the August calling times: Tuesday, 4 of August or Thursday, 6 August 2026 between noon and 2 pm.

Contact person is Baronas Recruitment Team Lead Lassi Jyrinsalo via email at lassi.jyrinsalo@barona.fi.

Lets challenge the ordinary!

jobs.title: Technical Account Associate
jobs.description:
Company Description

International Flight Support (IFS) builds smart, stable, and customer-focused software for the aviation industry. Our platform helps airline operators digitise flight operations, reducing workload, improving compliance, and enabling seamless coordination between pilots and back-office staff.

We are a team of 17 with diverse international backgrounds, headquartered in Copenhagen and serving a growing global customer base. We care about product quality, practical innovation, and long-term partnerships. Our working language is English.

Job Description

We're looking for a technically-minded customer success professional to join a small, committed team where your work has real impact. You'll own the full support journey for our B2B accounts, from first contact through to resolution,  while building lasting relationships and working closely with engineers, product leaders, and aviation professionals.

Qualifications

What You'll Do

  • Handle and resolve customer technical support requests, managing cases from first contact through to resolution

  • Be the go-to person for customers on technical queries, coordinating internally and keeping customers informed throughout

  • Proactively reach out to customers to anticipate needs, follow up on open items, and maintain strong relationships

  • Monitor account health and flag risks, opportunities, or recurring issues

  • Handle customer onboarding through project implementation, helping new accounts get set up and comfortable with our tools

  • Work closely with internal teams,  product, development, and sales,  to relay customer feedback and help prioritise cases

  • Help maintain support documentation and contribute to a knowledge base that improves team efficiency

 

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in technical support, customer success, or account management in a B2B environment

  • A strong service mindset: you take ownership, follow through, and genuinely care about the customer experience

  • Comfortable with operating within technical environments, systems, integrations, and data flows, and able to translate complexity into clear communication

  • Proactive and commercially aware: you understand the link between customer satisfaction and business outcomes

  • Organised and structured, with the ability to manage multiple accounts or workstreams simultaneously

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, but equally able to work autonomously and take initiative

  • Based in Copenhagen or willing to relocate; this is primarily an on-site role with some flexibility to work from home

  • Bonus: experience in aviation, MRO, logistics, or another technical or regulated industry

Additional Information

Why Join IFS

  • Be part of a small, committed team where your work has real impact

  • Work closely with engineers, product leaders, and aviation professionals

  • Contribute to building tools used by real people in critical operations

  • Based in the heart of Copenhagen, with work-from-home flexibility

  • Competitive benefits: additional healthcare insurance and pension

  • Free office lunch, snacks, and soft drinks

  • Dedicated growth days for personal and professional development

  • Plus, did you ever dream of flying in the cockpit? At IFS, that dream might just come true

jobs.title: Barselsvikar for organist, Bolbro kirke
jobs.description:
Barselsvikariat ved Bolbro Kirke

 

En stilling som barselsvikar for organisten ved Bolbro Kirke er ledig pr. 1. oktober 2026.

Bolbro Sogn har 9.259 folkekirkemedlemmer. Der er ansat 3 præster, 2 kordegne og

2 kirketjenere.

 

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge.

 

Arbejdsopgaverne omfatter:

 

·        Forestå orgelspil, instrumental musikledsagelse af liturgi og menighedssang ved          gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og andre aktiviteter, såvel i som uden for kirken. Herunder på lokale plejehjem og Kirkegårdskapellet.

·        Forestå ledelse af et højmessekor bestående af 6 korister.

·        Forestå arrangementer med musikalske indslag i sognehuset.

·        Deltage i vores aktivitetsudvalg i tæt samarbejde med kirkens præster og menighedsråd.

·        Føre tilsyn med orglet og kirkens øvrige musikinventar.

 

 

Vi tilbyder:

 

·        Et alsidigt job med mulighed for selv at sætte sit præg på indholdet.

·        Et job i et aktivt sogn som er i vækst – hvor der bygges mange nye boliger.

·        Et job i et sogn med en stor mangfoldig menighed, som vi gerne vil give et godt kirkeligt tilbud.

·        Et job med dygtige og engagerede præster og kolleger, hvor der er et godt arbejdsmiljø.

·        Et godt orgel og et godt klaver.

·        Mulighed for selv at ansætte korister og dermed præge det musikalske udtryk.

·        Egen kontorarbejdsplads.

·        Et synligt menighedsråd, som er åbent for nye idéer og har tiltro til medarbejderne.

 

Vi forventer:

 

·        At du er uddannet organist (DOKS) eller KMOK/PO-organist.

·        Er imødekommende og har gode samarbejdsevner, samt har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker i alle aldre.

·        At du har vid erfaring i det klassiske orgelrepertoire, nye klassiske salmer og er fortrolig

med det rytmiske salmerepertoire.

 

Kirkens orgel:

 

Orglet i Bolbro Kirke er bygget af Marcussen & Søn i Aabenraa i 1963. Det har 16 stemmer, to manualer og pedal, og orglets facade er tegnet af arkitekt Ebbe Lehn Petersen. Derudover er der to klaverer.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker ved Bolbro Menighedsråd, Stadionvej 68, 5200 Odense V.

Ansættelse af en kirkemusiker vil være omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og CO10 og organisationsaftale mellem By, Land- og Kirkeministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganistionen af 2010 for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som henholdsvis kordegn, kirke- og kulturmedarbejder eller kirkemusiker og det tilhørende protokollat for kirkemusikere.

 

 

Ansættelsen af en organist med eksamen som ”Kirkemusiker med Orgel og Korledelse” eller en organist med PO-eksamen er omfattet af Overenskomst mellem By,- Land- og Kirkeministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010.

 

Organister med en kirkemusikalsk kandidat- eller bacheloruddannelse er omfattet af protokollat til akademikeroverenskomsten om overenskomstansættelse af DOKS-organister og faste lærere på kirkemusikskolerne indgået mellem Akademikerne og By-, Land- og Kirkeministeriet.

 

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk

 

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte organister har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen. OBS: DER KAN IKKE SKE TJENESTEMANDSANSÆTTELSE VED VIKAR - ELLER MIDLERTIDIG ANSÆTTELSE.

 

Årslønnen for en kirkemusiker aftales indenfor intervallet 331.619,- kr. – 472.557,- kr. (nutidskroner). Der er ikke rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 27.465,- kr. (nutidskroner).

 

OK tillæg på 1075,- kr. (nutidskroner).

 

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Dansk Kirkemusiker Forening inden ansættelsen.

 

 

Årslønnen for ansøgere med en kirkemusikalsk kandidateksamen (DOKS) aftales i henhold til ny løn-AC-skalaen. Det vil sige en bruttoløn mellem 360.853,- kr. – 439.707,- kr. årligt (nutidskroner).

 

Der er knyttet rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt mellem 46.428,- kr. – 72.109,- kr. (nutidskroner). Indplacering og rådighedstillæg ydes efter anciennitet. Derudover kan der efter lokal forhandling ydes kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg.

 

Årslønnen for ansøgere med kirkemusiker med uddannelse i orgel og korledelse (tidligere PO-organister) aftales i henhold til det aftalte basisløntrinssystem. Basistrin 1 udgør kr. 348.201,- kr. årligt (nutidskroner) og basisløntrin 2 udgør kr. 365.841,- kr. årligt (nutidskroner). Indplacering sker efter anciennitet.

 

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 29.476,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 1 kirke/37.699,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 2-3 kirker/44.657,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 4 til 6 kirker/51.488,- kr. (nutidskroner) for tjeneste ved 7 eller flere kirker (vælg det relevante rådighedstillæg).

 

Løn, OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

 

Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet referencer og børneattest ved ansættelsen.

 

Interesseret?

 

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til organist Lene Holst Henriksen, tlf. 23 66 63 92, mail: lene-hh@hotmail.com, Bolbro Sogns menighedsrådsformand Karin Wermuth, tlf. 31 23 37 35, mail: karinwermuth1973@gmail.com eller

kontaktperson Anita Hennild, tlf. 51 41 88 18, mail: abmo@km.dk.

 

Ansøgningen med relevante bilag sendes til Bolbro menighedsråd: 7776fortrolig@sogn.dk

Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde senest den 27. august 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler samt prøvespil forventes at finde sted den 7. september 2026 i Bolbro Kirke.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We’re Hiring: R&D Software Engineer | Hitachi Energy Do you want to develop software that helps power some of the world's most critical energy infrastructure? Join the MACH Infrastructure & Tools team at Hitachi Energy and work at the intersection of software engineering, industrial automation, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. You'll be part of a collaborative engineering team developing and evolving a strategically important in-house application used across our HVDC business. Unlike many corporate software roles, you'll have the opportunity to work across the complete software lifecycle and gain real ownership from day one.

This role offers the opportunity to work on software that directly supports critical infrastructure, contributing to solutions that have a real impact on the reliability and security of essential systems. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers and technical specialists, gaining valuable insights and hands-on experience in industrial digitalization, operational technology (OT) environments, networking, and cybersecurity.

Working in a quality-focused engineering environment, you'll leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to design and deliver innovative solutions. The position also provides excellent opportunities for professional growth, with potential career paths leading to roles such as Technical Lead, Product Owner, or Design Architect.

How you’ll make an impact

    Design, develop, test, and maintain industrial software applications using C#, .NET and Python technologies.
    Collaborate with architects, project managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
    Support continuous improvement of software development processes, quality standards, and engineering practices
    Contribute to reliability, cybersecurity, and long-term maintainability of software supporting critical infrastructure solutions.
    Participate in technical investigations, troubleshooting activities, and feature development across the software lifecycle.
    Build technical ownership of strategic applications and help drive future product and platform evolution.

Your background

    B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
    Experience with software development using C#, .NET and/or Python.
    Knowledge of desktop application development; experience with MVVM architecture is considered an advantage.
    Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn new technologies and domains.
    Collaborative and self-driven personality with a high degree of ownership and accountability
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; Swedish is considered an advantage.

What we offer

    Collective agreement

    Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
    Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
    Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

More about us

jobs.description:
Your New Role

We are looking for a curious and detail-oriented QA Tester to join an innovative team working with hardware integrations and connected devices. You will play an important role in ensuring that devices running digital integrations provide a high-quality user experience.

Your responsibilities will include setting up new devices and companion apps, executing manual and exploratory tests, writing clear and reproducible bug reports, and maintaining test cases as software and integrations evolve. You will also perform regression testing following fixes and new releases, summarise test results, and communicate with external partners regarding certification outcomes and next steps. In addition, you will help identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to testing processes.

The position can be offered as either one full-time assignment or two part-time positions, making it particularly suitable for students looking to combine work with their studies.

Company Presentation

Our client is a globally recognised technology and entertainment company operating at the forefront of digital products and services. The company develops innovative solutions used by millions of people worldwide and collaborates with partners to deliver seamless experiences across a wide range of devices and platforms. You will join a collaborative and international environment where quality, curiosity and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Good to Know

Scope of employment: 50–100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters Working model: On-site in Stockholm Salary: According to agreement Start date: As agreed End date: 6-month contract, with possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client

To succeed in this role, you will need:

    

Technical education or equivalent technical knowledge

    

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

    

A curious, structured and detail-oriented approach

    

Good problem-solving skills and an ability to work collaboratively

    

Initiative and willingness to identify and drive improvements

    

Ability to work on-site in Stockholm and flexibility regarding working hours

What we Offer

    

Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

    

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex

    

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

    

Additional compensation during parental leave

    

Occupational health services

    

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

    

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application

We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

jobs.title: Guide
jobs.description:
Activity Guide

We are now looking for an **Activity Guide** to join our team. In this role, you will be at the heart of our international activity operations – safely guiding our guests through unique nature experiences and contributing to the development of our activity services.

What we offer

- Meaningful work with one of the pioneers of tourism in Lapland, where sustainability and quality are at the heart of everything we do.

- An inspiring working environment: in your free time, you can enjoy the peace and beauty of Laplands nature – skiing, hiking, fishing or watching the Northern Lights.

- The support of an encouraging work community: you will work in an international environment with the warm and relaxed atmosphere of a family-owned company.

- A wide range of staff benefits and opportunities for personal and professional development.

- Staff accommodation can be arranged if needed.


Your responsibilities

- Safely and professionally guiding guests on a variety of activities, such as snowshoeing, snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights excursions and ice fishing.

- Ensuring excellent guest experiences through warm, clear communication and professional service.

- Preparing equipment and maintaining activity areas.

- Working in the equipment storage and service area.

- Following safety guidelines and company procedures.

- Supporting the development of activity products and daily operations.

- Reporting to the Activity Manager.


Who are we looking for?

You are responsible, proactive and passionate about the outdoors and customer service. You enjoy seasonal work where no two days are exactly the same and thrive in an international environment.

You have:

- Solid experience in guiding or outdoor activities; previous experience in Lapland is considered an advantage.

- Good physical fitness and a safety-first mindset.

- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

- Excellent communication and customer service skills.

- Fluency in English; other language skills, such as Finnish, German or French, are considered an advantage.

- A valid Category B driving licence.

- A willingness to learn and develop your skills.


Ready for an adventure?

If you have a passion for nature, adventure and creating unforgettable guest experiences, you might be the person we are looking for.

**Start date:** Late November.

If this sounds like you and you are interested in joining our team, send us your application and CV. We would love to hear from you!

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris is a family-owned pioneer of tourism in Lapland, located in Muonio in Fell Lapland, close to the Swedish border. Founded in 1973 as a camping and caravan site on the banks of the Tornio–Muonio River, Europes longest free-flowing river, Harriniva has grown into three full-service resorts surrounded by the pristine nature of Lapland.

Today, Harriniva Hotels & Safaris consists of **Harriniva Adventure Resort**, **Jeris Lakeside Resort** and **Torassieppi Eco Reindeer Resort**.

Every day, our team works to deliver on our promise: **Best in Wilderness**. At Harriniva, we do our utmost to ensure that every guest experiences the unique nature of Lapland in an unforgettable way – taking home lasting memories and the feeling of being at their best in the wilderness.

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Riehen liegt als Gemeinde im Kanton Basel-Stadt an der Grenze zu Frankreich und Deutschland. Sie profitieren von einer hervorragenden Verkehrsanbindung durch mehrere Tramlinien und Busverbindungen zum Basler Zentrum. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit guter Erreichbarkeit, vielfältigen Dienstleistungen und der Nähe zu internationalen Märkten, was Riehen zu einem geschätzten Arbeitsort macht.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Betreuung in Riehen

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Betreuung

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Betreuung in Riehen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Riehen verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmännern in Langzeitpflege und Spitälern. Ihre Abschlüsse HF oder FH eröffnen Ihnen ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem lokalen Arbeitsmarkt mit attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler mit umfassender Marktkenntnis und etablierten Kontakten zu renommierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, wodurch sich Ihr Einstieg erheblich vereinfacht.

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Betreuung in Riehen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

Il contributo che può dare  
In qualità di responsabile dell'informazione della Cancelleria federale, è chiamato/a a dirigere la Divisione comunicazione, composta da varie sezioni e una quarantina di collaboratori, e ne assumerà la gestione strategica e operativa sotto il profilo del personale, tecnico, dei contenuti, organizzativo e finanziario  
Sarà subordinato/a alla vicecancelliera e portavoce del Consiglio federale, che supporterà nel suo compito di gestire la comunicazione del Consiglio federale in ogni circostanza e di coordinarla con i dipartimenti  
È responsabile della comunicazione della Cancelleria federale  
Su incarico della portavoce del Consiglio federale, farà in modo di garantire, nel rispetto degli standard di qualità e delle scadenze previste, la gestione e lo sviluppo strategico dell'offerta informativa per il Consiglio federale, la Cancelleria federale e la comunicazione delle autorità sul sito  
In questo contesto, si occuperà anche delle opportunità e dei rischi che le nuove tecnologie comportano per la comunicazione istituzionale  
Quale sostituto/a della portavoce del Consiglio federale, la rappresenterà in sua assenza a tutti gli effetti nell'esercizio delle sue funzioni durante le sedute del Consiglio federale o in altri organismi  
Che cosa La contraddistingue  
Diploma universitario in comunicazione o in un altro settore attinente alla funzione, esperienza pluriennale in ruoli dirigenziali di un livello di pari responsabilità  
Esperienza pluriennale nella comunicazione istituzionale o aziendale, preferibilmente in ambito politico  
Eccellenti doti comunicative a livello orale e scritto, capacità di esprimersi in pubblico con disinvoltura  
Profonda conoscenza delle dinamiche che regolano l'interazione tra politica, mass media e opinione pubblica  
Attitudine alla diplomazia, alta motivazione e disponibilità  
Ottima conoscenza attiva di due lingue ufficiali e dell'inglese, conoscenza almeno passiva della terza lingua ufficiale  
In sintesi  
Che cosa offriamo  
Lavorare per la Svizzera Ci adoperiamo per il modello di successo svizzero e lavoriamo per il benessere della popolazione.  
Vivere la diversità La concretizzazione delle pari opportunità ci consente di esprimere al meglio le nostre competenze e di contemplare punti di vista differenti.  
In forma sul posto di lavoro Forniamo supporto e consulenza alle nostre collaboratrici e ai nostri collaboratori sulla tematica della salute fisica e mentale.  
Tutti i benefit  
Cancelleria federale – lo stato maggiore del Consiglio federale  
La Cancelleria federale è lo Stato maggiore del Consiglio federale e lo assiste nella preparazione e nello svolgimento delle sue riunioni nonché nei relativi lavori successivi. Gestisce e coordina la comunicazione del Governo e ne elabora la pianificazione politica. Organizza gli eventi ai quali il Consiglio federale partecipa in corpore e assiste il presidente della Confederazione nell'esercizio della sua funzione. La Cancelleria federale organizza inoltre le votazioni e le elezioni a livello federale. Assicura i contatti con i comitati d'iniziativa e referendari e verifica la riuscita formale di domande di referendum e iniziative popolari. Infine, la Cancelleria federale sostiene e coordina la trasformazione digitale dell'Amministrazione federale.

Nicole Lamon vicecancelliera e portavoce del Consiglio federale

Mellingen liegt zentral im Kanton Aargau und ist durch ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindungen charakterisiert, insbesondere die Nähe zur Autobahn A1 und gute Bahnverbindungen. Die Gemeinde besticht durch ihre Lage zwischen Zürich und Bern, was Sie beruflich und privat flexibel macht. Zudem bietet die Region ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld mit guter Infrastruktur und Nähe zur Natur, wodurch Mellingen für viele Arbeitnehmer ein attraktiver Wirtschaftsstandort ist.

### Ihr Wirkungsfeld als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Mellingen

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Stv. Stationsleitung

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Mellingen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Mellingen verzeichnet eine konstant hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern, insbesondere für Positionen als stellvertretende Stationsleitungen in Spitälern und Pflegeinstitutionen. Die Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt sind ausgezeichnet, da der Fachkräftemangel im Gesundheitswesen Sie als erfahrene Fachperson sehr gefragt macht. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler mit umfassender Kenntnis der regionalen Arbeitgeber und erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch massgeschneiderte Positionen, die zu Ihren beruflichen Zielen und persönlichen Anforderungen passen.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Stationsleitung in Mellingen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Test Engineer – SiC/Si 80–100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our Product Evaluation & Qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg, where we ensure the highest quality and reliability standards for next-generation semiconductor chips and power modules.

Our products play a critical role in enabling renewable energy, eMobility, traction, and industrial applications world-wide. As we continue to expand our testing capabilities, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Senior R&D Test Engineer to support the development and qualification of innovative Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Silicon (Si) tech-nologies.

In this role, you will work at the interface of R&D, product engineering, and testing, helping bring advanced semi-conductor technologies from development to industrialization.

How you’ll make an impact

Contribute to the development and qualification of next-generation Silicon Carbide (SiC) and Silicon (Si) semicon-ductor devices for power module applications
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across R&D Design, Process Development, and Product Engineer-ing to evaluate the performance and reliability of new technologies
Plan, execute, and monitor electrical and reliability tests using advanced test equipment and methodologies
Analyze test data, identify trends and root causes, and provide technical recommendations to support product de-velopment decisions.
Prepare and present test reports, communicating key findings and risks to project stakeholders
Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the testing laboratory, enhancing efficiency, quality, and testing ca-pabilities
Enure compliance with safety, environmental, cleanliness, and laboratory operating standards in all testing activities

Your background

Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field
Several years of experience in the semiconductor, power electronics, or related industry, ideally within electrical testing, validation, or reliability engineering
Strong understanding of semiconductor devices, particularly Silicon Carbide (SiC) and/or Silicon (Si) technologies
Experience with test systems, measurement equipment, and data analysis methodologies
Programming or automation skills are highly desirable, preferably in Python, LabVIEW, or similar tools
Experience with statistical data analysis and engineering software tools; CAD knowledge is considered a plus
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured and collaborative working style
Fluent in English; German is an advantage

More about us

The opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor technologies that enable the global energy transition
Collaboration with highly skilled experts in an international and innovative environment
Challenging projects with real impact on future power electronics solutions
Flexible working arrangements and attractive development opportunities within a global technology leader

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Pfäffikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Dipl. Pflegefachfrauen und -männer HF/FH in der Langzeitpflege rund um Pfäffikon ist derzeit sehr angespannt, da Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich stark nachgefragt werden und qualifizierte Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten rar sind. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf interessante Positionen mit stabilen Arbeitsverhältnissen und fairen Löhnen in etablierten Pflegeinstitutionen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie dabei, den passenden Arbeitgeber zu finden und vermittelt Sie gezielt in Stellen, die zu Ihren Qualifikationen und Ihrem Pensum passen, wodurch Ihr Einstieg in der Region wesentlich erleichtert wird.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Pfäffikon

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Pfäffikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

modene Büroräumlichkeiten, smart working.
flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und Arbeitsorte.

Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.  
Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.  
Deine Herausforderung  
Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.  
Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.  
Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.  
Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.  
Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.  
Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.  
Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.  
Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.  
Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen  
Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld  
Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)  
Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab  
Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein  
Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.  
In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher

Illnau-Effretikon liegt in der Zürcher Landschaft und bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Arbeitsumgebung mit guter Infrastruktur. Die Region ist dank der S-Bahn-Anbindung schnell mit Zürich verbunden und besticht durch ihre Nähe zu Natur und Erholungsräumen. ### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Mit Ihrer Qualifikation auf HF/FH-Niveau eröffnen sich Ihnen ausgezeichnete Chancen auf dem lokalen Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere in Alters- und Pflegeheimen sowie Spitälern. iPersonal vereinfacht Ihren Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung, fundierte Kenntnisse des regionalen Marktes und die Begleitung beim Bewerbungsprozess, sodass Sie schnell eine passende Führungsposition finden.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Gruppenleitung in Illnau-Effretikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.
