jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju čl. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23) Dječji vrtić „Bajka“ objavljuje

N A T J E Č A J ODGOJITELJ/ICA - 3 izvršitelja/ice - na određeno vrijeme - puno radno vrijeme - zamjena;

UVJETI za radno mjesto su: - prema čl. 24. i čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (Narodne novine, broj: 145/24).; Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti: - životopis (vlastoručno potpisan, preslika) - dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (preslika) - dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika) - potvrda o podacima (o stažu) evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (podiže se u poslovnicama HZMO-a na šalteru) ili elektronički zapis Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje-a (e-radna knjižica koja se preuzima putem e-građani), ne starije od dana objave natječaja - uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela navedenih u čl.25.st.1. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97,107/07, 94/13, 98/19,57/22, 101/23) - ne starije od dana objave natječaja -uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neki od prekršaja navedenih u čl.25. st.4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“ 10/97,107/07 94/13, 98/19,57/22, 101/23), ne starije od dana objave natječaja.

Na natječaj se pod ravnopravnim uvjetima mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Izrazi navedeni u natječaju u muškom rodu neutralni su, a odnose se na osobe oba spola. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na druge kandidate/kinje pod jednakim uvjetima.

Sukladno odredbi članka 103. stavak 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihove obitelji (NN 121/17) u nastavku je poveznica na dokaze koje kandidati/kinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti trebaju priložiti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na sljedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokumentaciju (dokaze) propisanu člankom 49. stavkom 1 istog Zakona. U nastavku je poveznica na dokaze koje kandidati/kinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti trebaju priložiti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe sa invaliditetom.

PODACI O PLAĆI: Plaća se sastoji od osnovne plaće, dodataka te ostalih primitaka u skladu sa Zakonom o radu (,,Narodne novine”, broj: 93/14., 127/17., 98/19., 151/22., 46/23. i 64/23.) i Kolektivnim ugovorom za zaposlene u predškolskim ustanovama Grada Zagreba (Službeni glasnik Grada Zagreba 40/22., 14/23., 15/23., 1/24., 26/24., 40/24. - ispravak, 41/24., 2/25., 13/25., 44/25. i 6/26. – u daljnjem tekstu: Kolektivni ugovor). Osnovna bruto plaća radnika za puno radno vrijeme i uobičajeni učinak predstavlja umnožak osnovice za izračun plaće i koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojem radnik radi, uvećan za iznos dodatka na radni staž. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Koeficijent za obračun plaće utvrđen je Kolektivnim ugovorom te iznosi: ODGOJITELJ VSS 2,14 ODGOJITELJ VŠS 2,10 • Odgojitelju koji nema položen stručni ispit koeficijent složenosti poslova radnog mjesta umanjuje se za 10%. (osim ako je oslobođen obveze polaganja stručnog ispita sukladno propisima) • Ako se radni odnos zasniva s osobom koja ne ispunjava propisane uvjete za radno mjesto, utvrđeni koeficijent složenosti poslova za to radno mjesto umanjuje se za 12%. • Koeficijent složenosti poslova povećava se sukladno stečenom zvanju mentora, savjetnika ili izvrsnog savjetnika: za zvanje mentora 10%, za zvanje savjetnika 20% i za zvanje izvrsnog savjetnika 30% • Osnovna plaća uvećat će se za završen poslijediplomski ili doktorski studij: 1. ako radnik ima stručni naziv magistar (mr.), odnosno akademski naziv specijalist (spec.) ili sveučilišni specijalist (univ. spec.), za 5 %, 2. ako radnik ima akademski stupanj magistra znanosti (mr. sc.), za 8 %, 3. ako radnik ima akademski stupanj doktora znanosti (dr. sc.), za 15 %, ako akademski stupanj, stručni odnosno akademski naziv nije uvjet za radno mjesto na kojem radnik radi i ako je akademski stupanj, stručni odnosno akademski naziv, u funkciji poslova radnog mjesta na kojem radnik radi, odnosno razvoja predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja.

Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podataka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravovremenu i urednu prijavu sa svim prilozima te koja ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objavljivanja natječaja.

Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Bajka, Zagreb, Zorkovačka 8 sa napomenom „Za natječaj – odgojitelj na određeno vrijeme, zamjena“.

U roku od 8 dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru, obavijest o izabranom kandidatu, objavit će se na oglasnoj ploči i mrežnoj stranici Vrtića.

Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog Zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića „Bajka“ dana 11.08.2026. godine do 19.08.2026. godine.

jobs.title: MEDICINSKI FIZIČAR/MEDICINSKA FIZIČARKA U PROCESU DIJAGNOSTIKE I LIJEČENJA 1
jobs.description:
Na temelju odluke ravnateljice KBC-a Rijeka izv.prof.prim.dr.sc. Alemke Brnčić-Fischer, dr.med., od 07. kolovoza 2026. godine i suglasnosti Ministarstva zdravstva, klasa: 100-01/26-03/129, urbroj: 534-03-2-2/26-46 od 13. ožujka 2026. godine raspisuje se; NATJEČAJ za prijam u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme Medicinski fizičar koji sudjeluje u procesu dijagnostike i liječenja 1 /magistra fizike-fizičara u Zavodu za medicinsku fiziku i zaštitu od zračenja - 2 izvršitelja Uvjeti:
  • VSS
  • Sveučilišni diplomski studij fizike
Uz prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti;
  • zamolbu i životopis
  • presliku Diplome o stečenom obrazovanju
  • potvrdu o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis HZMO o radnom iskustvu)
  • dokaz o državljanstvu
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (uvjerenje nestarije od tri (3) mjeseca)
Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz uvjet probnog rada. Klinički bolnički centar Rijeka pridržava pravo dodatnih testiranja. Prema Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08, 125/11, 20/12, 138/12, 69/17), na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Prijave kandidata podnose se u roku od 8 dana od objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama na adresu: Klinički bolnički centar Rijeka, Rijeka, Krešimirova 42, pismenim putem ili osobno u Pisarnici KBC-a Rijeka (prizemlje zgrade Ravnateljstva). Osobe koje prema posebnim propisima ostvaraju pravo prednosti kod zapošljavanja, moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, uz prijavu priložiti dokaze iz kojih je vidljiva osnova ostvarivanja prava prednosti te svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Pozivaju se osobe iz članka 102. stavka 1.-3. Zakona o pravima hrvatskih branitelja iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21) dostaviti dokaze iz članka 103. stavka 1. istoga Zakona u svrhu ostvarivanja prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokumenata potrebnih za ostvarivanje prednosti pri zapošljavanju dostupni su na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Pozivaju se kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21) da dostave dokaze iz članka 49. navedenog Zakona u svrhu ostvarivanja prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokumenata potrebnih za ostvarivanje prednosti pri zapošljavanju dostupni su na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pristupnici koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno Zakonu o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 38/18, 32/20), dužni su se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom (NN 75/18). KBC Rijeka dostavljene podatke pristupnika obrađuje u skladu sa odredbama pozitivnih propisa koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podatka. Dostavljeni podaci obrađivat će se u svrhu provođenja natječaja radi zasnivanja radnog odnosa i u druge se svrhe neće koristiti. KBC Rijeka pridržava pravo, djelomično ili u cijelosti, u svako vrijeme poništiti ovaj natječaj, odnosno ne donijeti odluku o izboru kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. Odluke o izabranom kandidatu javno će biti objavljene na internetskoj stranici Kliničkog bolničkog centra Rijeka – www.kbc-rijeka.hr. Nepravovremene prijave i prijave s nepotpunom dokumentacijom, izuzet će se iz razmatranja a natječajna dokumentacija biti će vraćena kandidatima. Pristupnici su dužni dostaviti elektronsku adresu zbog nesmetane korespondencije u svrhu pravovremenog i nesmetanog odvijanja postupka provođenja natječaja. Kandidati su dužni pratiti svoju elektronsku poštu i odgovoriti na sve primljene e-mail poruke. Opis poslova:
  • sudjeluje u aktivnostima Zavoda vezanim za primjenu fizike u medicini
  • provodi zakonom propisana redovita godišnja ispitivanja rada uređaja koji proizvode ili u radu koriste ionizirajuće zračenje
  • provodi usporedna umjeravanja detektora ionizirajućeg zračenja
  • sudjeluje u znanstvenim i stručnim istraživanjima u svrhu unaprjeđenja postojećih fizikalnih metoda vezanih za medicinske procedure dijagnostike i liječenja u KBC Rijeka
  • sudjeluje u provedbi projekata vezanih za primjenu fizike u medicini koji se provode na Zavodu sudjeluje u osmišljavanju i provedbi edukacije novozaposlenih fizičara
  • obavlja i druge poslove iz djelokruga svog rada i po nalogu neposredno pretpostavljenog
  • odgovoran je za pravovremenu dostavu odobrenja za rad/obnovu odobrenja za rad službi KBC Rijeka odgovornoj za ljudske resurse, ukoliko je ista preduvjet za rad
  • obavlja poslove primjene fizike u medicini tipične za područje u kojem djeluje:
  • radijacijska onkologija
  • provedba mjerenja fizikalnih veličina u svrhu određivanja apsorbirane doze i dozimetrijskih parametara kojima su definirani snopovi X-zraka
  • provedba procedura osiguranja i kontrole kvalitete rada uređaja koji proizvode snopove X-zraka i sustava u radijacijskoj onkologiji
  • izračun, optimizacija i vrednovanje raspodjela apsorbirane doze pacijenata u radijacijskoj onkologiji
  • razvoj i primjena fizikalnog dijela metoda i postupaka koji imaju primjenu u radijacijskoj onkologiji
  • razumijevanje i primjena koncepata zaštite od ionizirajućeg zračenja tipičnih za radijacijsku onkologiju
  • primjena umjetne inteligencije u radijacijskoj onkologiji o Dijagnostička i intervencijska radiologija
  • provedba procedura osiguranja i kontrole kvalitete rada uređaja koji proizvode snopove X-zraka i sustava u dijagnostičkoj i intervencijskoj radiologiji
  • dozimetrija snopova X-zraka koji se koriste u dijagnostičkoj i intervencijskoj radiologiji
  • provedba procedura više razine osiguranja i kontrole kvalitete rada uređaja za oslikavanje nuklearnom magnetskom rezonancijom
  • razvoj i primjena modela za naknadnu obradu slikovnih podataka (image processing)
  • primjena umjetne inteligencije u dijagnostičkoj radiologiji
  • razumijevanje i primjena koncepata zaštite od ionizirajućeg zračenja tipičnih za dijagnostičku i intervencijsku radiologiju

jobs.title: Nurse (Poland) (Krankenschwester/-pfleger)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Nurse

Stellenbeschreibung:
Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

Key responsibilities

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English
- Own a car and have a clean license
- Passionate about international healthcare

Benefits

- 15,900 PLN car allowance per annum
- 2,400 PLN home allowance per annum
- Structured career development track, with opportunities for progression and advancement
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to thrive in a global environment
- We celebrate diversity on a global scale and encourage every colleague to bring their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion and equal support

At International SOS, we offer a great working environment, thanks to our commitment to flexible working, diversity, and development.  We encourage every person to be their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion, equality and support.

Seit 25 Jahren begleiten wir als erfolgreiche Vermittlungsagentur Menschen wie Dich dabei, den Arbeitsplatz zu finden, der nicht nur zum Lebenslauf, sondern perfekt zum Leben passt. Für eine renommierte Klinikgruppe in der malerischen Nordschweiz suchen wir genau jetzt Deine Expertise.
Schließe kurz die Augen und stell Dir vor, wie es sich anfühlt, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, in dem Deine Leistung täglich gesehen und honoriert wird. Wir haben aktuell 3 exklusive Vakanzen zu besetzen – eine davon wartet vermutlich genau auf Dich.

High-End-Diagnostik im MRT: Du steuerst modernste MRT-Systeme und meisterst komplexe Fragestellungen mit Leichtigkeit.
Dynamik in der Angiologie: Bei interventionellen Eingriffen und Gefäßdarstellungen bist Du die unverzichtbare rechte Hand des Teams – ruhig, fokussiert und kompetent.
Patienten-Empathie: Du schenkst Menschen in Ausnahmesituationen Sicherheit und das Gefühl, in den besten Händen zu sein.
Warum dieser Schritt Dein Leben verändern wird
Vielleicht hast Du schon länger über die Schweiz nachgedacht. Lass uns gemeinsam hinschauen, was Dich hier wirklich erwartet:
Spürbare Wertschätzung & Spitzen-Gehalt: Schweizer Saläre und hervorragende Sozialleistungen bieten Dir eine finanzielle Freiheit und Sicherheit, die Du so wahrscheinlich noch nicht kennst.
Zeit für das Wesentliche: Ein exzellenter Personalschlüssel sorgt dafür, dass Du Dich wieder voll und ganz auf Deine Patienten und die Bildqualität konzentrieren kannst – ohne permanenten Stress.
Lebensqualität pur: Die Nordschweiz bietet Dir die perfekte Balance. Atemberaubende Natur, die Alpen vor der Haustür und gleichzeitig die unmittelbare Nähe zur deutschen Heimat.
Dein Rundum-Sorglos-Paket: Wir sind an Deiner Seite. Von der SRK-Anerkennung Deines Diploms über die Wohnungssuche bis hin zu allen bürokratischen Schritten – wir halten Dir den Rücken frei.
Das bringst Du mit auf diese Reise:
Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA.
Fundierte, professionelle Erfahrung in den Bereichen MRT und Angiologie/DSA.
Die Bereitschaft, Dich auf ein neues, wertschätzendes System einzulassen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Du musst diesen Weg nicht alleine gehen. Vertraue auf 25 Jahre Erfahrung und ein Netzwerk, das Türen öffnet. Lass uns in einem ganz unverbindlichen, vertraulichen Telefongespräch herausfinden, ob diese Chance Dein Herz höherschlagen lässt.
Mach jetzt den ersten Schritt in Deine neue Freiheit.

jobs.title: Account Manager Executive (German - speaking) -  Remote work in Spain - HE04 (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.
- Lead the solution-building process and engage pooled central inside sales specialists and presales experts when needed.
- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.
- Have analytical mindset to identify key business challenges and propose actionable solutions.
- have ability to manage the end-to-end sales process for transactional and, in selected cases, contractual opportunities.
- Have 1–3 years of relevant industry sales experience.
- Enjoy working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
- Are passionate about technology, customer relationships, and business growth.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**  

- Full-time, permanent contract, 39 hours/week: Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00
- Base salary of 20,976 euros gross/year + up to 7,400 euros gross/year in bonus + private medical insurance
- Location at either our Barcelona, Malaga or Valencia office, or remote from Spain, if you are not based at one of these locations (except Canary Islands)
- Full paid training about the company and the project you will be working on
- Career development program and specialized courses

**Experience the best version of you!**  

At Concentrix, we invest in our game-changers because we know that when our people thrive, our clients and their customers thrive.  

If all this feels like the perfect next step in your career journey, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover why over 440k+ game-changers around the globe call Concentrix their “employer of choice.”  

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer

All our recruitment practices are based on business needs, job requirements, and professional qualifications, without regard to race, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, family or parental status, national origin, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable national laws.*

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. - Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

jobs.title: Senior Professional Data-Engineer (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
who we are At adorsys, we are not just developers and analysts; we are pioneers shaping the digital future for banking and insurance sectors. For over a decade, we have crafted innovative software solutions that grant our clients a decisive edge in their business. We foster an international and agile work environment that thrives on diversity, creativity, and collaboration.
What awaits youWe are looking for experienced Data Engineers to join an international platform team responsible for the infrastructure and data management of intelligent automation services in the finance domain. The services leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning models to generate automated booking proposals from various financial data sources.

The team is currently modernizing its platform to ensure long-term scalability, stability, and performance. By 2026, all core components and data pipelines will be migrated to a modern infrastructure stack based on Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, and other state-of-the-art technologies.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and streaming solutions, ensuring high data quality, governance, and security standards.

Your profile Main Tasks & Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache NiFi.
• Implement and manage data lakehouse structures based on Apache Iceberg, including schema evolution, partitioning, and time travel features.
• Develop and optimize SQL queries and data access layers with Trino, ensuring high performance and reliability.
• Integrate diverse data sources (Kafka, S3, RDBMS, REST APIs, etc.) into unified pipelines.
• Ensure data quality, security, and governance across the data infrastructure.
• Perform performance tuning, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and distributed systems.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data scientists, platform engineers, business stakeholders) to deliver data-driven solutions.
• Document technical designs, concepts, and processes.

Required Skills & Experience
• Proven experience with Apache Iceberg, Apache NiFi, and Trino.
• Understanding and ability to work with Apache Spark code.
• Experience with ETL/ELT processes and integrating APIs.
• Hands-on expertise in real-time streaming with Apache Kafka.
• Strong background in large-scale data processing and distributed systems.
• Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), especially S3, IAM, Glue.
• Programming languages: Python, Java, or Scala.
• Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
• CI/CD & DevOps tools: Git, Jenkins, Terraform, GitHub Actions.
• Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
• Strong knowledge of SQL and performance optimization techniques.

Nice to Have
• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Familiarity with CI/CD automation and Infrastructure as Code.
• Practical knowledge of security configurations in data processing.

Soft Skills
• Structured and solution-oriented working style.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills within interdisciplinary teams.
• Ability to document and explain complex technical processes in a clear manner.

Project Context

The platform team develops and maintains the data infrastructure for automation services in the accounting and finance sector. These services use artificial intelligence to continuously improve booking suggestions based on historical cloud data, ensuring seamless integration into familiar workflows.
To ensure scalability and long-term stability, the platform is being migrated to a new infrastructure (Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, etc.) by 2026. This transformation secures performance, scalability, and future-proof operations.

Why us?We're not just offering a job; we're inviting you to be part of a movement. With us, you'll navigate the exciting terrain of finance and banking and contribute to sustainable financial living. Benefit from a German firm's structure and security, coupled with competitive remuneration and a culture that nurtures growth.

Your contact personLucian Mihaila

About usWe have been developing individual software for banks and insurance companies for more than 10 years. We do this to give our customers a real competitive advantage. Our teams accompany the clients from the first idea to the finished product.
Regardless of whether an existing service needs to be modernized or the solution for a new business model is missing: we develop software for a digital future.

jobs.title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Compliance Officer \- Sanctions  
Building the bank of tomorrow takes more than skills.  
It means combining our differences to imagine, discuss, code, develop, test, learn... and celebrate every step together. Share our vibes? Join Swissquote to unleash your potential.  
We are the Swiss Leader in Online Banking and we provide trading, investing and banking services to\+500'000 clients, through our performant and secured digital platforms.  
Our \+1000 employees work in a flexible way, without dress code and in multicultural teams.  
By having a huge impact on the industry, they are growing their skills portfolio and boosting their career in a fast\-pace environment.  
We are all in at Swissquote. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.  
Are you all in? Don't be shy, apply!  
Compliance Officer \- Sanctions  
Are you eager to take up a new challenge? Join the Compliance Department as a Compliance Officer in the Compliance Support and Sanctions service. You will have multiple tasks and on top of the sanction topics, you will be exposed to a wide range of Compliance activities on the financial security aspect. Your role will include:  
Sanctions:  
Perform sanctions due diligence on clients and related parties during the onboarding phases as well as periodic or ad hoc review phases.  
Perform analysis on true sanctions hits escalated by the Compliance Monitoring as part of the sanction screening done on the client base and on the transactional activity of our clients.  
Assess potential exposure to sectoral sanctions, export controls, dual\-use goods and sanctioned industries  
Provide recommendations regarding acceptance, rejection or escalation of client relationship  
Support and advise other compliance officers on sanction related topics  
Regulatory monitoring on sanction news impacting the bank and analysis of the impact on our client base, and analyse the impact of new sanctions packages.  
Draft and maintain sanctions policies and procedures.  
Participate in the calibration and optimization of sanctions screening systems.

Contribute to the bank's monitoring of risk tolerance, risk analysis and key risk indicators.  
Support ad hoc reporting requests: special requests, audits, regulatory reviews etc.  
Others:  
Provide targeted training on sanctions  
Drafting of internal memos and presentations  
Support and advice to management  
Qualifications  
Expert in Financial Sanction.  
Good knowledge in Swiss banking and financial laws.  
Analytical and methodological approach.  
Very good writing and communication skills in French and English (Other languages is a plus).  
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  
Excellent command of Powerpoint.  
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage high workloads.  
Strong team player who enjoys working in multicultural, dynamic, technological and international environment.  
Background  
Bachelor or Master Degree in Laws or Economics with appetite for data crunching and analysis.  
3 to 5\+ years of experience in the financial industry.

jobs.description:
- Für ein renommiertes Pflegeheim in der Region Worb suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – geregelter Tagdienst mit planbaren Arbeitszeiten.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Worb – die Eckdaten Ihrer Stelle

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

**Pensum:** 50–100 % (flexibel wählbar)

**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung

**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Worb

**Arbeitgeber:** Pflegeheim – den Namen erfahren Sie im Gespräch

Worb liegt in der Region Bern-Mittelland und ist durch die gute Verkehrsanbindung mit Bahn und Strasse leicht erreichbar. Der Ort bietet attraktive Arbeitsplätze in verschiedenen Branchen und überzeugt durch seine Nähe zur Stadt Bern. Sie profitieren von der ländlichen Umgebung mit guter Infrastruktur sowie kurzen Pendeldistanzen.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH im Tagdienst in Worb an

- Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Bedarfserhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Vorbereitung und Abgabe der Medikamente
- Überwachung von Vitalzeichen und frühzeitiges Erkennen von Zustandsveränderungen
- Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden im Team
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen Pflegesystem
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien und Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe
- Darüber hinaus Mitgestaltung von Pflegekonzepten sowie wir verbessern die Qualität stetig im Team
- Teilnahme an interprofessionellen Rapporten und Visiten im geregelten Tagdienst

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Empathie und Belastbarkeit
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Tagdienst im Pflegeheim

Diese Stelle ist im Tagdienst angelegt. Sie arbeiten also in einer klaren Tagesstruktur mit geregelten Übergaben am Morgen und am Abend. Dabei nehmen Sie an Rapporten im Team mit Ärzten und Therapien teil, koordinieren Termine mit Ärzten und Therapeuten und begleiten Angehörigengespräche. Somit verbinden Sie fachliche Verantwortung mit einem planbaren Alltag.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann HF/FH im Tagdienst verbinden Sie fachliche Tiefe mit einem Alltag, der Planung zulässt. Genau deshalb ist die Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH im Tagdienst in Worb bei Berufsleuten mit Familie so beliebt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben zum Beispiel den Pflegebedarf, planen anschliessend die Massnahmen, führen sie durch und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern sie die Medikamentenabgabe, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen im Gesundheitszustand frühzeitig. Dadurch sichern sie die Pflegequalität für jede einzelne Bewohnerin und jeden Bewohner.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die dreijährige höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium in Pflege an einer Fachhochschule (FH). Beide Abschlüsse berechtigen zur eigenverantwortlichen Berufsausübung. Ausländische Diplome benötigen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen attraktive Weiterbildungen offen, etwa ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Funktion als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Worb im Kanton Bern verzeichnet eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern auf Stufe HF/FH. Für Sie als Fachkraft bieten sich hervorragende Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, insbesondere im Bereich flexibler Teilzeitanstellungen zwischen 50 und 100 Prozent. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Personalvermittler bei der Jobsuche und erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch umfassende Beratung und direkten Zugang zu interessanten Positionen in lokalen Gesundheitseinrichtungen.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Worb

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – so wächst Ihre Karriere weiter
- Dazu persönliche Beratung durch Ihre feste Ansprechperson, von der Bewerbung bis zum Stellenantritt
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Ebenso faire, GAV-konforme Anstellungsbedingungen mit transparentem Lohn
- Langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH im Tagdienst in Worb

**Welche Ausbildung benötige ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit einer SRK-Anerkennung ebenfalls willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Arbeite ich in dieser Stelle auch nachts?**
Nein, denn diese Stelle ist bewusst im Tagdienst angelegt. Sie profitieren daher von planbaren Arbeitszeiten mit geregelten Übergaben.

**Kann ich das Pensum frei wählen?**
Ja, denn das Pensum ist zwischen 50 und 100 Prozent flexibel wählbar. Sagen Sie uns einfach, welches Modell zu Ihrem Leben passt.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir dabei streng vertraulich.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Im Inserat verzichten wir jedoch aus Diskretionsgründen darauf.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH im Tagdienst wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Tagdienst-Stellen für Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmänner HF/FH.

jobs.title: Bauführer & Projektleiter mit Erfahrung in der Natursteinbranche
jobs.description:
Bauführer \& Projektleiter mit Erfahrung in der Natursteinbranche  
Wir sind ein unabhängiges und national führendes Natursteinunternehmen, welches auf eine über 100\-jährige Tradition zurückblickt. Wir sind in den Bereichen Restauration/Renovation, exkl. Innenausbau, Terrassen, Aussenanlagen, Schwimmbäder, Bäder, Wellnessanlagen u.m. tätig. Unsere fundierten Fachkenntnisse und die Professionalität unserer Mitarbeiter waren die Voraussetzung für eine stetige Festigung am Markt. So konnten wir nicht nur gesund wachsen. sondern uns auch einen erstklassigen Ruf erarbeiten. Wir entwickeln uns stets weiter. Qualität, Termintreue und Kundenzufriedenheit sind unsere höchsten Ansprüche.  
Als Ergänzung unseres Teams suchen wir einen ambitionierten und praxisnahen Bauführer/Projektleiter (35\-50 Jahre alt) mit Erfahrung in der Natursteinbranche.  
Ihr Verantwortungsbereich:  
Selbständige Projektleitung bzw. Bauführung sind Ihre Stärke. Sie koordinieren diverse Baustellen und überzeugen mit ausgeprägten Führungsfähigkeiten und geschulter Kommunikationsfähigkeit. An der Front gelten Sie als kompetenter, geradliniger und freundlicher Ansprechpartner. Sie stehen für absolute Zuverlässigkeit, Qualität auf höchstem Niveau und eine hohe Lösungsorientierung. Sie bearbeiten Offertanfragen selbständig, beraten, kalkulieren Preise und erstellen Offerten aufgrund von Plänen und Vorgaben. Die Dokumentation und das Controlling Ihrer Projekte haben Sie im Griff und stets auf dem aktuellen Stand.  
Ihr Profil:  
Sie sind eine motivierte und dynamische Persönlichkeit, lieben es unternehmerisch zu denken und haben eine gute Bodenhaftung. Als ursprünglicher Handwerker (Steinmetz, , Plattenleger etc.) oder mit einem entsprechenden Hintergrund in der Baubranche mit Weiterbildung Bauführung/Projektleitung konnten Sie sich als Bauführer, Projektleiter erfolgreich positionieren. Sie blicken auf einen mehrjährigen Leistungsausweis in der Führung von Bauvorhaben mit personeller Verantwortung zurück und kennen sich bestens mit Natursteinen aus. Sie sind kommunikativ stark und scheuen die Konfrontation nicht. Sie sind motiviert und wissen Mitarbeiter zu begeistern und zu führen. Sie haben eine rasche Auffassungsgabe, ein stabiles Nervenkostüm, sind flexibel und belastbar und können auch in hektischen Momenten Ruhe bewahren und sich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren. Sie haben ansprechende Umgangsformen und können mit Menschen aller Ebenen umgehen. Dinge müssen für Sie harmonisch sein – Sie lieben das Schöne, das Edle und Ihre Arbeit. Wenn Sie sich dann noch als erfolgreichen Idealisten bezeichnen würden und vielleicht sogar noch italienisch sprechen, sollten Sie sich bei uns melden.  
Unser Angebot:  
Die Möglichkeit, nach einer fundierten Einarbeitung Mitglied im obersten Kader zu werden. Ihren Erfolg können Sie auf die langjährige Kompetenz einer renommierten Firma und fachlich/technisch fähigen, langjährigen und loyalen Mitarbeitern bauen. Es erwartet Sie ein aussergewöhnlicher, äusserst attraktiver Arbeitsplatz mit viel Raum und Licht sowie faire und interessante Anstellungsbedingungen.  
Wenn Sie dieses Inserat mit Begeisterung gelesen haben und Ihre Fähigkeiten erfolgreich unter Beweis gestellt haben, freuen wir uns auf Ihre schriftliche Bewerbung mit Foto. jpid5799c6cjm jit0728jm jiy26jm

European Quantitative Power Analyst
Location: Geneva, Switzerland

Your Role
As our European Power Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping trading strategies across European electricity markets by delivering high-impact analytical insights. Working within the Global Gas and Power team, you will combine fundamental and statistical analysis to support decision-making in a dynamic trading environment.

Our Team
Koch Minerals & Trading (KM&T), with offices in Geneva, London and globally, is a commodity trading business active across energy, metals, and freight markets. The Global Gas and Power team focuses on delivering analytical insights that support trading strategy and market understanding across European electricity markets.

What You Will Do
Lead fundamental analysis of European power markets
Develop, maintain, and enhance supply and demand (S&D) stack models
Provide analytical insights to support trading strategies and identify new opportunities
Manage and improve data inputs and sources for power market analysis
Support and maintain fundamental research on European electricity markets

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)
Experience in European power market fundamental analysis or demonstrated ability to develop comparable market insights
Experience working with FBMC power stack models
Strong knowledge of statistical techniques and their application
Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Understanding and application of weather fundamentals in power markets

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Economics)

Experience translating analytical insights into commercial or trading strategy impact
Familiarity with European electricity market structures and interconnections

Who We Are
As a Koch company, Koch Minerals & Trading (KM&T) specializes in the innovative procurement, exchange, and delivery of essential commodity products and services that empower our daily way of life. We pursue the development of investments into successful ventures and new, transformative platforms.

jobs.title: Animateurs sociaux / Animatrices sociales
jobs.description:
Animateurs sociaux / Animatrices sociales  
Depuis plus de 70 ans, le CSP agit à Genève en faveur de la solidarité, de la dignité et de la justice sociale. Créé en 1986, l’Atelier Galiffe est aujourd’hui un dispositif reconnu du réseau social et sociosanitaire genevois. Fort de près de quarante ans d’expérience dans l’accueil de personnes en situation de vulnérabilité sociale, il s’apprête à franchir une nouvelle étape de son développement.  
Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un nouveau centre de jour au printemps 2027, nous engageons des  
Animateurs sociaux / Animatrices sociales (3 postes fixes à 60\-70%)  
Notre deuxième centre de jour ouvrira ses portes en avril 2027 à la rue de la Cartouchière, Plan\-les\-Ouates. Il offrira un lieu de rencontre, de ressourcement et de participation destiné à des personnes vivant des difficultés sociales et/ou psychiques. À travers des activités artisanales, créatives et relationnelles, il favorisera le lien social. Chacun∙e pourra y trouver un espace où se sentir accueilli∙e, respecté∙e dans son autonomie et libre d'être soi\-même.  
Votre mission  
En tant qu'animateur∙trice social∙e, vous faites vivre un lieu d'accueil, d'écoute et d'activités, non médicalisé, ouvert et accessible. Vous veillez à ce que chacun∙e y trouve sa place, dans le respect de son histoire, de son rythme et de ses ressources. Vous proposez des activités adaptées aux envies et aux capacités des participants, privilégiant le plaisir de faire, sans recherche de performance ni esprit de compétition. Vous contribuez à faire du centre un lieu chaleureux, ouvert à la fréquentation libre, où chacun∙e peut participer à sa manière.  
Vos principales responsabilités  
Accueillir les participante∙s et favoriser leur intégration.  
Concevoir, organiser et animer des activités artisanales, créatives, artistiques, culinaires ou de jardinage, adaptées aux envies et aux capacités des participants.  
Être à l'écoute des participante∙s, prendre en compte leurs demandes et leurs suggestions, les accompagner et les orienter, lorsque nécessaire, vers les partenaires et services du réseau.  
Participer à la préparation et à l'ouverture du nouveau centre de jour.  
Collaborer avec l’équipe du centre existant afin d’assurer la cohérence des pratiques et de contribuer au développement du projet dans une logique de valeurs partagées et de co\-construction, et de participer aux réflexions communes ainsi qu’aux dynamiques d’équipe au sens large.  
Participer aux réflexions organisationnelles, représenter le centre auprès des partenaires et collaborer avec les bénévoles, les animateurs∙trices remplaçant∙e∙s, et avec les autres services du CSP.  
Votre profil professionnel  
Nous recherchons des professionnel∙le∙s souhaitant mettre leurs compétences relationnelles autant que leurs savoir\-faire créatifs, artistiques ou artisanaux au service des personnes.  
Titulaire d’un diplôme dans les domaines du travail social, de l’animation communautaire ou socioculturelle (ou formation certifiante à effectuer durant l’emploi).  
Formation ou compétences dans un ou plusieurs domaines artistiques, artisanaux, manuels ou créatifs (bois, textile, arts plastiques, bricolage, jardinage, récupération, etc.) et capacité à les partager avec les participante∙s.  
Expérience confirmée et savoir\-être auprès de personnes en situation de vulnérabilité sociale et/ou psychique. Capacité à construire une relation de confiance avec des personnes parfois très fragilisées.  
Excellentes capacités d'écoute, d'adaptation et d'innovation, avec une bonne résilience émotionnelle.  
Connaissance de terrain du réseau social genevois.  
Expérience en gestion de projets souhaitée.  
Goût pour le travail de terrain, l'animation de groupes et la relation tant individuelle que collective.  
Capacité à comprendre et à accompagner les dynamiques de groupe, ainsi qu’à prévenir et à gérer les tensions et les situations conflictuelles.  
Esprit d'équipe, autonomie et sens de l'organisation.  
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  
Vous participerez à la création d’un nouveau lieu d’accueil de jour et à la constitution d’une équipe complète de trois animateur·trices. Ces deux dimensions se construiront ensemble, dans un projet stimulant où la créativité, le travail manuel et la relation humaine occuperont une place centrale. En lien étroit avec l’équipe du centre existant et la responsable du service, vous serez pleinement moteurs dans les différents défis liés à cette ouverture : installation et aménagement des nouveaux locaux, construction d’une dynamique d’équipe, création de liens avec les partenaires sociaux du bâtiment et les différents bénéficiaires, développement des relations avec le réseau social du quartier, ainsi que réflexion collective sur les moyens de rendre le nouvel Atelier attractif, visible et accueillant.  
Entrée en fonction : février 2027  
Lieu de travail : Chemin de la Cartouchière, Plan\-les\-Ouates  
Postulation : faites\-nous part de votre intérêt en déposant votre dossier de candidature  
(CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail et diplômes, en un dossier unique),  
jusqu’au 30 août 2026\. jpid62ddfb4jm jpit0833jm jpiy26jm

Consultant en recrutement IT \- H/F  
Vous souhaitez exercer le métier de recruteur dans un environnement où la technologie, la qualité de la relation humaine et la connaissance du marché sont au cœur du métier ?  
Rejoignez Sigmalis Talent Services et participez au développement d’un groupe suisse à taille humaine, spécialisé dans les métiers de l’informatique.  
Le groupe Sigmalis  
Présent en Suisse romande depuis 2007, Sigmalis réunit aujourd’hui deux structures complémentaires autour d’une même ambition : accompagner durablement les entreprises dans leurs projets informatiques.  
Sigmalis, ESN basée à Genève, accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets informatiques grâce à ses expertises en développement applicatif, Business Intelligence et Data Management. Ses consultants interviennent aussi bien en mission directement au sein des équipes clients que dans le cadre de projets réalisés au forfait.  
Sigmalis Talent Services, société sœur spécialisée dans le recrutement IT, accompagne les entreprises dans la recherche et la sélection de profils informatiques, dans le cadre de recrutements fixes ou de missions temporaires.  
Cette complémentarité nous permet de conjuguer connaissance des métiers IT, expertise du recrutement et proximité avec le marché suisse romand.  
Description du poste  
Votre mission En tant que Consultant·e en recrutement IT, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, depuis la compréhension du besoin jusqu'au suivi des candidats. Vous intervenez aussi bien sur les recrutements destinés à renforcer les équipes de consultants du groupe que sur les mandats confiés à Sigmalis Talent Services par ses clients. Votre rôle ne consiste pas uniquement à identifier des CV : vous cherchez à comprendre les parcours, les compétences, les motivations et les aspirations professionnelles afin de créer des mises en relation pertinentes et durables. Vos principales responsabilités Comprendre les besoins de recrutement, les environnements techniques et les profils recherchés, Définir et déployer les stratégies de sourcing et d'approche directe les plus adaptées, Rédiger et publier des offres d'emploi attractives et ciblées, Identifier et approcher des candidats via les différents outils, réseaux professionnels et techniques de chasse de tête, Analyser les candidatures et évaluer leur adéquation avec les exigences techniques, professionnelles et humaines du poste, Préparer et conduire des entretiens approfondis et structurés, Rédiger des comptes rendus d'entretien précis permettant de restituer les compétences, l'expérience, les motivations et les éléments déterminants de chaque candidature, Accompagner les candidats tout au long du processus et assurer un suivi régulier et professionnel, Garantir la qualité et la mise à jour des informations dans notre ATS et constituer des viviers de talents sur les profils régulièrement recherchés, Développer une relation de proximité avec les équipes internes du groupe et comprendre leurs besoins actuels et futurs, Contribuer à l'attractivité de nos opportunités et à notre marque employeu  
Profil recherché  
Vous bénéficiez de 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans le recrutement et le sourcing de profils IT au sein d'une agence de recrutement ou d'une société de services informatiques en Suisse romande. Cette connaissance du marché local est importante pour vous permettre d'être rapidement autonome dans votre fonction. Vous disposez également des compétences et qualités suivantes : excellente maîtrise des méthodes de sourcing, de recherche directe et de chasse de tête, bonne connaissance des principaux métiers et environnements de l'informatique, connaissance du marché de l'emploi et du tissu économique de Suisse romande, capacité à conduire des entretiens structurés et à évaluer une candidature au\-delà des seuls éléments du CV, français langue maternelle ou niveau équivalent, avec d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et une orthographe irréprochable, bon niveau d'anglais vous permettant de conduire des entretiens avec des candidats anglophones, sens de l'organisation, rigueur et capacité à gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités simultanément, excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens de la communication, autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats, goût du travail en équipe et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs et métiers, respect absolu de la confidentialité et de l'éthique inhérentes au métier du recrutement. Nous recherchons une personne qui souhaite s'investir dans la durée, développer son expertise et contribuer activement à la croissance de notre activité. Rejoindre Sigmalis Talent Services, c'est… Intégrer un groupe suisse à taille humaine, dans lequel les échanges sont directs et les responsabilités réelles. Exercer pleinement votre métier de recruteur, de l'analyse du besoin à l'accompagnement du candidat, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité des recrutements. Évoluer au contact de spécialistes de l'IT, qui permettent de mieux comprendre les métiers, les environnements techniques et les enjeux rencontrés par nos clients. Construire des relations de proximité avec les candidats, en privilégiant la qualité des échanges et du suivi plutôt qu'une approche purement quantitative du recrutement. Travailler sur des missions variées, aussi bien pour les besoins internes du groupe que pour des entreprises et organisations de Suisse romande. Participer au développement d'une structure en croissance, dans laquelle vos idées, votre expérience et votre capacité à prendre des initiatives pourront directement contribuer à faire évoluer nos pratiques. Enfin, nous accordons une importance particulière à l'éthique, la confidentialité, la qualité du travail réalisé et au respect des engagements pris envers nos candidats comme envers nos clients. Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette approche du recrutement et souhaitez poursuivre votre parcours dans un environnement spécialisé IT ? Nous serons heureux de découvrir votre candidature et d'échanger avec vous sur votre parcours et vos aspirations professionnelles. jpidde2d0f3jm jpit0833jm jpiy26jm

jobs.employer: TRAFIGURA PTE LTD, Singapour,succursale de Genève
jobs.description:
locations Geneva, Switzerland
time type Full time
job requisition id R-0 17471

Main purpose
We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting new opportunity to work on XVA and working capital models as well as contributing to a Quant Library in a dynamic and leading commodity house. As part of the job, you'll be developing and maintaining methodologies and quantitative tools, and liaising with stakeholders across the business (Traders, MO, Risk, Finance, Credit, IT). You will have strong interaction with traders and be part of the daily process of assessing the risk associated to every new transaction.

Key responsibilities
Developing and maintaining methodologies and quantitative tools

Liaising with stakeholders across the business (Traders, MO, Risk, Credit, IT) Assess the risk (CVA and FVA) associated to every new transaction

Required qualifications
3+ years working experience, preferably in an XVA quantitative business in commodity
Very strong analytical and mathematical skill
Comfortable with derivatives modelling concepts
Strong Python and/or C++ programming skills & experience
Experience in delivering production quality code, including use of source control, continuous integration, unit and regression testing

Preferred qualifications
Knowledge of working capital / cash at risk models within physical commodity space would be a plus
Master’s or higher numerate degree in Maths, Engineering, Physics, Science, Finance, or related field

Attributes for success
Ownership: Takes full responsibility for models, methodologies, and outputs, ensuring accuracy, robustness, and timely delivery in a high-impact environment
Attention to Detail: Demonstrates precision and rigor when developing, reviewing, and maintaining quantitative models and data
Communication: Clearly explains complex quantitative concepts to traders and non-technical stakeholders, supporting informed decision-making
Organizational Skills: Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders while maintaining high standards of documentation and governance
Resilience: Performs well under pressure in a fast-paced trading environment, adapting quickly to changing priorities and market conditions
Analytical Thinking: Applies strong problem-solving skills to assess risk, interpret model outputs, and translate analysis into commercial insight

Department overview
The Market Liquidity Risk team plays a critical role in assessing and managing the liquidity, funding, and valuation risks arising from Trafigura’s global trading activities.
The team develops and maintains XVA, working capital, and liquidity models that support day-to-day trading decisions. Working closely with traders, middle office, risk, finance, credit, and IT, the team ensures robust risk assessment for every new transaction.
The team sits at the heart of the trading floor, combining quantitative rigour with commercial awareness. Through its analysis, the team directly supports profitability, capital efficiency, and disciplined risk-taking across the Group.

Equal opportunity employer
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse workforce! We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices for reasons of race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or handicap, disability, or any other legally protected status.

At the heart of global supply, Trafigura connects vital resources to power and build the world. Through our Metals and Minerals, Oil & Petroleum Products and Gas, Power and Renewables, commercial divisions, we use infrastructure, logistics and financing to connect producers and consumers, using our deep understanding of the markets we serve to make supply more efficient, secure and sustainable.
We are accelerating our investments in renewable energy, including hydrogen, ammonia and other low-carbon energy technologies required for the transition to a low carbon future. We are committed to responsible business practices and we work with our stakeholders to improve environmental and social standards, bringing greater trust and transparency to global supply chains.
A career at Trafigura offers a gateway to working on some of the most exciting challenges of a rapidly changing world – from helping to optimise supply chains to developing infrastructure and new markets. In a culture that is founded on openness and energy, our people work as part of a multinational, globally connected team and thrive in a fast-paced environment where they can nurture and commercialise bold ideas. Everyone has a voice and is empowered to collaborate across geographies and disciplines to help shape our business and the wider world. We know the importance and value of diversity in our business and we invest in attracting, developing and retaining talent from all backgrounds.

Founded in 1993, Trafigura is one of the largest independent employee-owned commodities groups in the world with over 12,000 people working across more than 60 offices. The Trafigura Group owns global multi-metals producer Nyrstar; fuel storage and distribution company Puma Energy; and joint ventures Impala Terminals, a port and logistics provider, and Nalo Renewables, investing in wind, solar and battery storage projects.

jobs.title: General Manager (Textile Laboratory and Audit Services)
jobs.description:
Job description:

IDFL Europe AG is a leading provider of textile laboratory testing, auditing, and certification services serving brands, manufacturers, suppliers, recyclers, farms, and retailers throughout Europe. As part of the global IDFL Group, with more than 20 international offices and over 400 employees worldwide, IDFL Europe AG specializes in down and feather testing as well as sustainability auditing and certification across multiple international standards.We are seeking an experienced General Manager to lead our Swiss operations and support the continued expansion of our laboratory and auditing businesses throughout Europe.Position SummaryThe General Manager is responsible for the overall strategic and operational management of IDFL Europe AG, including laboratory operations, auditing and certification services, financial performance, business development, quality management, personnel leadership, and coordination with IDFL’s international offices.The successful candidate will oversee a multidisciplinary organization supporting clients throughout Europe while maintaining the company’s technical leadership in textile testing and sustainability certification.

Key Responsibilities

-Provide overall leadership and strategic direction for IDFL Europe AG.
-Manage laboratory testing operations specializing in down and feather testing.
-Direct auditing and certification operations across multiple international sustainability standards.
-Maintain compliance with ISO accreditation and certification requirements.
-Lead business development initiatives throughout Europe.
-Manage financial performance, budgeting, and operational planning.
-Supervise technical, laboratory, auditing, and administrative personnel.
-Coordinate with IDFL’s global offices to ensure consistent technical standards and customer service.
-Maintain relationships with international brands, manufacturers, certification bodies, and other key stakeholders.

Required Qualifications - Applicants must demonstrate:

-Bachelor’s degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Materials Science, Industrial Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Supply Chain Management, or a closely related discipline.
-Advanced postgraduate qualification (Master’s degree or equivalent) in business management, engineering, sustainability, quality management, or a related field.
-Minimum 10 years of professional experience within the textile testing, auditing, certification, or textile supply chain industry.
-Minimum 5 years of management experience leading technical or auditing teams across multiple countries.
-Demonstrated responsibility for operational, financial, and personnel management within an international organization.
-Qualification as a lead auditor for multiple internationally recognized textile sustainability standards.
-Demonstrated experience making certification decisions or managing certification programs under internationally recognized certification schemes.
-Experience managing auditing operations across multiple European countries.
-Technical knowledge of textile laboratory testing.
-Experience working with international textile brands, manufacturers, and supply chain organizations.
-Fluent English (written and spoken).
-Ability to travel internationally throughout Europe.

Preferred Qualifications - Preference will be given to candidates possessing experience or qualifications in several of the following internationally recognized programs:

-Textile Exchange
-Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS)
-Forest Stewardship Council (FSC)
-Better Cotton
-Higg Facility Environmental Module (Higg FEM)
-Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals (ZDHC)
-Downpass, EDFA and J-TAS

Additional preference will be given to candidates who have:

-Experience with down and feather product supply chains, including raw material sourcing, processing, manufacturing, quality assurance, traceability, and certification.
-Technical knowledge or practical experience in down and feather laboratory testing, including quality assessment methodologies and applicable international standards.
-Experience integrating laboratory testing with certification and auditing activities.
-Experience supporting ISO-accredited quality management systems.
-Experience working in multinational organizations with geographically distributed teams.
-Additional European languages, particularly Italian or Turkish.

What We Offer:

-Management position within an internationally recognized organization.
-Opportunity to lead a growing European business.
-International collaboration with technical experts across more than 20 countries.
-Competitive compensation package consistent with Swiss executive management positions.
-Long-term career development within a global organization.

License/Certification:

-Textile Exchange qualified auditor (Required)
-Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) qualified auditor (Required)
- FSC, ZDHC, HIGG FEM, Better Cotton Qualified Auditor or Certifier (Preferred)

(payable 14 times per year)


PhD Position in Forest Regeneration and Nutrient Dynamics
Tree regeneration success is a key determinant of forest resilience and long-term ecosystem
stability. While light availability has been widely studied as a driver of regeneration dynamics,
the role of the forest floor as a regulator of nutrient supply to seedlings has received far less
attention. The Forest floor is the interface between the above- and below-ground parts of forest
ecosystems. It serves as a seedbed and rooting zone for vegetation, and acts as a hub of the
ecosystem where organic matter, nutrients and water are stored, absorbed, and transformed.
In the context of climate change, the Forest floor and its associated ecosystem services appear
as particularly at risk. As part of the research group "Humus layer: Function, dynamics and
vulnerability in transition" (https://gepris.dfg.de/project/457330647), the goal of our project is
to investigate how forest floor characteristics, root and mycorrhizal connectivity to mature
trees, and drought jointly regulate nutrient availability and regeneration performance. For more
information, please contact: emilie.fleurot@boku.ac.at.


Responsibilities
º Conducting lab work (measurement of soil and leaf nutrient concentration,
measurement of 15N concentration, ...)
º Conducting 2 weeks of field work per year in Germany (collecting leaf and soil
samples, measuring the condition and height of the plants)
º Conducting 1 week of fieldwork in an old growth forest (Rothwald) (mapping of forest
soil properties)
º Performing data analysis and writing scientific publications
º Writing and defending a doctoral thesis is desired
Required skills and qualifications


º Diploma degree in MSc ecology, biology, forestry or other equivalent university degree
º Language skills: Strong proficiency in English, both written and verbal
º Training and experience in statistical analysis and the R software
º Experience in field work and motivation to work under harsh conditions
º Experience in scientific writing


Desirable skills and qualifications
º Background in forest ecology and/or soil biology
º Highly motivated candidate with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the
ability to work independently and as part of a team
º Driving licence type B
º Ability to perform fieldwork in adverse conditions
º Laboratory experiment, preferably with stable isotopes


Applications can be submitted until: 21st of August 2026


University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences Vienna seeks to increase the number of its
female faculty and staff members. Therefore qualified women are strongly encouraged to
apply. In case of equal qualification, female candidates will be given preference unless
reasons specific to an individual male candidate tilt the balance in his favour.


People with disabilities and appropriate qualifications are specifically encouraged to apply.

process
to HR Management, BOKU University, Peter-Jordan-Straße 70, 1190 Vienna;

jobs.title: Puhastusteeninduse praktika juhendaja
jobs.description:
Tule aita erivajadusega noortel jõuda tööturule.

Tööülesanded: Oled positiivne, kannatlik ja oskad inimesi motiveerida?
Ootame Sind liituma meie meeskonnaga, et viia ellu projekti, mille eesmärk on arendada erivajadusega noorte tööalaseid oskusi ning toetada nende edukat liikumist avatud tööturule. Sinu töö eesmärk on juhendada ja toetada erilisi noori kogu projekti vältel, aidates neil kujundada puhastusteenindaja tööoskusi ja -harjumusi ning valmistuda edukaks sisenemiseks avatud tööturule. Puhastusteenindus on peamine valdkond, mille kaudu noored projekti käigus praktilisi tööoskusi omandavad, mistõttu on oluline Sinu varasem kogemus ja teadmised puhastusteenindusest. Sinu ülesandeks on toetada noori praktika läbiviimisel ja tööle asumisel, juhendad neid nende esimestel tööpäevadel ning nõustad tööandjaid, et tagada noore edukas kohanemine ja töökohal püsimine. Selle eesmärgi saavutamiseks on Sinu peamised tööülesanded: • viia läbi individuaalset tööjuhendamist ja õpetada noortele puhastusteeninduse töövõtteid; • toetada noorte tööharjumuste, tööoskuste ja iseseisvuse kujunemist; • kohandada juhendamist vastavalt iga noore võimetele, vajadustele ja õpitempole; • hinnata noorte arengut ning toetada omandatud oskuste kinnistumist praktilise töö kaudu; • valmistada noori ette tööle asumiseks avatud tööturul; • leida noortele sobivaid praktika- ja töökohti koostöös tööandjatega; • juhendada noori nende esimestel tööpäevadel ning toetada tööülesannete omandamisel; • teha koostööd projektimeeskonna, partnerite ja tööandjatega ning pidada vajalikku projektiga seotud dokumentatsiooni.

Omalt poolt pakume: Omalt poolt pakume:
• Hoolivat ja toetavat meeskonda, kus väärtustatakse koostööd, avatud suhtlust ning üksteise toetamist. • Tähendusrikast tööd, kus saad päriselt panustada noorte tööoskuste arengusse ja nende edukasse jõudmisse tööturule. • Põhjalikku sisseelamist ja toetust – uuel töötajal on olemas kolleegide ning projektijuhi tugi. • Võimalust kujundada ja arendada puhastusteeninduse töötoa tegevusi ning rakendada oma teadmisi ja kogemusi. • Kaasaegseid töövahendeid – oma töökohta Tartus, arvutit ja töötelefoni. • Toetavat töökorraldust ning võimalust planeerida oma tööd iseseisvalt. • Ühiseid meeskonnaüritusi, õppepäevi ja kogemusreise. • Puhkust suveperioodil ning tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi vastavalt organisatsiooni võimalustele.

Muud nõuded: Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus.
Ootame Sinult: • valmisolekut juhendada ja toetada erivajadustega noori nende tööoskuste omandamisel; • puhastusteeninduse valdkonna teadmisi ja praktilist kogemust; • kasuks tuleb läbitud puhastusteenindaja või puhastustööde juhi koolitus; • head suhtlemis- ja juhendamisoskust ning kannatlikkust erinevate õppijatega töötamisel; • oskust märgata noorte individuaalseid vajadusi ning kohandada juhendamist vastavalt nende võimetele; • iseseisvust, head töö- ja ajaplaneerimise oskust ning vastutustunnet; • valmidust teha koostööd tööandjate, projektimeeskonna ja teiste partneritega; • head arvutikasutamise oskust dokumentatsiooni ja tööalase info haldamiseks; • eesti keele oskust vähemalt heal tasemel; vene keele oskus on soovituslik ja tuleb suhtlemisel kasuks; Eeliseks on: • varasem kogemus juhendaja, mentorina või kutseõpetajana töötamisel; • kogemus erivajadustega inimeste või noorte juhendamisel; • teadmised toetatud töötamise põhimõtetest ning motiveerivast juhendamisest.
