Etsimme nyt omatoimista, tarkkaa ja myyntihenkistä tekijää, joka ottaa vastuun omasta tekemisestään.

Toimipaikkamme sijaitsee Laihialla, mutta kohteemme sijaitsevat laajasti Laihian, Vaasan, Vähänkyrön, Isonkyrön ja Ylistaron alueilla. Työ on liikkuvaa ja työpäivät vievät sinne, missä asiakkaamme ja kohteemme ovat.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

**Sujuvan aloituksen:**

Sinun ei tarvitse aloittaa tyhjästä. Saat heti työn alle yrityksen valmiita toimeksiantoja, joten pääset kiinni tekemiseen alusta alkaen.

**Täyden tuen työhösi:**

Saat käyttöösi viimeisimmät järjestelmät ja tuen sekä apua aina tarvittaessa. Et jää yksin haastavissakaan tilanteissa. Vastaat kuitenkin omista toimeksiannoistasi itsenäisesti alusta loppuun ja huolehdit siitä, että asiat tulevat tehdyiksi ajallaan ja huolellisesti.

**Turvallisen ja motivoivan palkkamallin:**

Tarjoamme aidon kiinteän pohjapalkan, jonka päälle reilut provisiot.

**Kiinteä pohjapalkka:**

1 000 euroa / kk.

**Myyntiprovisiot pohjapalkan päälle:**

30 % itse hankkimiesi kohteiden välityspalkkiosta ja 15 % yrityksen sinulle antamien kohteiden välityspalkkioista (laskettuna arvonlisäverottomasta välityspalkkiosta).

**Vuokraprovisiot pohjapalkan päälle:**

50 % itse hankkimiesi toimeksiantojen vuokravälityspalkkioista ja 30 % yrityksen sinulle antamien kohteiden vuokravälityspalkkioista (laskettuna arvonlisäverottomasta välityspalkkiosta).

T**yöajot**:

Oman auton käytöstä työajoihin maksetaan kilometrikorvaukset 25snt/km.

**Vapautta ja joustavuutta:**

Tarjoamme itsenäisen työnkuvan, joustavuutta työn tekemiseen ja matalan hierarkian ilman suuren ketjun kankeita rakenteita. Saat vastuuta, mutta samalla myös vapautta hoitaa työsi tehokkaasti omalla tavallasi.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

**Omatoimisuutta ja tarkkuutta:**

Nämä ovat tehtävässä ehdottomia edellytyksiä. Etsimme henkilöä, joka tarttuu asioihin itsenäisesti, pitää langat käsissään ja vie aloittamansa asiat loppuun asti. Kiinteistönvälityksessä yksityiskohdilla on merkitystä, joten järjestelmällisyys, huolellisuus ja vastuunotto ovat tehtävässä välttämättömiä. Sovituista asioista pidetään kiinni.

**Oikeaa asennetta ja nälkää:**

Kokemus välitysalalta on plussaa, mutta asenne, myyntihenkisyys ja halu oppia ratkaisevat. Voit olla kokenut välittäjä tai esimerkiksi muun myyntialan ammattilainen, joka haluaa rakentaa uransa kiinteistönvälityksessä.

**Valmiutta ilta- ja viikonlopputyöhön:**

Kiinteistönvälitystyössä asiakastapaamiset ja esittelyt sijoittuvat usein myös iltoihin ja viikonloppuihin. Tehtävä edellyttää valmiutta työskennellä joustavasti myös normaalien toimistoaikojen ulkopuolella.

**Myyntihenkisyyttä, verkostoja ja paikallistuntemusta:**

Uusasiakashankinta ja uusien toimeksiantojen hankkiminen ovat olennainen osa työtä. Saat yritykseltä valmiita toimeksiantoja hoidettavaksi, mutta odotamme sinulta myös aktiivista otetta asiakaskunnan ja toimeksiantokannan kasvattamiseen. Nautit ihmisten kanssa toimimisesta, osaat rakentaa luottamusta ja tunnet alueen tai olet valmis oppimaan sen nopeasti.

**LKV- tai LVV-pätevyys katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole tehtävän edellytys:**

Voit siis hakea tehtävään myös ilman alan pätevyyttä tai aikaisempaa kokemusta kiinteistönvälityksestä. Tärkeintä meille ovat oikea asenne, omatoimisuus, tarkkuus ja halu oppia.

**B-ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta:**

Työ edellyttää liikkumista asiakastapaamisissa, kohteilla ja esittelyissä, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on tehtävän edellytys.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

**Tule tekemään tulosta tiimiin, jossa töitä on valmiina, saat vahvan tuen tekemiseesi ja onnistumisesta myös palkitaan.**

jobs.title: Clothing Team worker, Lapland Safaris Ylläs
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Clothing Team workers for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the Christmas season 2026. We are looking for Clothing Team workers to work in Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Hetta and Olos.**

As a Clothing Team worker, you will assist guests to get properly dressed for winter activities for their entire holiday. Safari clothing includes overalls, woolen socks, boots, gloves, balaclava, and a hat if needed. After the safaris guests return the clothes and the clothing team is responsible for the washing and organizing of the clothing. The team also ensures that the customer premises are clean and organized. Work is an important part of the success of safari excursions.

You are the person we are looking for if you are customer service-oriented and have a positive attitude towards your work. We value diligence, initiative, teamwork skills, and conscientiousness in our employees. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

Due to the busy nature of seasonal work, we require flexibility in working hours and the ability to withstand pressure brought by the demands and challenges set by the work. Work is often physically demanding. Sometimes the working days can be long, and the work is done on weekdays, weekends, and Christmas holidays.

Communication with guests is conducted mainly in English. Your English language skills do not have to be excellent, but you need to be able to give instructions to our guests in English and at least briefly answer their questions or direct the questions to another colleague. Other language skills, especially Spanish and French, are also useful in our fell destinations. Previous experience of similar tasks in the field of tourism is considered advantageous, as well as experience driving a large van (class B drivers license) in arctic conditions.

**In Ylläs** the Clothing Team Workers will dress up all guests arriving at Kittilä airport and dressing takes place near the airport. Focus is mainly on dressing up groups that stay for a few days.

**In Rovaniemi** we are looking for local employees who already have an apartment / accommodation in Rovaniemi. Working days are more often focused on weekdays, with daytime working hours, rather than weekends and evenings.

**In Hetta** our Clothing team workers also work as Outdoor Activity Instructors for our Christmas-themed activities.

**In Olos** ourClothing team workers are responsible for distributing and maintaining the clothing of Charter guests in Lapland Hotels Olos area.

**We offer you:**

- A great team to work with

- Versatile and variable working days

- An easy way to start working in the field of tourism in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will begin at the end of November 2026 and will last approximately until the end of December or beginning of January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A, hourly wage starting from 10,10 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish public holidays are paid double. Except for Rovaniemi, accommodation is arranged; in shared rooms at a rent that is reasonable compared to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.** If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Asiakaspalvelija –liity Valoon tiimiin!
jobs.description:
Nautitko ihmisten auttamisesta ja mutkattoman asiakaspalvelun tarjoamisesta? Haluatko olla osa kasvavaa yritystä, jossa asiakaskokemus on kaiken keskiössä? Etsimme uusia asiakaspalvelijoita tuottamaan erinomaisia kohtaamisia Valoon asiakkaille osana motivoitunutta tiimiä.

Valonnopeudella kasvava Valoo on valokuitumarkkinoiden raikkain ja rohkein toimija, joka tuo laadukkaat, nopeat ja kestävät valokuituyhteydet yhä useampaan suomalaiseen kotiin. Asiakkaille tarjoamme markkinoiden parhaan nettiyhteyden - työntekijöille innostavan, lämpimän ja merkityksellisen työympäristön.

Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu

Asiakaspalvelijana päätehtäväsi on asiakkaiden kontaktoiminen informatiivisella ja ystävällisellä otteella, asiakaspalvelun kasvoina toimiminen eri yhteydenpitokanavissa sekä luonnollisesti Valoon palveluiden myynti. Sinulla on tärkeä rooli Valoon ilosanoman jalkauttamisessa ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamisessa. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti Seinäjoen toimistolta käsin ja työpäiväsi sijoittuvat arkipäivisin klo 9-17 ja lauantaisin klo 10-16 väliselle ajalle.

Mitä toivomme sinulta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista jakirjallista osaamista asiakaspalvelun laadun varmistamiseksi
- Positiivista ja rentoapalveluasennetta - tavoitteenasi on tuottaa mieleenpainuva asiakaskokemus
- Hyvää tilannetajua sekä kiinnostustaasiakasta kohtaan
- Tavoitteellista suhtautumistaasiakaspalveluun
- Kykyä toimia erilaisissavuorovaikutustilanteissa ja kuunnella asiakasta aidosti
- Iloista ja ratkaisukeskeistälähestymistapaa
Aikaisempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta on eduksesi, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme hyvää tyyppiä oikealla asenteella.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

- Paikan kasvavassa yrityksessä ja reippaassa, rempseässä työporukassa
- Joustavan työn, jossa arvostetaan yhdessä tekemisen meininkiä
- Kattavan koulutuksen tehtävään -sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen
- Uudet ja raikkaat toimitilat inspiroivassa työympäristössä Seinäjoen keskustassa
- ICT-alan TES:n mukaisen kuukausipalkan 2 184,90 € / kk (osa-aikaisen tuntipalkka 13,83 €) sekä kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän
- Baronan työterveyspalvelut sekä lounasetu
Tarjoamme tehtävää sekä kokoaikaisena että osa-aikaisena. Etsimme tiimiimme kokoaikaisen (37,5 h/vko) asiakaspalvelijan lisäksi myös osa-aikaista tekijää, jonka työaika on noin 20 tuntia viikossa. Työvuorot sijoittuvat asiakaspalvelumme aukioloaikojen mukaisesti.

jobs.title: Chemist (Senior Expert)
jobs.description:
We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?

We are looking for a Chemist that will be titled Senior Expert / Expert, Fuels with a main responsibility in the Fuel Laboratory. The location for this position is Vaasa, Finland.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Senior Expert / Expert, Fuels you will provide expert chemical competence to support Wärtsilä's fuel related technology development, engine testing, customer projects and fuel specification work as well as support on troubleshooting challenges. The role ensures high quality laboratory analysis, development of new analytical methods and expert interpretation of results for conventional, bio based and emerging sustainable fuels. The position supports Wärtsilä's strategic targets related to decarbonisation, fuel flexibility and reliable engine operation.
Requirements for the position:

* M.Sc. in Chemistry or related field

* Strong laboratory experience of instrumental analysis in a chemistry laboratory
* Fluent English communication skills, Swedish and/or Finnish a strong benefit
* Ability to work independently and take ownership
* Willingness to perform hands-on laboratory work when required


Qualifications/to be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:

* A Team player with good collaboration skills in cross-functional teams
* See working in a Chemistry Lab as a dream work were to work & develop long term
* Experience with advanced analytical instruments (e.g. IC, XRF, GC, ICP-OES, FTIR, TGA/DSC)
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Structured way of working and ability to interpret data, reporting and support technical decisions
* Interest in method development and continuous improvement
* Experience in fuel analysis or petrochemicals and knowledge of alternative fuels (e.g. ammonia, hydrogen, methanol) is seen as an advantage



Why you and us?

You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.

Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.

You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact and next steps

Please submit your application before the application deadline 30th of August 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

In case of any questions regarding the position, reach out to:

Olai Lagus,
General Manager, Fuel Laboratory
+358 505675543 or olai.lagus@wartsila.com

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja tai sairaanhoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
ETSIMME RAUMAN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA TAI SAIRAANHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Etsimme nyt Rauman alueelle lähihoitajaa kotihoitoon arkipäivätyöhön. Työ sisältää myös vaativaa hoidollista työtä.

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Hoitotyö ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana. Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------

Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

jobs.title: Närvårdare
jobs.description:
VERKSAMHETEN
Äldreomsorgen i Mariehamns stad sysselsätter omkring 200 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder bland annat hemservice, dagverksamhet, korttidsvård, serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg samt institutionsvård. De aktuella platserna som ska tillsättas är placerade inom Trobergshemmets institutionsvård och serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg.

ARBETET
Arbetet består av att utföra grundläggande omvårdnadsinsatser utifrån klientens behov genom ett rehabiliterande och aktiverande förhållningssätt. Samtliga klienter har en kontaktperson som bland annat ansvarar för planering av insatser, uppföljning och att ge information. Dokumentation är en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet.

KVALIFIKATIONER
För tillsvidare anställning söker vi dig som har formell behörighet som närvårdare med skyddad yrkesbeteckning och är registrerad i Valvira. Om du saknar den formella behörigheten som närvårdare så är du ändå välkommen att söka och kan då vara aktuell för ett vikariat. Du klarar av varierande arbetsuppgifter, har ett fint bemötande och bidrar till arbetsglädje. Du kan arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med kollegor samt de övriga professionerna du kommer i kontakt med. Du har en positiv inställning till, och bidrar till verksamhetens kontinuerliga förbättringsarbete. En del av platserna är för nuvarande placerade inom demensavdelning. Meriterande till dessa platser är specialkunskaper samt erfarenhet av kognitiva sjukdomar.

Vi kan erbjuda följande platser:

Trobergshemmet institution
- 1 st 100 % tillsvidare med aktuell placering inom demensavdelning
- 2 st 100 % tillsvidare
- 1 st 95 % tillsvidare
- 4 st 91,5 % tillsvidare
- 1 st 83,5 % tillsvidare
- 2 st 75 % tillsvidare

Trobergshemmet serviceboende
- 1 st 91,5% tillsvidare
- 2 st 75 % tillsvidare med aktuell placering inom demensavdelning
- 1 st 100% vikariat för perioden 19.10.2026-31.05.2027
- 1 st 75% vikariat för perioden 19.10.2026-31.05.2027

Samtliga anställningar är i arbetsavtalsförhållande. Arbetet inleds med en prövotid om 6 månader och startar enligt överenskommelse. Grundlönen är 2874,34 euro i månaden för heltidsarbete och uppfyllda behörighetskrav, vidare tillkommer eventuella erfarenhetstillägg och individuella lönetillägg. Staden erbjuder dessutom omfattande företagshälsovård och friskvårdsförmåner.

Anställningen kräver vaccinationsskydd i enlighet med § 48 i Lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar (FFS 1227/2016).

Do našeho týmu ve společnosti Benpra servis s.r.o. hledáme zodpovědného a manuálně zručného kolegu na pozici Pracovník údržby zeleně. Baví Vás práce venku, máte vztah k přírodě a technice? Pak hledáme právě Vás!

Místo výkonu práce / startovací bod: Elektrárna Hodonín (U Elektrárny 3030/1, 695 01 Hodonín)

Pracovní poměr: HPP (plný úvazek, 40 hodin týdně)

Typ provozu: Jednosměnný provoz (flexibilní pracovní doba)

Mzdové rozpětí: 36 200 Kč až 41 200 Kč hrubého / měsíc (v závislosti na zkušenostech) + osobní ohodnocení

Co bude Vaší náplní práce?
Stanete se součástí stabilní tříčlenné pracovní skupiny. Vaším úkolem bude:

Provádění kompletních prací při údržbě zeleně (sečení, kácení, ořezy stromů ze země i z plošiny).

Obsluha a běžná údržba strojů (křovinořez, motorová pila, štěpkovač, plošina, traktor s lesní frézou).

Realizace zakázek především v regionu Jižní Moravy, výjimečně ve Středních Čechách. Výjezdy i návraty jsou vždy z našeho zázemí v Elektrárně Hodonín.

Co od Vás požadujeme?
Řidičský průkaz: Skupina B podmínkou (skupina T nebo E velkou výhodou).

Praxi v oboru: Minimálně 2 roky (5 let výhodou).

Dobrou technickou znalost pracovních strojů a jejich ovládání.

jobs.description:
Description du poste :

En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums.
L'entreprise CS GROUP recherche actuellement des profils :

Description de l'entreprise

CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l'intégration et l'exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l'énergie, l'industrie, le transport, l'aéronautique et la cybersécurité.

Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d'innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d'affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites.

En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante.***Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance.
* Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain.
* Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l'innovation.

Explorer, observer, sécuriser l'espace de demain.

Avec 50 ans d'expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d'œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l'Europe.

Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l'innovation de l'écosystème spatial.

Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l'Espace. Portées par l'IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens.

Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c'est façonner le futur de l'espace aux côtés d'experts passionnés.

Description du poste

Nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur(e) DevOps pour rejoindre notre Business unit Espace au sein de notre agence Space Processing & Intelligence spécialisée dans le traitement et l'hybridation des données spatiales .

Vos missions

Vous rejoignez l'équipe DEVOPS, en charge de l'administration des environnements de développement et la mise en place des plateformes d'intégration continue pour les différents projets de la BU Espace.***Auditer des besoins projet, définir la stratégie
* Mettre en place des outils
* Réaliser des pipelines CI/CD
* Assister et expertiser pour les évolutions des besoins

L'environnement technique***GitLab, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Helm, ArgoCD, Ansible, Terraform
* Cloud (providers européens essentiellement) / Openstack
* OpenSource
* Langages variés (Python, Node, Java, C/C++, Golang, Rust)
Qualifications

De formation Bac+5 écoles d'ingénieur ou équivalent, vous possédez une expérience entre 3 et 5 ans en tant que DevOps . La connaissance du secteur spatial est un véritable atout. Vous maitrisez la plateforme de conteneurisation Docker / OCI ainsi que le logiciel Kubernetes .

La maitrise de l' anglais professionnel (lu, écrit et parlé) est indispensable.
Vous êtes à l'écoute , autonome, curieux(se) et aimez le travail en équipe ? Vous aimez débattre au sein de l'équipe pour faire évoluer les choix et les solutions techniques au cours du temps ? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons !

Informations supplémentaires

Rejoignez une entreprise où l'humain, l'innovation et l'impact se rencontrent.

Chez CS, nous offrons Une expérience collaborateur enrichissante , portée par un environnement de travail conçu pour favoriser la flexibilité, l'autonomie et le bien-être au quotidien.
* Un parcours d'intégration complet pensé pour embarquer chaque talent dès le premier jour et une Academy pour développer vos compétences, enrichir votre expertise et construire les parcours professionnels qui vous ressemblent.
* Un engagement sociétal fort : plus de 3000 associations soutenues, une politique handicap active, une culture inclusive, une démarche de numérique responsable, et des partenariats comme Elles bougent pour inspirer les talents féminins de demain.

.et bien d'autres avantages à découvrir en nous rejoignant !

Notre singularité ? L'alliance unique entre expertise technologique, projets critiques et engagement humain. Entreprise innovante et responsable, nous construisons un environnement éthique, inclusif et tourné vers l'avenir. Ouverts à tous les talents, nous croyons que la diversité est une richesse.

Description du poste :

Véritable chef d'orchestre de l'établissement, vous assurez la performance globale de l'hôtel et de ses activités de restauration. Vous garantissez la qualité de l'expérience client, l'atteinte des objectifs économiques et le développement des équipes.
Pilotage opérationnel
- Assurer la gestion quotidienne de l'hôtel et des activités F&B.
- Garantir un niveau de qualité de service irréprochable.
- Veiller à l'application des standards de qualité, de sécurité et d'hygiène.
- Optimiser l'organisation des services et les parcours clients.
Management des équipes
- Encadrer, animer et accompagner les managers et leurs équipes.
- Développer une culture de performance, d'engagement et de responsabilisation.
- Participer activement au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la montée en compétences des collaborateurs.
Gestion économique et financière
- Construire et piloter les budgets.
- Analyser les indicateurs de performance (CA, GOP, RevPAR, taux d'occupation, masse salariale, coûts F&B Déployer les actions nécessaires à l'amélioration continue des résultats.
Développement commercial
- Développer les ventes hébergement, restauration et séminaires.
- Entretenir les relations avec les partenaires locaux et institutionnels.
- Contribuer à la visibilité et à l'attractivité de l'établissement.
- Proposer, suivre le programme des animations et évènements sportifs

Description du profil :

Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie (au moins 5 ans) de directeur(rice) dans un établissement hôtelier disposant d'une activité restauration significative.
Vous maîtrisez Le management d'équipes pluridisciplinaires.
- Les enjeux de l'hébergement et du revenue management.
- Le pilotage d'une activité F&B.
- L'analyse financière et les indicateurs de performance.
- La gestion de projet et l'accompagnement du changement.
Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre leadership, votre sens du service client, votre capacité à fédérer les équipes, votre exigence opérationnelle et votre culture du résultat.

Per questa posizione, offriamo una retribuzione lorda mensile fino a un massimo di €1.914,90 sul full time (riproporzionato in base al monte ore specificato da contratto) e altre componenti retributive previste dalla legge, se applicabili. Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è CCNL LOGISTICA, TRASPORTO MERCI E SPEDIZIONE (CNEL I100). La posizione è inquadrata al livello 5 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a. Richiesta disponibilità su turni diurni a rotazione, dal lunedì alla domenica con riposi a rotazione. Le opzioni di turno disponibili saranno confermate successivamente nel corso del processo di candidatura. Luogo di lavoro: Via di Valle Caia X, 00040 Ardea (Roma) Principali attività: - Ricevere, controllare, ordinare e riporre tutti i prodotti. - Raccogliere, imballare e spedire tutti gli ordini. Dopo la formazione, potrai anche: - Spostare i prodotti utilizzando carrelli industriali e macchine, come carrelli elevatori e transpallet elettrici. Competenze: - Si può stare in piedi e camminare per un lungo periodo, questo potrebbe essere per più di 8 ore per turno. - Potrebbe essere necessario sollevare e spostare prodotti che pesano fino a 23kg, seguendo le regole di sicurezza. - Potrebbe essere necessario dover essere in grado di sollevare, piegarsi, torcersi, inginocchiarsi e accovacciarsi per la movimentazione della merce. - Potrebbe essere necessario essere in grado di gestire una gamma completa di prodotti Amazon. Questo sito supporta la consegna di prodotti di grandi dimensioni, dalla TV e grandi elettrodomestici ai divani. - Potrebbe essere necessario trascorrere un po' della vostra giornata di lavoro in altezza. jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market
Workplace Experience Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE OVERVIEW

Replit is looking for an experienced Workplace Experience Manager who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and is passionate about creating exceptional workplace experiences. You’ll be the heartbeat of our office operations—managing day-to-day facilities needs, coordinating vendors and landlords, owning events and F&B programs, and leading office planning and moves as we scale.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will build processes where there are none, improve those that exist, and ensure our physical workspace reflects the speed, creativity, and ambition of Replit. You will manage multiple office events throughout the year from start to finish.  You will also support the needs of smaller regional locations to ensure that all our Replit team members have a great experience.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Oversee daily office operations, ensuring a clean, safe, and productive environment for all employees and visitors.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for building management and landlords; manage communication, access, maintenance requests, and building compliance.

 - Develop and maintain workplace policies, procedures, and documentation.

 - Partner with internal stakeholders (People, Sales, Leadership) to plan and execute year round in-office events, such as team offsites, community meetups, celebrations, all-hands, and external guest visits.

 - Manage event logistics including space planning, A/V coordination, catering, and vendor oversight.

 - Oversee daily Food & Beverage operations including snacks, beverages, catered meals, and special event catering.

 - Evaluate usage patterns, manage budgets, and optimize programs for employee satisfaction and efficiency.

 - Support workspace planning, including seating arrangements, space optimization, and future layout needs.

 - MAC experience: lead office moves, expansions, and reconfigurations—from vendor selection to scheduling and day-of coordination.

 - Collaborate with IT and People Ops to ensure smooth onboarding/offboarding processes.

 - Source, negotiate, and manage relationships with vendors across facilities, F&B, cleaning, office supplies, security, and workplace services.

 - Monitor service levels, budgets, and contract terms to ensure high performance and cost-effectiveness.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of experience in office management, workplace operations, or facilities roles in a startup or similarly fast-paced environment.

 - 7+ years of experience and expertise in event planning and execution (small to large-size corporate events).

 - Experience managing F&B programs, including vendor evaluation, budgeting, and procurement.

 - Direct experience coordinating with landlords/building management and handling facilities-related issues.

 - Proven track record of vendor sourcing, negotiation, and ongoing relationship management.

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities and move quickly with limited direction.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity, proactive, solutions-oriented, and able to anticipate operational needs.

 - Ability to work on-site 5 days per week and support occasional early/late hours for events.

 - Experience supporting  regional offices in international locations.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Familiarity with workplace software (e.g., Envoy, Notion, Asana, or similar tools).

 - Experience using AI tools.

 - Background supporting hybrid or distributed teams.

 - Experience overseeing workplace budgets.

 - Passion for Replit’s mission and familiarity with startup culture, developer tools, or community-centric tech companies.

 - Ability to create scalable processes and documentation from scratch.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - A seamless office experience where employees feel supported, energized, and productive.

 - A well-run workplace with strong vendor performance, clear processes, and predictable costs.

 - Events that strengthen team connection and reinforce Replit’s culture.

 - Office operations that scale efficiently as Replit grows.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.description:
Description:


SEB is a leading international financial services group with customer bases among both private individuals and organizations. We are recognized for our expertise and customer-centric approach, which we achieve by listening to our customers, committing to quality and trust, and encouraging an entrepreneurial mindset in everything we do.

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. It is also the base for many of SEB's funds and offers global custody and related depositary services to financial institutions. We are around 150 employees with more than 20 different nationalities and in the midst of further growth and expansion.

PWM&FO offers comprehensive banking services, access to capital markets, financing solutions and individually tailored advisory services. The advisory services are based on SEB's vast range of financing and investment products.

The PWM&FO together with the Investment & Trading Solutions divisions have a full-service investment offering through the areas of discretionary and advisory portfolio management as well as direct trading desk access. The Asset Management Solutions International team manages discretionary mandates across a range of risk levels and currencies for our international client base. PWM&FO have local presence in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Germany, Luxembourg, UK and a representative office in Nice, Zurich and Singapore

We are currently looking for a Portfolio Manager to join our Asset Management Solutions International team in Luxembourg to manage discretionary mandates


About the role

As a Portfolio Manager, you will be responsible for managing individual discretionary mandates, taking part in collectively managing our model strategies and making decisions on asset class allocation and instrument selection in accordance with SEB market view and supported universe. You will also communicate and promote the discretionary service internally and support Client Executives in client and prospect meetings.

You will give input to local and global investment committee and contribute actively to identifying new investment trends, themes and ideas suitable for PWM&FO globally. You will proactively create and present investment ideas based on SEB market outlook and client preferences.

You will support in the client acquisition for discretionary mandates. You will be responsible for the follow- up and communication of the result of implemented investment ideas towards the clients. You will contribute to the continued development of the investment process and investment offering.

You will be based in Luxembourg and be part of the local Asset Management Solutions International Team, as well as part of the global Discretionary Asset Management team. You will be operative towards clients in all PWM&FO geographies. Some travelling may be part of the job.


To thrive in this role, we believe you have

Bachelor's or master's degree in economics, finance, engineering or related field
Several years of professional experience of managing financial assets
Deep understanding of financial markets, financial instruments, investment strategies and portfolio construction characteristics
Strong presentation and communication skills combined with experience from interacting with clients
In-depth understanding of client needs in portfolio management
Strategic mindset and experience of finalizing complex investment decisions in difficult situations
Solid knowledge of regulations and risk management
Fluency in English and Swedish both written and spoken. Additional Nordic languages is a plus


What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

Dynamic and international working environment
Extensive training and development opportunities
Flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of view
Friendly and welcoming working environment
Agile and modern ways of working
Competitive compensation package


Learn more about working at SEB in www.sebgroup.com/career

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.title: Philanthropy Advisor for Private Major Donors - German
jobs.description:
Join MSF OCG as a Philanthropy Advisor!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
As Philanthropy Advisor, you will secure and grow income from individual major donors in German-speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. You will manage a portfolio of assigned donors, build strong and lasting relationships, deepen their engagement with MSF’s social mission, and identify opportunities to increase their support. This includes organising meetings with MSF representatives, sharing relevant information on MSF projects and priorities, coordinating donor events and webinars, presenting funding opportunities, and directly soliciting financial contributions. You will also contribute to the effective use of the CRM system and prospect research to strengthen the team’s fundraising approach.
Tasks & Responsibilities
Qualification, cultivation and stewardship
•    Manages a portfolio of Major donors
•    Is accountable to deliver the best possible experience to MSF key donors in in order to increase their engagement.
•    Qualify each Major Donor and Major Donor prospect, in close cooperation with the Prospect Researcher
•    In coordination with the Team Coordinator, closely liaise with the Middle Donor manager to identify and update potential Major Donors
•    Prepare and facilitate one to one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors or representatives (lawyers, wealth managers, etc.)
•    Establish relations with new potential major donors, including high-potential middle givers and other prospects, including ultra-high-net-worth individuals, to secure significant future support for MSF’s work
•    Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation in an attempt to show them our live saving mission and work in the projects.
•    Define, propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and guidance
•    Ensure that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance policy.
•    Ensure that the moves management runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and steward properly.
•    Keep the database up-to-date
•    Liaise with Writing Officers for the preparation, including proof reading and editing, of project briefings, reports, proposals, slideshows, infographics and any other creative way of presenting MSF and its mission to private major donors
•    Liaise with the Direct Marketing team to adequately leverage marketing appeals and to coordinate touch-points
Solicitation
•    Present and defend MSF’s cases for support to individual major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Lichtenstein.
•    Ensure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.
Information and data management
•    Closely work with the System Support Team to ensure most efficient use of Customer Relationship Management Database
•    Support the Team Coordinator in income forecasting and quarterly analysis of results
Others
•    Participate in the Community of Practice for Individual Major Donors of MSF
•    Work proactively on projects as needed in the Unit, upon request by her/his supervisor.
Your profile
Education
•    University degree in Business Management, Marketing, Communications, Political Science, Law, International Relations or equivalent
Experience
•    Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in similar functions or in the fields of  high-level relational skills, like public relations, wealth management or sales/marketing/communications, high-level advocacy or humanitarian project work
•    Experience in using Microsoft Dynamics or other Customer Relationship Manager System: a plus
•    Experience and knowledge of humanitarian aid: a plus
Languages
•    (Swiss) German (native or equivalent),
•    English
•    French : a plus
•    Italian: a plus
Skills/ Technical competencies
•    Proven writing skills
•    Excellent in oral public presentations
•    Use of data base a plus
Personal Abilities/Qualities
•    Excellent interpersonal skills
•    Rigorous and good organizational skills
•    Empathic, enthusiastic, optimistic
•    Result orientation
•    Team spirit
•    Strong commitment to MSF’s social mission and values
Terms of employment
•    Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
•    Open-ended contract
•    Working place: Zürich
•    Ideal start date: asap
•    Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
•    Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
•    Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
•    Relocation support available for eligible candidates.
How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
•    CV (maximum 2 pages)
•    Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
•    Documents must be submitted in either English or French.
The application deadline is 30th August, 2026.
We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Associate – Treasury Strategy & Technology
jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Treasury. Lead with Innovation.

Treasury functions are undergoing a profound transformation. The convergence of advanced technology, artificial intelligence, and evolving financial landscapes is redefining how global organizations manage liquidity, mitigate risk, and drive strategic value. We're looking for an exceptional Senior Associate to help our clients navigate this transformation - someone who combines deep financial expertise with cutting-edge technology knowledge and a passion for innovation.

What You Can Expect From Us

- Strategic Advisory at the Highest Level: You will advise international corporations on complex treasury, financial risk management, and cash management challenges, with a specific focus on treasury technology, systems architecture, and digital transformation.
- Transformational Impact: You will help drive large-scale, multi-stakeholder transformation initiatives at global companies - reshaping how treasury functions operate, create value, and leverage technology.
- AI & Innovation Leadership: You will be at the forefront of applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to treasury and financial processes - from cash flow forecasting and liquidity optimization to fraud detection, risk modeling, and intelligent automation.
- Thought Leadership: You will provide thought leadership and practical, actionable advice on treasury strategy, financial risk management, regulatory compliance, and the evolving role of technology in finance.
- Efficiency & Value Creation: You will improve the added value, operational efficiency, internal controls, and regulatory compliance of clients' treasury functions and their supporting technology ecosystems.
- Collaborative Excellence: You will collaborate with a diverse, global network of highly talented experts across strategy, technology, risk, and finance - sharing knowledge and building innovative solutions together.
- Diverse, International Environment: You will work across multiple industries, service areas, and geographies in a dynamic and stimulating professional setting.

What We Expect From You

Experience & Qualifications
- 3 - 6 years of relevant professional experience in treasury consulting, treasury technology, financial risk management, or within a corporate treasury function with a strong systems and technology focus.
- University degree (Master's preferred) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
- Professional certification such as CFA, FRM, CTP, or equivalent qualification, demonstrating deep expertise in financial analysis, accounting, and financial risk management.

Technical & Domain Expertise
- Deep financial analysis and risk management skills, including a strong understanding of financial instruments, hedge accounting, valuation methodologies, interest rate and FX risk, and treasury-related accounting standards (IFRS 9, etc.).
- In-depth, hands-on knowledge of at least one leading Treasury Management System (TMS) such as FIS (Quantum/Integrity), Kyriba, Coupa Treasury, ION (IT2/Wallstreet Suite), SAP Treasury, or similar - including implementation, configuration, and optimization experience.
- Familiarity with treasury processes and operations, including cash and liquidity management, bank relationship management, payments and bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host), debt and investment management, and intercompany financing.
- Deep knowledge of the application of AI and machine learning to financial processes, including predictive analytics for cash forecasting, anomaly detection, natural language processing for financial data, robotic process automation (RPA), and the integration of intelligent solutions into treasury workflows.
- Understanding of the broader treasury technology ecosystem, including ERP integration, data architecture, API connectivity, cloud-based solutions, and emerging fintech platforms.

Personal & Professional Attributes
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to synthesize complex financial, operational, and technical information into clear, compelling recommendations.
- Strong presentation and communication skills, with confidence and credibility when interacting with senior client stakeholders, including C-suite executives and treasury leadership.
- An advisory and team-oriented mindset - you take ownership of workstreams, mentor junior team members, foster innovative thinking, and contribute to a culture of excellence.
- Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of cross-functional, international teams.
- Fluent English (written and spoken) is required; German, French, or any additional language is a strong plus.
- A commitment to expanding our global business network and leveraging your personal and professional relationships to create opportunities and deepen client trust.

Why This Role?
This is not just a consulting role - it's an opportunity to sit at the intersection of finance and technology during one of the most exciting periods of transformation in corporate treasury. You will work on challenges that matter, with people who inspire, for clients who are shaping the global economy.

jobs.description:
Credit Control Officer  
Credit Control Officer  
Location Geneva  
Start date Immediate  
Activity rate 100%  
Reporting line Head of Credit Control  
About BCP  
Established in 1963 as a Swiss Bank, BCP segments its activities into two well\-established core businesses: Commodity Trade Finance and Wealth Management. These are reinforced by our expert Treasury services. BCP enjoys a solid reputation as a high\-quality service provider in all of its banking fields. Founded under Swiss Banking Law and Regulations, BCP is supervised by FINMA, the Swiss financial markets supervisory authority. Headquartered in Geneva, BCP also operates branches in Luxembourg and in Dubai.  
More information can be found at  
About the role  
As a Credit Control Officer, you will play a key role in safeguarding the Bank's credit portfolio by providing independent oversight and control over Commodity Trade Finance and Wealth Management credit facilities. Working closely with the Front Office, Credit Risk and Operations teams, you will contribute to the sound management of complex credit transactions, ensuring compliance with the Bank's risk appetite, internal policies and regulatory requirements. This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, analytical thinking and business partnering within a dynamic international banking environment.  
Key responsibilities  
Perform independent controls over credit facilities, transactional exposures and clients' economic positions, including the assessment of hedging structures and overall risk exposure.  
Ensure ongoing monitoring of Commodity Trade Finance (CTF) and Wealth Management (WM) credit facilities in accordance with the Bank's control framework, internal policies and regulatory requirements.  
Partner closely with the Front Office and Credit Analysts by providing independent oversight on the structuring, renewal and lifecycle management of Commodity Trade Finance credit facilities.  
Support the monitoring and renewal of WM lending facilities while strengthening independent control processes across the portfolio.  
Prepare \& review credit documentation, identify control gaps and escalate potential risks or exceptions in a timely manner.  
Ensure the execution and continuous improvement of credit control administrative related tasks.  
Contribute to the continuous enhancement of Credit Control best practices, processes, procedures and governance.  
Prepare accurate management reports, credit monitoring documentation and regulatory information within established deadlines.  
Participate in cross\-functional initiatives and projects, including process optimisation, system enhancements and IT\-related developments.  
Foster close collaboration with internal stakeholders to promote a strong risk culture and operational excellence.  
Your profile  
University degree or professional qualification in Banking, Finance, Economics or another relevant discipline.  
8 to 10 years of experience within an international bank, ideally as a Transaction Manager, Trade Finance Risk Manager or in a similar control function with significant exposure to Commodity Trade Finance.  
Good understanding of credit risk principles, exposure monitoring and hedging mechanisms.  
Strong organizational skills and analytical mindset \- able to challenge, identify risks and propose practical solutions.  
Ability to work autonomously, and perform effectively under pressure with a high level of accuracy.  
Good accounting and financial analysis skills.  
Strong communication skills, in both English and French (written and spoken).  
Proficient in standard banking systems and Microsoft Office applications.  
Swiss residency mandatory.  
What we offer  
A dynamic and multicultural work inclusive culture where empowerment and creativity are competitive compensation from home (one day per week).  
Application process  
Please submit your résumé via JobUp.  
Response timeframe  
If you do not receive a response from us within three weeks, please consider that your application was not selected for this position. We appreciate your understanding.

jobs.title: Head of Accounting & Controlling CDI 80% - 100%
jobs.description:
About Us
Founded in 1892, the International Skating Union (ISU) is the oldest international winter sports Federation and the second oldest International Sports Federation. The ISU is recognized by the International Olympic Committee, governing the sports of Figure Skating and Speed Skating.
Today, the ISU’s vision is a world where everyone can experience and enjoy the thrill of skating and our mission is to sustainably grow and improve our sport by prioritizing our skaters, engaging our fans, nurturing partnerships and inspiring communities.

Our DNA is to be Inspiring, Supportive, Unstoppable.


The Role
The Head of Accounting & Controlling is responsible for leading the ISU's accounting and financial control functions, ensuring the integrity of financial reporting, maintaining an effective internal control framework, and overseeing treasury activities. Reporting to the Chief - Finance & Operations, the role manages a small finance team and plays a key role in supporting governance, risk management, and strategic financial decision-making.


Key Responsabilities

Accounting & Financial Operations
•    Lead, mentor and develop the accounting team responsible for the day-to-day finance operations.
•    Ensure the accurate and timely processing of all accounting transactions, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, fixed assets and statutory reporting.
•    Oversee the year-end closing processes and ensure that soft closes take place on at least a quarterly basis.
•    Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements and ISU policies.
•    Continuously improve accounting processes, controls and reporting efficiency.

Financial Control & Internal Controls
•    Maintain and continuously enhance the ISU's internal control environment.
•    Develop, implement and monitor financial policies and procedures to ensure compliance and operational effectiveness.
•    Identify financial and operational risks and implement appropriate mitigating controls.
•    Support the implementation of best practices in governance and financial controls.

Treasury Management
•    Monitor the ISU's liquidity and working capital position.
•    Oversee daily treasury activities, including cash management, payment approvals and banking relationships.
•    Propose and implement appropriate FX hedging solutions
•    Prepare and monitor cash flow forecasts and funding requirements.
•    Support the optimisation of working capital and cash management processes.

Audit & Governance
•    Lead the preparation and coordination of the annual external audit.
•    Act as the primary liaison with external auditors and coordinate the timely resolution of audit findings.
•    Support the Chief - Finance & Operations in coordinating the activities of the Audit, Risk and Investment Committee.
•    Prepare financial reports, presentations and supporting documentation for

Executive Management, ISU Council and ISU Congress.
•    Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and internal control improvements.
Business Partnership
•    Provide high-quality financial analysis and advice to senior management.
•    Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes.
•    Support strategic initiatives through financial analysis and business insights.
•    Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and collaboration within the finance function.


Essential Requirements
•    Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
•    Professional accounting qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CA or equivalent) preferred.
•    Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive experience in accounting, controlling or finance, including experience in a leadership role.
•    Demonstrated experience managing a small finance or accounting team.
•    Strong knowledge of financial reporting, internal controls and treasury management.
•    Experience coordinating external audits and interacting with auditors.
•    Strong understanding of corporate governance and risk management principles.
•    Experience with Microsoft Business Central (MSBC) ERP is highly desirable.
•    Experience in implementing or evolving ERP systems.


Desirable
•    Strong leadership and people management skills.
•    Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
•    High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
•    Strong organisational and project management skills.
•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•    Driven by process improvement and open to technological advancement and automation.
•    Ability to build effective relationships with cross-functional colleagues, auditor and banking partners.
•    Fluent in English. Comfortable working in French language environment with with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting systems.


Key Success Measures
•    Timely and accurate financial reporting.
•    Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.
•    Strong and well-documented internal control environment.
•    Successful completion of annual audits with minimal findings.
•    Effective cash flow and treasury management.
•    High-quality reporting and support provided to Executive Management.
•    Continuous improvement of finance processes, governance and operational efficiency.


Why Join Us
Be part of the International Skating Union and make a direct impact on global skating events. Work closely with senior leadership in a dynamic, international environment where your financial and strategic expertise shapes key organizational decisions.


What We Offer
•    A unique opportunity to contribute to the financial planning and strategic coordination of a global sports federation.
•    Exposure to senior leadership and organizational decision-making.
•    A dynamic and international working environment in Lausanne.
•    The chance to support the development of global skating events and initiatives.


How to Apply

If you are eager to contribute to the ISU’s strategic projects and enhance your experience in global sports leadership, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV to jobs@isu.org with the subject line:
Head of Accounting and Controlling – [Your Name]

Former athletes and skaters are strongly encouraged to apply, as their unique experiences are highly valued.

The International Skating Union (ISU) is seeking a Financial Planning & Analysis Manager to support the organization in strengthening financial visibility, budget management, event delivery oversight and cross-departmental project execution.

Working transversally across the organization, and especially with the ISU Events Department, the successful candidate will contribute to financial planning cycles and financial performance monitoring across the organization.

Corporate Financial Planning & Strategic Analysis
•    Lead the preparation and consolidation of the ISU’s annual budget and financial forecasts.

•    Develop management dashboards and reporting tools to improve financial transparency across departments.

•    Work with department heads to ensure alignment between operational plans and financial resources.

jobs.title: Merchandising Execution Associate MARLBOROUGH
jobs.description:
Are you someone who thrives on helping others succeed, enjoys making an impact, and takes pride in guiding customers to the right solutions for their projects? If youâre also naturally curious and eager to keep learning, consider starting or growing your career with us at The Home Depot.

Position Overview

Merchandising Execution Associates (MEAs) perform in-store merchandising service activities such as merchandising projects, planogram maintenance, overhead organization, and display/signage maintenance designed to enhance the customer experience. MEAs execute merchandising strategies and ensure product is displayed correctly to drive sales and maximize inventory turns. MEAs work in teams with on-site supervision, and provide service to multiple departments in the stores. These associates execute approved general bay service, tasking, projects and resets safely, accurately and efficiently. MEAs must build and maintain strong relationships with store associates and provide superior customer service to both internal and external customers.

Key Responsibilities

Merchandising: General Service, Tasking, Packdown, and Projects

  • Read and interpret directions to ensure merchandise is set to the planogram, project instructions, program service requirements and general service guidelines
  • Straighten, clean and merchandise product to ensure merchandise is presented in a visually appealing manner
  • Maintain copy of most recent planogram inside upright beam adjacent to product set
  • Build displays and fixtures using basic hand tools
  • Maintain, order, and install display material/signage/brochures
  • Follow directions and processes to conduct accurate price and label changes. Replace incorrect, damaged, or missing price labels.
  • Maintain aisle
  • Utilize store systems to access key merchandising reports. Read, interpret, and execute action based on findings.
  • Maintain bay service records and other documentation as directed.
  • Execute one off projects as required by store, district, and regional leadership.

Customer Service

  • Maintain aisle cleanliness so that merchandise is accessible and customers are able to move throughout the aisles easily
  • Partner with store leadership to markdown all damaged or un-sellable merchandise
  • Answer questions regarding the store and products for the customers.
  • Partner with store associates to find necessary products to fit the customer's needs.

Other

  • Partner with store representative to conduct inspections of returned and damaged items for Return to Vendor.
  • Follow standard operating and safety procedures.
  • Complete assigned training curriculum
  • Other duties as assigned

Competencies

  • Action Oriented
  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality

Skills

  • Basic computer skills with knowledge of web based applications.
  • Interpersonal skills, working on teams, with heavy reliance on team to accomplish goals.
  • Follows safety policies and procedures. Identifies and corrects safety hazards.
  • Attention to Detail: Stays attentive and aware, catches errors before completing assignments, and maintains high quality standard for work.
  • Drives Execution & Self Motivated: Demonstrates the ability to deliver results without close supervision despite a large workload, competing demands, and fast paced environment. Ensures tasks are completed on time, without error, and meet quality standards.

Direct Manager/Direct Reports

  • Reports to Merchandising Execution Supervisor (MEAS)

Travel Requirements

  • No travel requirements for this role

Physical Requirements

  • Bending, stooping, reaching, twisting, lifting, pushing, pulling, and moving items

Working Conditions

  • Working within a flexible schedule that typically starts early in the morning
  • Warehouse environment that can be dusty and noisy
  • Doors are frequently open, causing drafts and interior temperature changes

Minimum Education

  • GED
  • Highschool Diploma or Equivalent

Minimum Years Of Work Experience

Certifications

Other Requirements/Assets

  • 1 year of relevant working experience

jobs.title: Développeur / Expert Keycloak & Java (IAM & MFA) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Au sein de l'équipe Sécurité & Identité (IAM / CIAM), vous serez responsable de la conception, de la personnalisation et de l'intégration de la solution d'authentification et de gestion des accès Keycloak. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'implémentation de parcours d'authentification sécurisés (MFA) et le développement de modules Java sur mesure.

Missions Principales
- Développement & Personnalisation Keycloak : Développement de SPI (Service Provider Interfaces), d'authentificateurs personnalisés, d'évènements et d'extensions en Java / Jakarta EE.
- Authentification & MFA : Configuration, personnalisation et intégration de flux d'authentification forte (MFA, WebAuthn, TOTP, SMS, OTP) et gestion des politiques de sécurité.
- Intégration IAM / CIAM : Configuration des Realms, des clients (OpenID Connect / OAuth2, SAML v2) et fédération d'identités (LDAP, Active Directory, Identity Providers externes).
- Personnalisation UI/UX : Adaptation des thèmes de connexion et du parcours utilisateur (Freemarker, HTML/CSS, JavaScript).

MCO :
- Maintien en condition opérationnelle
- Montées de version Keycloak
- Écriture de tests et intégration dans les pipelines CI/CD (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm).

Compétences techniques obligatoires :
Java 11+ / Jakarta EE : Développement d'extensions / SPI pour Keycloak.
Keycloak (Core) : Maîtrise des concepts d'Authentication Flows, Execution Steps, SPI (Authenticator, EventListenerProvider, UserStorageProvider).
Sécurité & MFA : Implémentation du MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, OTP personnalisés).

Les plus appréciés : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Operator, Quarkus.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, SSCS: Supply Chain
User Researcher, Growth
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re seeking an experienced User Researcher to shape growth-related product decisions by delivering insights that fuel AI experiences. This role blends traditional growth research, such as adoption, monetization, and pricing and packaging, with fast-evolving AI features like Notion Agent and Chat that permeate experiences like onboarding and Workspace creation. It requires a unique mix of user research expertise, strategic foresight, and technical fluency in AI and AI product development.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Design and execute studies that evaluate how people experience Notion with AI in the loop, including how users discover, trust, and get value from AI, and identify barriers to adoption and willingness to pay.

 - Run mixed-methods research (qual + quant), including interviews, concept testing, prototype/usability testing, diary studies, surveys, and advanced quantitative pricing studies — leveraging AI tooling to scale your research process and work.

 - Deliver actionable insights that enable us to deeply understand our customers, identify business opportunities, and drive decision-making — leveraging AI to scale your reporting, sharing, and overall impact.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - AI fluency: You’re curious and hands-on with AI products — and can reason about how AI behavior shapes product experience.

 - Systems thinking - You can understand complex user journeys and growth engines (including the parts users don't see), and identify where experiences breakdown across the system.

 - Business mindedness: You connect research to business outcomes and can articulate why an insight matters for strategy, growth, and/or revenue.

 - Data fluency: You know how to understand and leverage experimentation, and how to use behavioral data to sharpen research questions and interpret results.

 - Pragmatism: You have experience prioritizing and doing research in fast-moving 0→1 environments, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative.

 - Communication: You evolve how your share research according to the audiences and like getting creative in how you share your insights (ex: videos, podcasts, workshops, etc.)

 - Experience: 5+ years doing UX research in industry




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience researching AI-enabled products (especially agentic/workflow automation), growth journeys, and B2B products

 - Expertise conducting research with AI research tools (Outset, Listen Labs, Dovetail, etc.)

 - Masters or PhD Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Behavioral Economics, Anthropology, Sociology, or similar.

 - Experience communicating research to executive stakeholders.

 - You’re familiar with the work of computing heroes like Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, Bret Victor, etc. — and understand why we're big fans.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $196,000 - $230,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

ETSIMME PORIIN JA LÄHIALUEILLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON
