Anställning kommer att ske löpande så tveka inte på att skicka in din ansöka, kanske är det just dig vi söker!

Om rollen

Som kundservicemedarbetare arbetar du med inkommande kundärenden via telefon. Du hjälper kunder på ett professionellt och effektivt sätt, där kvalitet och bemötande alltid står i fokus.

I rollen kan arbetstiderna variera mellan dag, kväll och natt beroende på vilket projekt du tilldelas.

Arbetet innebär bland annat att:

    Hantera bokningar och avbokningar
    Hjälpa både privat- och företagskunder
    Arbeta mot tydliga mål kopplade till kundnöjdhet och effektivitet

Du blir en viktig del av teamet där din insats direkt påverkar både kundupplevelsen och resultatet.

Vi erbjuder

    Heltidstjänst med stegrande lön
    20 dagars betald semester per år
    Betald introduktion och utbildning
    Möjlighet att utvecklas och göra karriär inom bolaget
    En arbetsplats med stark gemenskap och högt engagemang
    Möjlighet att bo och arbeta i Spanien
    Hjälp med spanska dokument (NIE & socialförsäkring)
    Bostadshjälp där vi hjälper dig med kontaktuppgifter till både mäklare och hyresvärdar.

Vi söker dig som

    Är noggrann, strukturerad och stresstålig
    Trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo
    Är bekväm med telefon och dator som arbetsverktyg
    Behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift samt har grundläggande engelska
    Är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter verksamhetens behov

Är du rätt person för jobbet?

Tjänsten passar dig som är redo att göra något nytt, hitta en ny vardag eller utvecklas snabbt inom kundservice. Du är positiv, målinriktad och arbetar effektivt mot uppsatta mål med hög kvalité. Den viktigaste pelaren på Nordic Operation Center är vår kultur. Vår vision är att bygga ett andra hem för vårt team där vi alltid sätter våra medarbetare i fokus.

Tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande men inget krav. Är du vårt nästa stjärnskott eller har du det som krävs för att bli det? Vi söker efter nya stjärnor men vi är också med och skapar dem från grunden!

jobs.title: Electrician Royal Beach Club
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Electrician specializes in the maintenance and safe operation of all electrical equipment on the Private Destination, this includes high voltage equipment. This role diagnoses issues, fixes equipment, and maintains records of inspections. This position demonstrates exemplary skills in overhauling and maintaining all electrical equipment. The Electrician follows all safety protocols to ensure the safety of Guests, visitors, and fellow Team Members. This role is committed to a safety-first culture to ensure optimum safety for Guests, Visitors, and Team Members.

All duties and responsibilities are performed following Companyâs Brand Standards, the Royal Way philosophy, policies, and SOPs, public health, safety, security, and environmental guidelines.

This Job Description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties performed by the Team Member occupying this position. All Team Members may be required to perform any other job-related duties assigned by their Supervisor or Management. The nature of this job requires daily interactions with internal and external stakeholders.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ensures safe operation of all electrical equipment in the kitchen venues and laundry rooms.
  • Performs maintenance on electrical vehicles, e-trams, and e-bikes, heavy machinery, and boats.
  • Understands the CCTV/Data System and fixes the issues.
  • Performs Fire Alarm System inspections and maintenance.
  • Inspects and ensures the Audio & Video System (Videlio) are in working condition.
  • Sets up and maintains the satellite dish system and TV units in the accommodation, offices, and venues.
  • Ensures the weather stations antenna is in working condition for daily operation.
  • Assists Supervisor to work on high voltage equipment.
  • Follows safety protocols while working with electrical equipment, ensuring the own safety and safety of others.
  • Demonstrate a safety-first culture and follows the Companyâs policies and procedures.
  • Determines the suitability and appropriateness of all electrical equipment newly acquired or in operation.
  • Understands how to use electrical system documentation such as drawings, service, and instruction manuals.
  • Determines if all components and parts used in the electrical systems are covered by the AMOS maintenance jobs and advises the Electronic Manager of any discrepancies.
  • Responds to, diagnoses, and fixes electrical issues. Applies safety regulations and safety practices at all times.
  • Reads work orders, maintains records of daily tasks, and discusses challenges with the Electronic Manager.
  • Ensure that all electrical spare parts are available in ample quantity to perform the job safely.
  • Uses clear, concise, and professional communication in person, over the radio, and in written format.
  • Demonstrates effective teamwork and collaboration, and time management skills.
  • Maintains an orderly and clean work area, with all tools in good repair.
  • Adheres to all Company policies regarding PPE and Chemical Management.
  • Sets up and closes working areas as per schedule or as instructed by the Management Team.
  • Participates in trainings and meetings. Adheres to a Company confidentiality agreement.
  • Follows the destinationâs grooming standards. Ensures personal appearance, hygiene, and uniform appearance are always in accordance with Company policy. Maintains a safe and sanitary environment for Guests and the Team.
  • Acknowledges and greets Guests, visitors, and Team Members in public spaces with a warm, friendly greeting.


Financial Responsibilities

  • Maintains the inventory of tools and equipment.
  • Determines inventory and compiles a bi-weekly list of all supplies/tools needed.


Qualifications:

  • A High School Diploma or basic education equivalency.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of progressive technical experience and training in a resort or marine environment.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of operational experience with electrical equipment, including power generation, sewage treatment plants, incinerators, potable water production, satellite communications, and operating equipment.
  • Advanced knowledge of electrical systems, needs assessment, problem resolution, and quality standards.
  • Valid license or certificate(s) in the area of technical specialty are required.
  • Good interpersonal skills to communicate with all levels of Management and Team Members.
  • Ability to work positively and cooperatively in a diverse international environment.
  • Ability to maintain focus, work with strict deadlines, multitask and be flexible and adaptable.


Language Requirements:

  • Ability to speak English clearly, distinctly, and cordially with Guests, Team Members, Contractors, and Vendors.
  • Ability to read and write English, to understand and interpret written procedures. This includes the ability to give and receive instructions in written and verbal forms and to effectively present information and respond to questions from Guests, Managers, and Team Members.


Physical Requirements:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to touch, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and taste and smell. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • All destination Team Members must be physically able to participate in emergency life-saving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal, and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency.


Work Environment:

  • Destination outdoor environment where high temperature, precipitation, and humid temperatures are experienced.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is required to work outdoors in extremely humid and hot conditions for an extended period of time.

This is a position where duties are exercised outdoors, walking in sand, and uneven surfaces, and high scaffolding.

- Huolehtimaan asiakkaidemme asuntosijoituksiin liittyvistä välityskohteista

jobs.title: Teknisk Driftskoordinator - ejendomsdrift i servicefirma
jobs.description:
Har du styr på bygningsdrift og kendskab til byggegarantier? Drømmer du om at arbejde i en central rolle indenfor ejendomsdrift og som tæt sparringspartner for kollegaer? Trives du i en hverdag, hvor du primært arbejder fra kontoret i Silkeborg, men også af og til er ude på besigtigelser?

Så vil vi rigtig gerne lære dig bedre at kende!

Hos Dalbøges Ejendomsservice får vi flere opgaver og derfor søger vi en ny kollega, som får en central rolle i den daglige drift af de ejendomme, vi passer.

Du bliver bindeled mellem vores dygtige viceværter og kunder. Nogle dage er du ude og besigtige en ejendom, følger op på garantisager eller flyttesynsopgørelser. Andre dage sidder du på kontoret og udarbejder tilbud, planlægger opgaver eller hjælper med at få en ny ejendom godt i gang.

Det er en alsidig rolle med stor frihed og et stort ansvar – men uden store armbevægelser. Hos os er alle en vigtig del af holdet.

HVORFOR ER DET LIGE NETOP DIG, VI ER PÅ UDKIG EFTER?

Du tager ansvar og får tingene til at ske.

Du bevarer overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften, og du trives med at finde løsninger sammen med både kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·         Har erfaring med ejendomsdrift, bygningsdrift eller facility management.

·         Har en god teknisk forståelse og gerne en håndværksmæssig eller byggeteknisk baggrund.

·         Har arbejdet med tekniske gennemgange, mangellister og/eller garantisager.

·         Har forståelse for flyttesyn og processerne rundt om synene.

·         Har lyst til at være den, som viceværterne kan sparre med i hverdagen, og sætter en ære i at deres opgaver er godt koordineret.

·         Er god til at skabe overblik og følge op på opgaver.

·         Er serviceminded og god til at skabe tillid hos kunderne.

·         Er fortrolig med almindelige IT-systemer og Office 365.

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvilken titel du har i dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, skabe struktur og være med til at udvikle vores forretning.

HVILKE OPGAVER KAN DU SE FREM TIL?

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

·         Sparring og planlægning af opgaver sammen med vores viceværter.

·         Besigtigelse af ejendomme, og udarbejdelse af tilbud og serviceaftaler.

·         Opstart af nye ejendomme og sikring af en god overgang til den daglige drift.

·         Håndtering og opfølgning på garantisager og mangler overfor entreprenører.

·         Dialog med kunder, håndværkere og samarbejdspartnere.

·         Løbende udvikling af vores arbejdsgange og kvaliteten i driften.

HVEM ER VI?

Vi er Dalbøges Ejendomsservice og vi leverer professionel ejendomsservice til udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og erhvervskunder.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, en del af PHM Group og har flere Gazelle-priser bag os. Samtidig har vi bevaret en kultur, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og hvor alle hjælper hinanden.

Hos os er der ikke langt fra tanke til beslutning. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar, sund fornuft og ordentlighed – både over for kunderne og hinanden.

DET MED SMÅT

Din daglige base bliver vores kontor i Silkeborg, men en del af arbejdstiden vil foregå ude på de ejendomme vi passer. Du vil blandt andet være med til at starte nye ejendomme i Aalborg, når vi udvider vores aktiviteter.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med stor fleksibilitet, gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid.

VIL DU MED?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning.

Send os i stedet dit CV og et par linjer om, hvorfor du synes, jobbet lyder spændende.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

jobs.description:
Vil du være med på en spændende vækstrejse i et moderne advokatfirma?

Globe Advokater er et ambitiøst og dynamisk advokatfirma med kontor i hjertet af København. Vi er særligt kendt for vores stærke profil inden for udlændingeret og rådgiver både private, virksomheder og internationale klienter i komplekse juridiske problemstillinger.

Samtidig er vi i gang med at udvide vores forretningsområder og arbejder i stigende grad med blandt andet ejendomshandler, familie- og arveret, straffesager og bistandssager. Vi har fokus på høj faglighed, effektiv sagsbehandling og en nærværende klientoplevelse.

Vi oplever stor aktivitet og søger derfor en dygtig og engageret advokatsekretær på 30-37 timer om ugen, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores fortsatte udvikling.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Sekretærbetjening og administrativ sagsbehandling

  • Kontakt med klienter, myndigheder og samarbejdspartnere

  • Udarbejdelse af juridiske dokumenter og korrespondance

  • Kalenderstyring, dokumenthåndtering og øvrige administrative opgaver

  • Oprettelse og håndtering af sager samt understøttelse af kontorets advokater

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som advokatsekretær eller fra en lignende stilling

  • Er struktureret, serviceminded og arbejder selvstændigt

  • Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formuleringsevner

  • Trives i et travlt miljø og har sans for detaljen

  • Har lyst til at være en del af et mindre, ambitiøst team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og får stor indflydelse på hverdagen

Det vil være et stort plus, hvis du tidligere har arbejdet med:

  • Ejendomshandler

  • Bistandssager

  • Straffesager

  • Familie- og arveretlige dokumenter

  • Sagsportalen og digitale sagsgange generelt

Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Legis, da vi anvender systemet i vores daglige sagsbehandling og ønsker en medarbejder, der kan bidrage aktivt til at udvikle og optimere vores arbejdsgange.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor selvstændighed og ansvar

  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen i et advokatfirma i vækst

  • Et uformelt, fleksibelt og ambitiøst arbejdsmiljø

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kollegaer

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

Ansøgning
Send din ansøgning og CV til info@globeadvokater.dk. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Ansøgningsfrist er den 17. august 2026.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:
  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Project assistant: Formulation development of novel tuberculosis compounds into long acting injectables at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A two-year position within pharmaceutical sciences focusing on formulation development and biopharmaceutical understanding of the performance of novel compounds for the treatment of tuberculosis is available at the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Pharmacy in the pharmacy research group. 

Starting date: 01 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Project background

Long-acting injectables (LAIs) are pharmaceutical products intended for weekly, monthly or with an even lower administration frequency, which provides a continued drug release and thereby a steady exposure of the delivered compound. LAIs are typically administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) as oil solutions, in situ forming gels, microspheres, implants, micro- or nanosuspensions, with focus on suspensions in the present work. For individuals suffering of tuberculosis LAIs can provide a huge benefit in disease treatment, due to the long duration time the disease requires. 

LAIs have, with huge clinical success, been applied in the treatment of antipsychotic conditions and the area contains some of the most successful LAI formulations seen from a therapeutic perspective. In the 1960s, oil-based parenteral depot formulations, containing antipsychotics, were introduced in the clinical practice. Since then, the micro- and nanosuspension technology has significantly advanced and many of the more recent LAIs are nano-or microsuspensions. Hence, this is currently one of the important technologies in the field of LAIs and also the focus of the present project. 

The common approach to manipulate the performance of LAI suspensions release rate relies on changing particle size distribution of the crystalline API. This strategy is fundamentally explained by the Noyes-Whitney equation, which describes the dissolution rate of particles in sink conditions. According to the Noyes-Whitney equation, the dissolution rate is proportional to the total surface area of the drug particles. Some commercial products confirms thus and also a few academical studies have reported correlations between the particle size and the in vivo release, hence it is clearly a point that should be clarified when working with a new compound for a LAI suspension. Aside from particle size, other formulation aspects can significantly impact performance, such as formulation composition and the level of flocculation. In addition, API crystal form properties, such as morphology, level of amorphous contents and residual solvent in the API, may have a significant impact on dissolution, indicating that the selection of version and form is crucial not only for manufacturability and stability purposes, but also for performance.

This project aligns closely with Quality by Design (QbD) principles, emphasizing risk assessment, formulation understanding, and robust design space development, but systematically investigating the formulation impact on in vivo release of LAI suspensions in nonclinical models using the obtained data to generate a risk matrix for in vivo impact of potential particle size variations. A successful outcome of this project will provide a formulation that can be taken to clinical trials for the treatment of tuberculosis with the tools to understand the biopharmaceutical performance of LAI suspensions with the relevant compounds supported by quality tools on the stability. 

The work will be conducted in close cooperation with Professor René Holm and other colleagues working on the project.

Qualifications

  • We are looking for a candidate with a strong interest in working with pharmaceutical formulation and evaluation focused on formulation and characterization of suspensions. 

  • The candidate will hold a BSc, a M.Sc. in pharmacy, chemistry, or closely related area. 

  • Previous experiences with one or more of the following are considered an advantage: 

    • formulation design of suspensions, 

    • particle size characterization, 

    • chemical stability studies,

    •  bioanalysis, and 

    • in vivo studies.

The candidate must be independent and fluent in English both orally and written. 

For further information about the position please contact Professor René Holm (reho@sdu.dk).

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääkaupunkiseudulla ja vaihtelevat projektien mukaan. Työ on monipuolista ja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kartuttaa osaamistasi erilaisissa rakennusalan kohteissa.

Työaika on pääsääntöisesti arkisin klo 7.00–15.30, noin 40 tuntia viikossa. Työpäivien pituudessa voi esiintyä satunnaista vaihtelua projektien mukaan.

Palkkaus määräytyy rakennusalan työehtosopimuksen sekä kokemuksesi mukaisesti.

Toivomme sinulta

Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta telineasennuksista tai muista rakennusalan asennustehtävistä, mutta huomioimme haussa myös motivoituneet hakijat, joilla on halu oppia uusi ammatti.

Odotamme sinulta:

- hyvää fyysistä kuntoa

- vastuullista ja turvallista työotetta

- valmiutta työskennellä korkealla

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- sujuvaa yhteistyökykyä.

- omaa autoa työkohteisiin siirtymisen helpottamiseksi


Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme:

- monipuolisen ja fyysisen työn vaihtelevissa kohteissa

- kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään

- ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen

- laadukkaat työvaatteet ja työvarusteet

- rakennusalan TES mukaisen palkkauksen

- mahdollisuuden pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen

- Click Henkilöstöpalveluiden oman yhteyshenkilön tuen koko työsuhteen ajan.


Työ alkaa vuokratyösuhteella, ja hyvin sujuneen yhteistyön jatkuessa työsuhteen on mahdollista jatkua asiakasyrityksessä.

Kiinnostuitko?

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian ja kerro siinä aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi sekä osaamisestasi. Liitä mukaan myös ansioluettelosi. Jos uskot olevasi etsimämme henkilö, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta tai lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi Click Henkilöstöpalveluiden Jan Kollinille. Sähköpostiosoitteemme ovat muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Jan Kollin, Click Henkilöstöpalvelut, arkisin klo 9–16, puh. 050 411 0390.

Odotamme hakemustasi!

jobs.title: Architecte du bâtiment (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoignez le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un Architecte Responsable d'Agence capable d'allier expertise technique, pilotage de projets et esprit entrepreneurial.
Votre mission
Rattaché à la Direction Générale du groupe, vous assurez la responsabilité technique et opérationnelle de l'agence de Barcelone.
Vous intervenez sur les projets de l'esquisse jusqu'à la réalisation, tout en participant à la structuration de l'activité locale, à la coordination des équipes et au développement futur du pôle Barcelone.
Vos principales responsabilités
Expertise technique et suivi des projets
- Assurer la mise au point des projets de l'esquisse au DCE : plans, coupes, façades, carnets de détails ;
- Établir et superviser les pièces écrites et graphiques relatives aux dossiers administratifs : PC, PA, permis de démolir ;
- Produire et suivre les pièces graphiques relatives aux marchés de travaux ;
- Gérer, coordonner et synthétiser les éléments des différents intervenants : maîtrise d'ouvrage, services d'urbanisme, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle, partenaires techniques ;
- Analyser la faisabilité technique des projets et proposer des solutions adaptées.
Développement, coordination et management
- Participer à la structuration de l'agence de Barcelone et de ses méthodes de travail ;
- Contribuer au recrutement, à l'intégration et au pilotage progressif des futures équipes ;
- Développer un réseau de partenaires et représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur ;
- Participer au développement de nouvelles activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives innovantes.
Profil recherché
- Formation Architecte ou équivalent ;
- Expérience confirmée en cabinet d'architecture, bureau d'études, ingénierie, construction ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne connaissance de la réglementation bâtiment : ERP, RT 2012, RE 2020, Code du Travail, ICPE, PMR, CDAC/CNAC ;
- Maîtrise des outils professionnels : Autocad, Revit, Photoshop, SketchUp, BIM ou équivalent ;
- Expérience en coordination de projets, pilotage d'activité ou management appréciée ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, autonomie et capacité à structurer une activité locale ;
- Rigueur, réactivité, sens du relationnel et goût pour le travail en équipe ;
- Goût pour l'innovation constructive et les environnements internationaux.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compétence technique, nous recherchons une personne capable de s'investir durablement dans un projet ambitieux, avec l'envie de participer activement à la construction et au développement d'une organisation appelée à jouer un rôle stratégique dans la croissance du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration :
- CDI ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des partenaires du groupe ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: Cleaning Inspector/Service Manager
jobs.description:
Cleaning Inspector (Quality Control Inspector)

We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Cleaning Inspector to join our professional cleaning company in Denmark.

As a Cleaning Inspector, you will be responsible for ensuring that residential and commercial cleaning services meet the

company's quality standards. You will conduct inspections after cleaning, identify areas that require improvement, provide

feedback to cleaning staff, and ensure customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

* Inspect completed cleaning work at residential and commercial properties.

* Ensure all cleaning tasks meet company quality standards.

* Report any issues and follow up on corrective actions.

* Train and guide cleaning staff on proper cleaning procedures and quality expectations.

* Communicate professionally with clients when necessary.

* Complete inspection reports using a mobile phone or tablet.

* Monitor cleaners' performance and maintain high service standards.

Requirements:

* Previous experience in professional cleaning or quality inspection is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and high standards of cleanliness.

* Good communication skills in English (Danish is an advantage but not required).

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple locations.

* Valid driver's license is an advantage.

* Reliable, responsible, and punctual.

We Offer:

* Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

* 37 Hours per week

Training and career development opportunities. A supportive and professional work environment.

* Opportunity to grow within a fast-growing cleaning company.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in delivering excellent quality and ensuring every client receives outstanding service.

jobs.title: Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen, 15 to 37 hours a week
jobs.description:
Job title:
Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen. No experience required.

The job

You stand in Copenhagen and stop strangers. You have thirty seconds to make them care about something that matters, and then you ask them to put their money where their heart is.

Most walk past. Some stop. A few say yes, and those are the ones that fund real work by real organisations.

It is the oldest job there is: convince a human being, face to face, with nothing but your voice.

What you actually get out of it

Forget the job. Here is the skill.

By month three you will be able to walk up to anyone, anywhere, and start a conversation that goes somewhere. You will be able to hear no fifteen times and go straight into the sixteenth conversation without flinching. You will know how to ask for something and get it.

Almost nobody has that. The people who do run companies, close deals, get hired over better candidates, and talk their way into rooms they were not invited to.

You cannot learn it from a book. You learn it by doing it four hundred times. We pay you while you do.

The money

Good Guaranteed base +

Commission on top, no ceiling. Holiday allowance and pension on top of that.

The hours

Anywhere from 15 to 37 a week.

Where it goes

We started in February 2026. We are already growing, which means the ladder above you is short and mostly empty. We promote from inside, and people have moved up to team leader in months, not years. Get good and you will be leading people before most of your friends finish their first probation period.

Straight talk

This job is not for everyone, and we would rather tell you now.

Apply

Hit apply. One minute. No CV, no cover letter, no motivation essay.

https://fremtidensfundraising.dk/ansoeg/fundraiser/

We reply within two working days. Interviews every week. Start within two weeks.

Three positions. Questions, call August on 25 78 10 13.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) de Village Vacances (H/F)
jobs.description:
Prenez la direction d'un village vacances 3* Atout France situé à Sevrier, à 8 km d'Annecy, offrant une vue panoramique sur le lac et un cadre exceptionnel pour des séjours en pension complète ou demi-pension. Vous serez responsable de la gestion globale du village, de la satisfaction client, du management des équipes et de la performance opérationnelle et financière de la structure.
Typologies de clients principales : Séminaires (accueil de groupes professionnels), Groupes loisirs (associations, clubs, comités d'entreprise), Familles (séjours multigénérationnels, animations adaptées).
Ouverture : Toute l'année (fermeture annuelle 4 semaines février / mars).

VOS MISSIONS :
Vous serez le garant de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la rentabilité et de l'expérience client au sein d'un village de 155 chambres (rénovées en 2020), doté d'un restaurant panoramique, d'un bar, d'une piscine extérieure, d'un parc paysager de 3,5 ha, et d'équipements dédiés aux loisirs.
1. RELATION CLIENT ET SATISFACTION
- Garantir une expérience client irréprochable pour les trois typologies (séminaires, groupes loisirs, familles).
- Piloter la qualité des prestations (hébergement, restauration, animations, services techniques).
- Développer l'accueil des séminaires : logistique, équipements adaptés, services sur mesure.
- Superviser les animations (programmes variés pour familles et adultes, semaines thématiques).
- Assurer la gestion des réclamations et proposer des solutions adaptées.
2. MANAGEMENT ET RESSOURCES HUMAINES
- Recruter, former et encadrer une équipe pluridisciplinaire
- Organiser les plannings en tenant compte des pics d'activité.
- Animer les réunions d'équipe et favoriser la coopération interservices.
- Gérer les conflits et maintenir un climat social positif.
- Évaluer les performances et mettre en place des plans de développement.
3. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET FINANCIÈRE
- Piloter le budget du village et rendre compte à la direction générale.
- Optimiser les coûts (achats groupés, gestion des stocks, maintenance préventive).
- Superviser la maintenance des infrastructures et veiller au respect des normes ERP, HACCP et sécurité.
- Assurer la passation entre saisons (clôtures comptables, inventaires).
- Développer des partenariats locaux.

VOTRE PROFIL
Formation et Expérience

jobs.title: Student Assistant in Architecture & Technology
jobs.description:
Are you studying IT, software engineering, computer science, or a related field and looking for a student position where you can work with enterprise architecture, documentation, and modern technology? At Nordic RCC, you will join a team helping build the digital foundations that support the Nordic power system and the green transition.

If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

Your role

As a student assistant in Architecture & Technology, you will be part of a dynamic team that includes architects across multiple domains. In this role, you will support the Architecture & Technology team in documenting our architecture landscape and develop guidelines and standards for architecture documentation. You will work closely with Enterprise, System and Application Architects and gain first-hand experience of how architecture is used to guide technology decisions across a growing organisation.

What you will do

  • Assist the architecture team in ensuring the quality of existing documentation

  • Create architecture models according to standards and guidelines, and support in architecture modelling and documentation activities

  • Assist in implementation governance tools

  • Contribute to governance activities, including architecture reviews and assessments

  • Research emerging technologies, trends, and industry best practices

  • Prepare presentations, reports, and decision material for management and stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with

  • Relevant Background: You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software/IT Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Collaborative Attitude: You enjoy working with others and are comfortable interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Interest in Architecture & Technology: You are curious about how organisations design, govern, and evolve their technology landscape

  • Structured Working Style: You have an eye for detail and enjoy creating order, structure, and clarity in documentation and information

  • Analytical and Curious Mindset: You have a strong curiosity for technology, and enjoy analysing complex topics, identifying patterns, and creating structure and clarity from information

  • Proactive Approach: You take initiative, ask questions, and are not afraid to explore new topics independently while seeking guidance when needed

Through this role, you will gain practical experience with enterprise, system, and application architecture, on-premises technologies, and technology strategy. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced architects and technology professionals while contributing to initiatives that support Nordic RCC's mission and the green energy transition.

The role is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience, allowing you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world environment while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The position will require approximately 10-15 hours per week, depending on your study workload. We are flexible during exam periods and expect that you have at least 1½ - 2 years left of your studies.

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 25 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to provide information to the same extent as the candidate for security clearance.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 September. We will conduct interviews on a continuous basis. If you have any questions, please contact Camilla Schneider Bergman, Head of Architecture & Technology M: +45 29 11 16 39. (Not available until 1 September)

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

jobs.title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

jobs.title: Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency
jobs.description:
Salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent til JWC Staffing Agency

30 timer om ugen – med mulighed for fuldtid

Har du et skarpt salgsgen, trives med en travl hverdag og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem stærke relationer?

Hos JWC Staffing Agency søger vi en engageret salgs- og rekrutteringskonsulent, der vil være med til at udvikle vores forretning og sikre de bedste medarbejdere til byggebranchen.

Du bliver en nøglespiller i vores fortsatte vækst, hvor du får ansvaret for både at udvikle vores kundeportefølje og sikre en professionel rekrutteringsproces fra første kontakt til medarbejderen er godt i gang hos kunden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor salg, rekruttering og koordinering går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

· Opsøge og udvikle nye kunder inden for bygge- og anlægsbranchen.

· Vedligeholde og udvikle eksisterende kunderelationer.

· Planlægge og koordinere rekrutteringsforløb fra start til slut.

· Udarbejde og publicere stillingsopslag.

· Aktivt søge efter kandidater via jobportaler, sociale medier, og netværk.

· Gennemføre telefoninterviews, jobsamtaler og kandidatvurderinger.

· Koordinere ansættelser, onboarding og opfølgning.

· Arbejde målrettet med salgsbudgetter, pipeline og KPI'er.

Vi forestiller os, at du

· Har erfaring med salg – gerne inden for byggebranchen eller bemandingsbranchen.

· Trives i en hverdag med højt tempo og mange forskellige opgaver.

· Er en dygtig relationsskaber og kommunikerer naturligt med både kunder og kandidater.

· Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket – også når tempoet er højt.

· Er selvstændig, initiativrig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

· Motiveres af at skabe resultater og nå dine mål.

· Taler - forstår og skriver dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring fra byggebranchen eller selv har en håndværksmæssig baggrund.

Vi tilbyder

Hos os får du ikke bare et job – du bliver en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

· En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag.

· Mulighed for at præge virksomhedens fortsatte vækst.

· Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger.

· Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

· Attraktiv lønpakke med pension og bonusordning.

· Computer, telefon og de nødvendige arbejdsredskaber.

· Mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale.

· Frihed under ansvar og fleksibilitet i hverdagen.

Hvem er vi?

JWC Staffing Agency leverer vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger til bygge- og anlægsbranchen i hele Danmark.

Vi er en ung virksomhed med store ambitioner. Selvom JWC Staffing Agency er en relativt ny virksomhed, består vores team af medarbejdere med mange års erfaring inden for bemandings- og byggebranchen. Derfor bygger vores samarbejde på værdier som ordentlighed, troværdighed og professionalisme.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre team med højt humør, en uformel omgangstone og stor respekt for hinandens kompetencer. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde, og derfor arbejder vi ud fra filosofien: "Vi løfter i flok."

Hos os er kolleger ikke konkurrenter. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og fejrer succeserne sammen. Den kultur afspejler sig både i vores daglige samarbejde og i vores bonusstruktur.

Vi har kontorer i Kolding og Odense, og denne stilling har primær arbejdsplads i Odense.

Ansøgning

Kan du se dig selv som en del af JWC Staffing Agency, og har du lyst til at være med på vores vækstrejse? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til jwc@jwc-staffing.dk med emnet "Salg".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Nørrebro)

Position: Full-Time (37 hours / week)

Salary: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Diamond Slice

At Diamond Slice, we bring proper New York slice shop culture to Copenhagen. We elevate the humble slice with high-hydration sourdough, top-tier seasonal local ingredients, natural wines, craft beers, and cocktails—all served in a fast-paced, high-energy, welcoming neighborhood environment.  We pride ourselves on exceptional quality, great hospitality, and an unpretentious vibe.

We are growing and looking for a driven Front of House Manager to lead our floor operations, nurture our team culture, and deliver outstanding guest experiences.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

As FOH Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day guest experience, lead shift execution, and serve as a key operational anchor for both our daily service and special events.

  • FOH Leadership & Experience: Take ownership of the Front of House, ensuring smooth service flow, excellent atmosphere, and high operational standards.

  • Team Coaching & Motivation: Train, mentor, and inspire the FOH team to build a high-performing, friendly, and efficient service squad.

  • Guest Communication: Serve as the primary face and voice for guest interactions, handling feedback, special requests, and inquiries with warmth and professionalism.

  • Festivals & Events Logistics: Play a central, hands-on role in planning and executing logistics for outdoor festivals, pop-ups, and special catering events.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced hospitality leader who takes initiative, and thrives with autonomy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in hospitality (with proven leadership or supervisory experience preferred).

  • Autonomy & Problem Solving: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership to solve operational challenges independently.

  • Assertive Communication: Unafraid to speak up, bring issues to the table, and constructively challenge the status quo to make operations better.

  • Feedback Culture: Skilled and comfortable with both giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback with colleagues and leadership.

  • Guest-Centric Mindset: Genuinely loves host culture, high-energy environments, and personal interactions with guests.

  • Schedule Availability: Fully comfortable working evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month, aligned with your experience.

  • Flexible Schedule: High degree of scheduling flexibility, provided operations run smoothly and team coverage is secure.

  • Autonomous Role: Real freedom to shape FOH operations and make your mark on our growing brand.

  • Great Culture: A fast-paced, supportive, and passionate workplace with high standards and great pizza.

How to Apply

Ready to join the Diamond Slice team?

Please submit your CV along with a short introduction telling us about yourself and why you'd be a great fit for Diamond Slice to: work@diamondslice.dk

Note! Applications must include: "Diamond Slice FOH Manager" in the subject line to be considered.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon Avedøre og Prøvestenen
jobs.description:
Der er chauffører - og der er Unicon chauffører 

Som betonchauffør er du andet og mere end bare en “ratholder”. Du er chaufførernes svar på Tom Kristensen og en ørn til at navigere under selv de trangeste forhold. Derudover kan du håndtere betonen, når den skal off-loades via båndet eller til en pumpechauffør, og du ved, hvordan man får en god dialog med de ansvarlige på pladsen, der modtager betonen.  

Der er dig, der sørger for, at betonen bliver leveret rigtigt og til tiden – og derfor også dig, der er respekt om, når folk får øje på den blå- og hvidstribede Unicon-bil. At være en del af holdet hos Unicon er noget ganske særligt, og det kræver, at du også er det.  

Vi arbejder tæt sammen i teams på de enkelte fabrikker og er der for hinanden, når der er brug for det. Og så har vi branchens bedste betingelser; med karrieremuligheder, fleksibilitet, betalt arbejdstøjsordning med vask, tryghed og gode forhold.  

Der er flere gode grunde til at blive chauffør hos Unicon:  

  • Vi har branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold 

  • Fleksibilitet for dig i forhold til vagter og arbejdssted 

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning, hvor vi også vasker tøjet for dig  

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder både fagligt og personligt og spændende karrieremuligheder 

  • En helt unik holdånd  

  • En grundig introduktion og oplæring i jobbet  

  • Gode arbejdsforhold. Unicon er medlem af Dansk Industri, som har overenskomst med 3F 

For at komme med på holdet kræver det, at... 

  • Du har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer og EU-bevis

  • Du har fokus på din og andres sikkerhed  

  • Du er præsentabel og serviceminded, da du er vores ansigt udadtil 

  • Du har fysik til at rengøre og vedligeholde din betonbil 

  • Du kan holde orden omkring dig 

  • Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat samt erfaring fra bygge-/entreprenørbranchen

Med udgangspunkt fra vores fabrik i Avedøre eller Prøvestenen vil du indgå i et fleksibelt team med gode kollegaer om afvikling af den daglige betonproduktion samt forefaldende arbejde på fabrikken. 

Du vil referere til fabrikkens daglige leder.   

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet  

Hvis du vil med på holdet, så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Såfremt du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte fabriksleder Michael Rud Larsen på telefon 40181421. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har den rette kandidat.  

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: Junior Embedded Software / Payload Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to work within sustainability and drones? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you. 

Our tech team is looking for a new colleague to help build and improve the electronics that turn our drones into precision measuring instruments. If you enjoy hands-on hardware work in a greentech environment and want real ownership over what you build, we want to hear from you. 

About the job 

You will be part of a small, talented tech team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our fleet of custom UAV deployed across the world to help map critical emissions. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Developing payload firmware that communicates with our drone systems (MAVLink / DJI) and onboard gas instrumentation and other sensors. 

  • Helping to bring new sensor instruments from datasheet to bench to flight. 

  • Improving and fixing existing payloads, diagnose issues on the bench and through in-flight data, harden the firmware, and ship the fix. 

  • Building small interface and breakout PCBs in KiCad, from assembly and bringing it up through to your own revisions. 

  • Potential for CAD and other mechanical work, depending on your qualifications. 

About you 

  • A bachelor's degree or similar/higher in electronics, robotics, computer engineering, mechatronics, physics or similar. 

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience, from your studies, a project, or a job. 

  • Tinker with Arduino/Raspberry Pi type projects. 

  • Wired up and used Serial/UART, I²C, SPI, etc., not just read about them. 

  • Basic C/C++ (or Arduino) and a bit of Python. 

  • English at a professional level. 

Nice to have 

  • Curiosity about drones, sensors and physical measurements. 

  • PCB design/KiCad experience, with signal/noise integrity knowledge. 

  • CAD and/or mechanical knowledge. 

  • Python for log analysis and quick tooling. 

  • Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement. 

What we offer 

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact. 

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance. 

  • Real hardware ownership early on, with a senior engineer to learn from. 

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early. 

  • A close-knit, supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning. 

  • Work that measurably cuts industrial emissions. 

About Explicit 

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology. Every measurement depends on the payload the drone carries: the boards, firmware, and sensors. 

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. 

Practical information 

  • Application deadline: 21 August 2026 

  • Expected start date: 1 October 2026 or 1 November 2026 

  • Location: Virum, Denmark 

How to apply 

Please send your application, including a few lines about what you’ve built and your CV, to jobs@explicit.dk. 

If you have any questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Rune Brogaard, Technical Manager, at ryb@explicit.dk

jobs.title: Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation (m/f)
jobs.description:
Change Management Specialist - Accounting and Corporate Services Transformation

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Change Management Specialist to support the transformation of its Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

As Change Management Specialist, you will:
• Support the transformation core team in organising, monitoring and steering the overall transformation agenda.
• Contribute to the definition and implementation of change management plans across departments.
• Assess the impact of transformation initiatives on teams, roles, responsibilities, processes, behaviours and client service delivery.
• Work closely with sponsors, department representatives, managers and operational teams to ensure that change is understood, accepted and adopted.
• Identify adoption risks, resistance points, communication needs, training needs and operational readiness issues.
• Prepare stakeholder communications, internal updates, user engagement material and change adoption reporting.
• Support the preparation of change impact assessments, stakeholder maps, readiness assessments and adoption dashboards.
• Coordinate with the central IT Business Application team, project teams and other internal stakeholders to align implementation plans with business change needs.
• Promote a pragmatic and user-oriented approach to transformation, focused on operational adoption and sustainable change.

This position is for you if:

• You have 4 to 6 years of experience in change management, business transformation, organisational change, consulting, operational excellence or a similar field.
• You have contributed to transformation programmes involving several stakeholders, business teams or departments.
• Experience with accounting, corporate services, fund administration or professional services environments.
• You can translate strategic objectives into practical change actions.
• You are able to assess how change impacts people, processes, roles, responsibilities and ways of working.
• You are comfortable facilitating discussions, structuring feedback and turning complex situations into clear action plans.
• You have strong communication skills and can adapt your message to partners, managers and operational teams.
• You are structured, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to monitor progress without taking ownership of each individual project.
• You have a good understanding of digital transformation, business applications and the role technology can play in improving processes, collaboration and service delivery.
• You are familiar with the potential of AI in a business environment and have already used, tested or contributed to practical AI-related use cases.
• You are fluent in English and French.
…then this offer is probably made for you!

It would be an advantage if you also have:

• Exposure to software implementation or digital transformation programmes.
• Knowledge of change management methodologies such as Prosci, ADKAR, Kotter or similar approaches.
• Experience preparing change plans, communication plans, adoption material, training support or stakeholder engagement plans.
• Good command of Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint, Excel, Teams and SharePoint. Experience with project or collaboration tools would be an asset.

What we offer

• A key role in a strategic transformation programme within one of BDO Luxembourg's core business practices.
• The opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, business teams and technology specialists.
• A varied role combining change management, stakeholder engagement, communication and transformation monitoring.
• A collaborative, multicultural and entrepreneurial working environment.
• The opportunity to contribute to the future operating model of our Accounting, Corporate, Fund and Payroll practices.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities in line with your strengths and career aspirations.

What´s in it for you:

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.
