You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 3+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - You are a fluent Russian speaker

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. jobs.title: Head of Demand Engine
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is looking for a Head of Demand Engine to build the engine that turns our best product stories, customer proof, and market opportunities into scaled pipeline. You’ll lead demand programs across campaigns, digital, paid strategy, webinars, email, web, and emerging channels. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing on audience and offer strategy, with Performance Marketing on paid execution, and with Field Marketing & Events on the moments that benefit from in-person activation.




This is a senior leadership role with both AMER and global scope. You’ll help set the global standard for how Notion plans, runs, tests, and measures demand programs, while learning from strong regional teams and making the best ideas repeatable across markets. You’ll lead a growing team spanning demand programs and digital demand, with room to expand into areas like partner marketing over time.




This is a build job as much as a run job. We’re looking for someone with real taste who can spot a strong idea, turn it into a sharp program, and build a repeatable engine around what works. You should care about quality and craft, but also love testing, data, systems, and execution. The opportunity is to modernize demand generation at one of the companies defining how teams work with AI.




This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the demand programs strategy, calendar, and operating rhythm across priority audiences, segments, and offers.

 - Turn strong product stories, content, customer proof, and market opportunities into integrated programs that can scale across channels and regions.

 - Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set a high bar for creative and execution, learn quickly, and put more weight behind what works.

 - Serve as the global point person for paid digital demand strategy. Define the audiences, offers, creative, programs, and goals, then partner closely with Performance Marketing on execution and optimization.

 - Lead digital demand across webinars, email, web, review sites, nurture, and new formats, creating new programs where the strategy calls for them.

 - Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps to build a trusted global approach to marketing ROI, attribution, forecasting, MQA/MQL methodology, and campaign reporting.

 - Work closely with Enterprise Product Marketing on audience, offer, and campaign strategy, and with Field Marketing & Events on coordinated execution.

 - Help build our muscle in account-based marketing and partner marketing as those motions develop.

 - Be a trusted partner to Sales and executive leadership. Bring a clear point of view, make the numbers legible, and advocate for what will have the most impact.

 - Hire, coach, and lead a strong team across demand programs and digital demand.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - A track record of building and scaling B2B demand programs that create qualified pipeline.

 - Strong judgment and taste. You can point to specific programs that worked because the audience, offer, creative, and execution were sharp.

 - Deep digital demand experience across paid strategy, email, web, webinars, nurture, and integrated campaigns.

 - A testing mindset and the operating discipline to turn learnings into repeatable programs, systems, and investment decisions.

 - Comfort with data. You can work closely with Marketing Ops and RevOps on attribution, reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and translate the numbers into clear action.

 - Executive presence. You earn trust with Sales and company leaders, hold a strong point of view, and are comfortable making hard calls.

 - Experience leading and developing strong teams in a fast-moving environment.

 - Experience operating across regions, or genuine curiosity and appetite to build globally.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. This model is still being written, and you’ll help write it.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience building account-based marketing programs.

 - Experience with partner or ecosystem marketing.

 - Experience working across both product-led and sales-assisted growth motions.




WHY THIS ROLE

This is one of the most visible, highest-impact seats in Notion’s marketing org. You’ll have the mandate to build the demand engine, shape how we measure marketing ROI globally, and work directly with Sales, RevOps, company leaders, and regional marketing teams.

jobs.title: Join Iceland´s Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician
jobs.description:
Join Iceland's Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Are you an ambitious and enthusiastic Consultant Physician looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact? Would you like to build a career with purpose in one of the world's most beautiful, and progressive countries?

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. We are seeking Consultant Physicians in Internal Medicine and/or Acute Internal Medicine to join our multidisciplinary team as we design, develop and deliver the next generation of emergency services in Iceland working in a leading university hospital committed to innovation, education, and research.

Experience an outstanding work-life balance in Reykjavík, where a vibrant capital city meets spectacular nature. Physicians' standard daytime working hours are based on a 36-hour working week. Enjoy safe communities, short commutes, world-class outdoor adventures, excellent schools and healthcare, and easy access to Europe and North America.

Landspitali is developing a new integrated model of urgent and emergency care focused on:
•    Improving patient flow
•    Delivering safer, more efficient and person-centered care
•    Developing innovative pathways for acutely ill patients

Successful applicants will play a key role in developing several new clinical services, including:
•    Acute Medical Unit (AMU)
•    Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC)
•    Hospital at Home

Why join Landspitali we offer:
•    A rewarding consultant-level position
•    Opportunities to take on leadership roles in developing new services
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams
•    An academic environment where clinical excellence, research, teaching and innovation go hand in hand
•    The opportunity to contribute to a transformation that will benefit thousands of patients every year
•    Excellent opportunities to achieve a healthy work life balance.
•    A supportive working environment that values staff wellbeing and professional development.
•    Structured Icelandic language training, including formal courses and digital learning resources.

The position is full-time (100%) or as otherwise agreed and is available immediately or by mutual agreement.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Clinical work across inpatient wards, the Acute Medical Assessment Unit (AMAU), and Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) services
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine inpatient admitting team
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine on-call rota
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students and resident doctors in training
•    Opportunities to participate in research activities
•    Participation in quality improvement and patient safety initiative
•    Contributing to the ongoing development of Acute Medicine and General Internal Medicine services

QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Specialist registration (or equivalent) in General Internal Medicine, Acute Internal Medicine, or Family Medicine/General Practice with an emphasis on Acute Care
•    Broad clinical experience in Acute and/or General Internal Medicine
•    Excellent communication and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
•    A commitment to quality improvement, innovation and the development of high-value healthcare services.

ABOUT THE POSITION AND APPLICATION:
Salary according to the current collective agreement concluded by the Minister of Finance and the Economy and the Medical Association of Iceland. It also depends on factors such as additional education, professional experience, and years of service. Physicians who are fully dedicated to the position in Landspítali may also receive an additional 15% salary premium in accordance with the collective agreement.

Applicants will be interviewed and decision to hire will be based on the information and documents provided by the applicants. Landspitali equal opportunities policy is taken into account when hiring at the hospital. All applications will be responded to.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS:
Please submit:
•    A cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and your vision for contributing to the development of emergency services at Landspítali.
•    A completed application form
•    A current Curriculum Vitae, including previous employment, education and professional qualifications
•    A list of any peer-reviewed publications. Applicants should either provide a Google Scholar profile link or documentation of publications indexed in PubMed.[BG1]
•    Details of teaching experience, research activities, quality improvement work and leadership experience
•    Certified copies of medical degree(s), specialist qualifications and medical licence(s)

Supporting documents must be in PDF format.

Interviews will be conducted with applicants and the decision on employment will be based on them and the submitted documents. Landspitali equal opportunities policy is considered when hiring at the hospital. All applications will be responded to.

For further information, please contact:
Bethan Elizabeth Griffith, Head Physician, The department of Emergency Assessment Unit
Email: bethane@landspitali.is,
Hlynur Indriðason, Head Physician, The department of General Internal Medicine
Email: hlynuri@landspitali.is
Telma Huld Ragnarsdottir, Head Physician, The department of General Internal Medicine
Email: telmhuld@landspitali.is,

Regarding residence and work permit, please look at our webite.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures and put "260721-02" in the field for employer.
The application deadline is up to and including August 14th, 2026

Landspitali is a vibrant and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 people work in interdisciplinary teams and collaboration between different professions. Landspitali’ s vision is to be a leading university hospital where the patient is always at the forefront. Key emphases in the hospital's policy are safety culture, efficient and high-quality services, human resource development and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Radiographer - Exciting opportunity at the Breast Centre at Landspitali - University Hospital of Iceland
jobs.description:
We are seeking an ambitious Radiographer to join our team in the screening and diagnostic imaging department at the Breast Centre at Landspitali.

We offer a comprehensive onboarding program under the guidance of experienced colleagues in a supportive and positive working environment. Our team enjoys an excellent workplace culture, with numerous opportunities for professional growth and to contribute to continuous improvements in the care and services we provide to our patients. The position is daytime only, Monday through Friday.

The screening and diagnostic imaging department at the Breast Centre at Landspitali provides breast screening, diagnostic breast imaging and radiation protection services.
The standard full-time workweek is 36 hours, with the aim of promoting employee health and wellbeing while supporting a better work¿life balance.

Employment percentage are negotiable.

Key Responsibilities
•    Carry out all mammography techniques both in screening and diagnostic imaging (X-ray images of the breasts and clinical examinations) whilst ensuring that the clients receive a caring and sensitive service.
•    Travel part time of the year throughout Iceland to perform screening mammography examinations.
•    Undertake specialized duties as required within the department.
•    Actively participate in quality improvement initiatives.
•    Maintain accurate documentation in the department's information systems.
•    Contribute to the delivery of high-quality diagnostic imaging services.
•    Work collaboratively as part of the multidisciplinary team to provide the highest standard of patient care

Qualifications
•    A valid license to practice as a Radiographer in Iceland
•    Previous experience in breast imaging is highly valued
•    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a professional attitude
•    Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
•    Commitment to fostering a positive and collaborative work environment
•    Reliable, punctual, and positive
•    Strong professional standards with the ability to work independently
•    Initiative, organizational skills, and a proactive approach
•    Good command of English, both spoken and written

Additional Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Society of Radiographers.

Application Requirements
Please submit:
•    A completed application form
•    A current Curriculum Vitae, including education, professional qualifications and previous employment
•    Certified copies of academic certificates
•    A valid license to practice as a radiographer in Iceland (or eligibility to obtain one prior to commencing employment).

Supporting documents must be submitted in PDF format.

Interviews may be conducted with shortlisted applicants, and the decision on employment will be based on the interview(s) and the submitted documents. Recruitment at Landspítali is conducted in accordance with the hospital's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be notified of the outcome of their application.

For further information, please contact:
Kristrun Þorkelsdottir, Head of the Breast Centre Outpatient Clinic, Email: kristrth@landspitali.is, TEL +354 8245421

For information on residence and work permits, please visit this website

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures and put "260721-03" in the field for employer.

Workada creates high-quality labeled data for advanced technology systems. Our team reviews, organizes, categorizes, evaluates, and quality-checks digital content so those systems can better understand information and perform real-world tasks.

They will also have strong experience managing a high-performing team of product support specialists across multiple levels, ensuring timely issue resolution, operational excellence, and a seamless customer experience.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

What we're looking for

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Ability to understand complex client needs, craft tailored discovery, and drive sales through consultative approaches.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
## About Outsite

 

Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.

 

## About Outsite for Teams

 

Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

 

## Role Overview

 

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.

 

This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

 

## Key Responsibilities

 

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound

- Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder

- Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base

- Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging

- Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages

- Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities

 

### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management

- Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture

- Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close

- Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged

- Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets

 

### 3. Collaboration & Handoff

- Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound

- Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals

- Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time

 

### 4. Reporting

- Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers

- Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

 

## Required Skills & Experience

 

- 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)

- Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders

- Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads

- Able to work autonomously and independently 

- Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive 

- Comfortable working European timezone hours

- Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job

- Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to

- Comfortable using AI in workflow

 

## Nice to Have

 

- Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams

- Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot

- Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space

- Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product

 

## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

 

- A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)

- A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM

- First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed

- Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing

- Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

 

## Benefits

 

- Remote, travel encouraged

- Credits for Outsite locations 

- Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
jobs.description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: 0.5 - 1.0

jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is growing quickly, and our Corporate Services needs are becoming more complex. We're looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager, Corporate Services to define sourcing strategies, guide supplier decisions, and build long-term partnerships across critical areas of the business.

In this role, you'll partner closely with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, IT, Compliance, HR, and Facilities to develop sourcing strategies, negotiate commercial terms, manage supplier performance, and help teams make informed decisions across value, cost, quality, speed, and risk.

You'll be a strategic advisor to leaders across the business, bringing market intelligence, commercial expertise, and supplier insights to help teams make thoughtful investment decisions and maximize the value of their vendor partnerships.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're redefining how software is built and who gets to build it. Our mission is to achieve Autonomy for All: making programming accessible, collaborative, and powered by AI. Realizing that vision requires a platform that legitimate users can trust and adversarial actors cannot exploit.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to help build Replit's Trust & Safety and Anti-Abuse program from the ground up. You'll turn noisy behavioral, identity, payment, infrastructure, and content signals into the measurement systems, detections, and decisions that protect Replit's users, platform, and economics. You'll work closely with Engineering, Support, Legal, Security, Infrastructure, Money, and Growth to make abuse economically unviable while keeping friction low for legitimate users.



Replit sits at the frontier of AI-native abuse. Our platform is a target for phishing and scam hosting, cryptomining, LLM token farming, card and coupon fraud, referral abuse, and increasingly, abuse driven by AI agents themselves. You'll help define how we identify, measure, and respond to these threats without compromising the experience of good users.



WHO YOU ARE

You're a data scientist who moves fast, goes deep, and thinks adversarially. You can spin up an analysis in hours that would take others days, not by cutting corners, but because you've built the intuition and technical toolkit to get to the right answer quickly. You dig past the top-line abuse rate to understand selection effects, missing labels, policy changes, attacker adaptation, and the false positives hidden inside an aggregate metric.

You understand that Trust & Safety data is imperfect and outcomes are high stakes. Ground truth is delayed, biased, and often incomplete; attackers react to defenses; and an apparently effective rule can quietly harm legitimate users. You pressure-test your own work, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish correlation from evidence strong enough to justify enforcement.

You use AI agents and tools aggressively to multiply your output: writing code, exploring data, generating hypotheses, and prototyping investigations. But you treat every AI-assisted output as a draft, not a deliverable. You know what good analysis looks like and won't ship anything that doesn't meet that bar.



YOU WILL

 - Own the analytical foundation for Trust & Safety, including abuse prevalence, fraud loss, false-positive and false-negative rates, time to detect, time to mitigate, appeal and reversal rates, and verification step-up conversion.

 - Build reliable datasets and dbt models that connect product events, account and identity signals, payment activity, infrastructure usage, content classifications, enforcement actions, appeals, and support outcomes.

 - Develop and evaluate risk models, rules, and anomaly-detection systems for threats such as phishing, scam hosting, cryptomining, token farming, payment fraud, promotional abuse, and AI-agent exploitation.

 - Design rigorous offline evaluations, shadow-mode tests, holdouts, and controlled experiments to measure detection quality and the user impact of new policies, enforcement actions, and progressive verification.

 - Define thresholds and decision frameworks that balance abuse reduction, economic loss, customer friction, and false positives across free, paid, and enterprise users.

 - Investigate emerging abuse patterns, quantify their impact, identify coordinated behavior, and turn ambiguous signals into clear recommendations for product and engineering teams.

 - Develop predictive models that estimate account, device, transaction, workspace, or deployment risk and embed those signals into detection, review, and escalation workflows.

 - Partner with Support and Legal to improve case review, appeals, reason-code quality, and feedback loops so human decisions become useful model and policy signals.

 - Build monitoring that detects model drift, attacker adaptation, data-quality failures, and unexpected harm to legitimate users.

 - Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including the tradeoffs, uncertainty, and evidence behind high-impact decisions.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Build a measurement framework for Replit's abuse surface, reconcile incomplete labels across automated detections, human review, appeals, chargebacks, and support cases, and establish a trustworthy baseline for the first time.

 - Design and evaluate a risk-scoring model for suspicious account clusters using identity, device, payment, graph, and product-behavior signals, then define thresholds that materially reduce fraud while protecting legitimate users.

 - Analyze a phishing detection rule that appears highly precise, uncover that it disproportionately bans paying users with legitimate brand references, and redesign its evaluation and review path to reduce false positives.

 - Measure a progressive verification "ladder of trust," determining when to step users up to additional verification and quantifying the tradeoff between abuse prevented and legitimate-user conversion lost.

 - Detect coordinated token-farming or promotional-abuse networks by combining account-linkage graphs, referral behavior, payment patterns, and infrastructure usage, then partner with Engineering to operationalize the findings.

 - Evaluate a new enforcement policy in shadow mode, estimate its counterfactual impact, and recommend whether to launch, revise, or reject it before any users are affected.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, fraud, risk, trust and safety, or a related field.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience working with large behavioral datasets and building reliable data models or pipelines.

 - Experience developing and evaluating predictive models, experiments, or decision systems, with sound judgment around uncertainty and tradeoffs.

 - Ability to turn ambiguous data into clear recommendations and communicate them effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

 - Comfort working with imperfect labels, biased samples, and high-impact decisions where false positives matter.

 - You use AI tools extensively to increase your effectiveness while maintaining a high bar for analytical quality.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or evaluating anti-abuse, fraud, identity, security, spam, integrity, or content-safety systems at scale.

 - Built, shipped, and maintained ML models in production (classification, anomaly detection, or risk scoring), including feature engineering on behavioral and transaction data, threshold selection against precision/recall economics, and post-launch monitoring

 - Experience with graph analysis, entity resolution, coordinated-behavior detection, reputation systems, anomaly detection, or risk scoring.

 - Experience measuring false positives and enforcement harm, designing human-review workflows, or using appeals and case outcomes as model feedback.

 - Familiarity with progressive verification, KYC, account trust, or identity providers such as Prove, Persona, Socure, or Stripe Identity.

 - Experience with causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score methods, synthetic control, or uplift modeling.

 - Experience with a modern data stack such as dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Fivetran, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Segment.

 - Experience at a consumer platform, developer tool, cloud provider, marketplace, fintech company, or other product with a meaningful adversarial surface.



BONUS POINTS

 - You've built AI-powered analytical tools, investigation systems, automated detections, or novel measurement approaches.

 - You have experience with AI-native abuse such as prompt injection, LLM token farming, model extraction, or agent-driven abuse.

 - You understand freemium, usage-based, or promotional pricing models and the abuse incentives they create.

 - You've worked directly with operational review teams and can translate analytical signals into practical playbooks, queues, and escalation paths.

jobs.title: Boltvezető-helyettes HUMANIC - Szombathelyi Family Cent ... (Verkaufstrainer/in)
jobs.description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 70 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

AZ ÖN FELADATAI

- Boltvezető helyettesítése
- Ügyfélkiszolgálás és értékesítés.
- Üzleti célok elérésének biztosítása
- Üzletünk szabályainak betartatása
- Üzletünk rendjének és tisztaságának fenntartása.
- Üzlet napi működésének felügyelete                
- Üzletünkben lévő termékek rendszeres ellenőrzése.
- Raktárkezelés és készletgazdálkodás
- Kapcsolattartás a vevőkkel és partnerekkel
- Ügyfelek igényeinek kielégítése.

AZ ÖN PROFILJA

- Kedves, mosolygós, dinamikus, csapatban szívesen dolgozó munkatársakat keresünk, aki szívesen foglalkozik emberekkel és mindenekelőtt szereti a cipőket,
- több éves kereskedelmi tapasztalat,
- igényes munkavégzés,
- német nyelvtudás előny,
- középfokú végzettség, érettségi

AJÁNLATUNK

- Keresünk rugalmas munkatársat boltvezető helyettesi munkakörbe, Veszprémben a Stop-Shop bevásárlóközpontban levő színvonalas cipőüzletünkbe 6 órás részmunkaidőben való foglalkoztatással.
- Változatos feladatok egy nemzetközi divatcégnél, amelynek székhelye Ausztriában található.
- Kedves, hozzáértő csapat, amely átfogó betanítást biztosít.

Előnyök üzleteinkben:- szakmai tréningek

- versenyképes alapbér
- béren kívüli juttatás
- teljesítménytől függően 13. havi bér.

Fizetés:- Megegyezés szerint

Project Manager / Delivery Assurance for SAP and Service Now (f/m/d)

Full or part time

At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. We are part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work.

With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.

**Make this the place where you grow

**Location: **Germany, Poland, Bulgaria or Romania

What makes us special:

We have a holistic view of the individual needs of our employees. Here (https://nttdata-solutions.com/de/karriere/benefits/)  you can find a detailed overview of our wide variety of benefits during different life phases.

■ Flexible working hours and locations: workation, mobile working, part-time models, sabbaticals, etc.

■ Your further development by plan: topic-specific induction, targeted career development based on career models, programs and your own academy

■ Family first: e.g. daycare allowance, paid maternity leave and paternity network

■ SAP Platinum Partnership: strong SAP partnership, large knowledge network, and SAP Learning Hub and certification opportunities.

■ We take care: e.g. 25% subsidy for company pension plan, company health management and cooperation with fitness providers

■ We help you get from A to B: company car (depending on your role), discount on public transport and bicycle leasing via JobRad®.

Do you love challenges?

As Project / Delivery Assurance Manager for SAP and ServiceNow Projects and Managed Services, you will be responsible for:

■ Conducting risk and quality assessments for new and existing large customer engagements, ensuring SAP and ServiceNow-specific risks are addressed.

■ Providing feedback on the Deal Governance process to ensure that new projects and services meet agreed standards and quality expectations.

■ Supporting Red/Amber projects by developing and executing "Back to Green" action plans, including internal management reporting.

■ Defining the necessary quality checks for SAP and ServiceNow projects and services to ensure quality, speed and profitability

Convince us with your potential!

■ Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

Several years of work experience in Delivery Assurance, Project and/or Services Management proves your:

■ Expertise in SAP and ServiceNow within complex enterprise environments

■ Delivery assurance skills, supported by certification (e.g. Six Sigma)

■ Strong project/service management and leadership abilities

■ Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach

■ Excellent communication and collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders

■ Commitment to continuous improvement, attention to detail, and adaptability under pressure

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Senior AI Builder
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


The AI Studio is the team responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing internal software platforms across every functional department of the company, including People Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Recruiting, and Executive Operations. We treat each internal department as its own product surface, and in truth as its own startup, with its own customers, its own metrics, and its own reasons for existing. We ship custom software, built on Replit’s own platform, to solve operational problems that off-the-shelf SaaS tools cannot serve well at our scale and pace of growth.





POSITION SUMMARY

The Member of Technical Staff (AI Builder) is a full-time builder role with substantial autonomy. You will design, architect, and ship AI-powered internal platforms that run the operations of the company across many departments at once. This is not a role for someone who wants a narrow, well-defined lane. It is a role for someone who wants to walk into an ambiguous business problem, understand it well enough to argue about it with the department lead, and then ship the software that fixes it.

We are looking for people who genuinely understand the mechanics of a business: how revenue is actually made, why recruiting velocity matters, what makes support scale or break, how finance closes a month, and why each department is critical to whether the company wins or loses. You do not need to have run every function, but you need to respect why each one exists and be able to reason about it like an operator, not just an engineer.

Because we treat each department as its own startup, we strongly favor people who have either run their own business or worked on a fast-scaling startup. You know what it feels like to build with incomplete information, to ship before it is comfortable, and to own an outcome rather than a ticket. The work is genuinely a ton of fun, and it is also demanding: it rewards diplomacy, creativity, technical depth, and business acumen in roughly equal measure. You will move fast, work long hours when it matters, and switch fluidly between a deep technical conversation and a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder who just needs their problem solved.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



INTERNAL PLATFORM DESIGN AND ENGINEERING

 - Design, architect, and ship custom AI-powered internal platforms that serve specific operational needs across Replit’s functional departments, including but not limited to People Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Recruiting, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Operations.

 - Translate ambiguous, often non-technical business requirements into technical specifications, system architectures, and shipped software products.

 - Own platform development end-to-end, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, data models, third-party integrations, and AI model orchestration.

Applied AI and Large Language Model Engineering

 - Architect multi-stage AI pipelines incorporating large language models, including prompt engineering, tool-call architecture, structured output generation, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic workflows.

 - Conduct model selection across multiple frontier and open-source providers, evaluating models against cost per query, latency, output quality, reliability, and task-specific performance.

 - Design and implement evaluation frameworks for AI features, including test datasets, scoring rubrics, and regression tests, so that AI-driven workflows stay reliable in production.

 - Optimize AI systems for cost and performance, including the appropriate use of lighter-weight models for qualification passes, batching strategies for high-throughput workloads, and caching architectures.

Business Understanding and Stakeholder Partnership

 - Treat each internal department as its own startup: understand its goals, its constraints, and the metrics that define whether it is succeeding.

 - Partner directly with department leads to identify operational inefficiencies, scope solutions, and prioritize the work that creates the most leverage.

 - Conduct stakeholder interviews, lead requirements-gathering sessions, and translate qualitative feedback into iterative product improvements.

 - Present technical work and operational outcomes to executive leadership, including the President and senior staff, and do it in language each audience can act on.

Third-Party System Integration

 - Design and implement integrations with the third-party platforms used at Replit, including enterprise HR platforms, support ticketing systems, CRM platforms, applicant tracking systems, project management tools, and identity providers.

 - Evaluate third-party APIs, SDKs, and data schemas, and design integration architectures appropriate to scale, security, and maintainability requirements.

Production Operations and Reliability

 - Maintain and operate shipped platforms in production, including dependency management, security updates, observability, error handling, and performance monitoring.

 - Respond to production incidents and continuously iterate on shipped platforms based on user feedback and operational telemetry.

Documentation and Knowledge Transfer

 - Document architectural decisions, system designs, and operational procedures for shipped platforms.

 - Onboard future team members and contribute to the evolution of the AI Studio as the function scales.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You understand how a business actually works and can explain why each department matters to the company winning.

 - You have either run your own business or worked on a fast-scaling startup, and you carry the ownership instinct that comes with it.

 - You are comfortable with long hours and a very high pace, and you treat that as part of the fun rather than a cost.

 - You can engage credibly with both deeply technical people and non-technical stakeholders, often in the same afternoon.

 - You bring diplomacy, creativity, technical knowledge, and business acumen, and you know when each one is the tool the moment calls for.

 - You would rather ship something real and iterate than wait for perfect information.
   
   


EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Technology Management, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical or technology-business hybrid field. Equivalent foreign degrees acceptable subject to credential evaluation. Exceptional non-traditional backgrounds with a strong shipped portfolio will be considered.

 - A demonstrated portfolio of shipped software products, including AI-powered applications, and the ability to discuss technical architecture, design trade-offs, and engineering decisions in detail.

 - Experience either running your own business or working at a fast-scaling startup, with real exposure to how the business operated end-to-end.

 - Working proficiency in modern software engineering practices, including version control, code review, deployment pipelines, and production debugging.

 - Hands-on experience with one or more large language model providers and their APIs, tool-calling interfaces, and structured output mechanisms.

 - Demonstrated experience designing prompt and tool-call architectures, conducting model selection across providers, and optimizing AI systems for cost and latency.

 - Programming proficiency in Python and TypeScript or JavaScript, including familiarity with relevant frameworks for AI application development.

 - Experience with relational databases, SQL, and modern data tooling.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present technical work to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience as a founder, co-founder, or early team member at a venture-backed startup, particularly one with an AI-native product.

 - Prior experience in technology investment analysis or operational consulting, with a demonstrated ability to evaluate business operations and identify high-leverage interventions.

 - Hands-on experience building on the Replit platform, including familiarity with Replit Agent and Replit Deployments.

 - Experience designing and shipping internal tools at a high-growth technology company.

 - Multilingual proficiency, particularly in languages relevant to Replit’s international customer base, including Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, or other major commercial languages.

 - Experience with mobile application development frameworks, including React Native and Expo.
   
   


TRAVEL AND LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

This position is based in Foster City, California, with secondary work performed at the company’s San Francisco, California office. The company operates on a hybrid in-person schedule, with employees expected to be in-office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday in Foster City, and Tuesday and Thursday in San Francisco. Occasional domestic travel may be required for company offsites and customer engagements.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll be responsible for analyzing business processes, identifying areas for improvement, designing and implementing solutions to unlock our sales team. Your knowledge of sales processes will be instrumental in implementing critical systems to unlock our business goals.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with RevOps, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to turn real deal friction into durable systems: clearer processes, smarter automation, and a quoting experience that helps the team move faster with confidence.


This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Analyze business processes and sales systems to identify improvement opportunities

 - Independently drive tasks and projects end to end (requirements, analysis, design, implementation, thorough testing, launch, and ongoing support).

 - Manage Salesforce configuration through a governed change management process - building and maintaining Flows, custom objects, validation rules, and security controls with sandbox-first development, documentation, and aligned with platform best practices.

 - Collaborate proactively with business stakeholders and the Corporate Systems team to deliver durable solutions.

 - Partner with senior admins and developers to configure solutions across core CRM data models (Accounts, Opportunities, lead-to-opportunity processes, and related custom objects).

 - Support stakeholders with day-to-day system questions, unblock workflows, and become a trusted Salesforce admin partner

 - Ensure thorough testing, documentation, and clear communication for all system changes.

 - Look for everyday ways AI can accelerate your work, simplify seller processes, and reduce manual steps.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL BRING

 - You are Salesforce Admin certified.

 - 7+ years of experience as a Sales Business Systems Analyst and/or providing Salesforce support.

 - Experience with a CPQ implementation and deep knowledge of quote-to-cash (and other sales functional processes).

 - Strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud best practices, including building Flows, validation rules, and reports.

 - AI-native builder mindset: comfortable using AI tools to accelerate development, generate code, build agents, and draft clear requirements; eager to keep leveling up.

 - Ability to map processes and translate needs into user stories, with strong stakeholder collaboration.

 - Experience working in Agile environments and partnering effectively with development teams.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Certified Salesforce CPQ Specialist



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $145,000-$170,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.
